description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

As Distributor Business Development Manager, you will own Elastic's distribution relationships and unmanaged Elastic partner strategy with distribution partners across APJ region.

The successful candidate will connect Elastic's sales teams, partner teams, and distributors in the region. Their main goal is to drive pipeline generation with the help of distributors. They will also enable resellers and execute co-sell strategies. Additionally, they will work on growing new business and increasing expansion ARR through the partner ecosystem.

This role requires a candidate with strong partner sales acumen, regional experience and proven track record of growing business with distributors. You will work with cross-functional teams, and focus on driving execution of Elastic sales plays, deep technical alignment and enablement of distributors and will scale business through distributor led partner ecosystem.

As a business leader, you will conduct executive business reviews with both the distributor and Elastic leadership teams. You should be capable and comfortable delivering demonstrations of Elastic products. You will arrange technical workshops and certification boot camps with distributors and Elastic reseller teams. Additionally, you will create and improve sales plays. And most importantly drive business execution across distributors and distributor-led partner ecosystem.

What You Will Be Doing

Distribution Strategy & Business Planning:

•
Manage business plans with distribution partners. Set quarterly targets for the pipeline and for recruiting resellers. Prioritize segments for Elastic's Enterprise, Public Sector, and Commercial business.

•
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with distribution executive team, and drive business growth initiatives with Elastic Field Sales teams, Managed Partners teams, and distributors

•
Develop and execute a distribution GTM playbook aligned to Elastic's Fiscal year priorities and key performance indicators such as: partner-sourced pipeline, New & Expansion business targets and reseller coverage model.

•
Work with Global Partner Sales Operations to track distributor performance using KPIs. These KPIs include partner-sourced ARR, deal registration volume, pipeline coverage ratio, and reseller activation rates.

Distributor and Partner Ecosystem Enablement and Development:

•
Onsite & Virtual - Independently design and deliver technical enablement programs for reseller sales engineers, architects, and pre-sales teams — onsite at distributor offices, reseller HQs, and industry events, as well as in virtual/webinar formats.

•
Build and maintain a reusable enablement content library: demo environments, hands-on lab guides, discovery decks, competitive battle-cards, and certification study aids tailored to the Elastic platform (Search, Observability, Security).

•
Run monthly/quarterly distributor enablement days with coordinated technical tracks (observability, SIEM/security analytics, vector/AI search) and business tracks (program updates, incentives, pipeline reviews).

•
Drive reseller technical certifications and training completions through proactive cohort scheduling, remediation support, and accountability reporting back to Elastic Partner Enablement.

•
Deliver or co-deliver Elastic product demonstrations for reseller-led opportunities, serving as the technical point of contact for pre-sales support through distribution when a dedicated SE is unavailable.

Reseller Ecosystem Development:

•
Identify, recruit, and enable net-new resellers through distribution partners; manage tiering and partner program alignment.

•
Drive reseller activation through demand generation programs, MDF utilization, and joint marketing motions with distributors

•
Maintain a healthy, active reseller pipeline across APJ markets

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

•
Partner with Elastic Regional Sales field managers (RVPs, AEs) to integrate distribution into account and territory planning.

•
Own execution across Elastic account segments - Work with Global Partner Sales Operations & Strategy on distributor discount structures, incentive programs, and data integrity within Salesforce/Impartner.

•
Collaborate with Elastic's Marketing team to develop and deploy partner-funded demand generation campaigns through public sector distribution partners.

•
Escalate and resolve distributor-facing channel conflicts, pricing disputes, and deal registration exceptions in coordination with Global Partner Sales leadership and Deal Desk.

What You Bring

•
7+ years of channel sales or partner management experience, with at least 3 years focused on distribution.

•
Demonstrated track record of driving partner-sourced revenue through distributor-managed reseller ecosystems.

•
Proven ability to independently deliver sales pitches and business value proposition to partners, ability to showcase product or solution demos, co-deliver hands-on workshops, and lab-based training — to Sales and technical audiences (SEs, architects, pre-sales).

•
Experience building or managing a self-sustaining partner enablement program: content design, delivery cadence, certification tracking, and outcomes measurement.

•
Hands-on fluency with at least one of the following domains: observability/monitoring, SIEM/security analytics, log management, or enterprise search — sufficient to lead credible technical conversations and live product walkthroughs.

•
Deep familiarity with account segments and how channel partners serve and execute business with Enterprise, Public Sector and commercial customers.

•
Experienced with diverse region and working directly with partners based in different countries across APJ - Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder distributor relationships across sales, marketing, and executive functions.

•
Strong command of channel mechanics: deal registration, margin stacking, MDF management, reseller tiering, and co-sell program execution. - Proficiency in Salesforce CRM for pipeline management, reporting, and partner attribution workflows.

•
Excellent executive communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — and equal comfort presenting to a CISO as to a room of reseller SEs. - Willingness and ability to travel onsite to distribution and reseller locations (estimated 20%–30%) for enablement events, QBRs, and partner marketing activities.

Bonus Points

•
Direct experience with Elastic (ELK/ECE/ECK), Splunk, Datadog, CrowdStrike, or another enterprise observability or security analytics platform — including hands-on configuration or demonstration capability.

•
Familiarity with partner program platforms (Impartner, Alliances, Salesforce PRM) and co-sell tools (Tackle/Clazar, WorkSpan). - Working knowledge of cloud marketplace procurement (AWS MP, Azure MP, GCP MP) as a transactional vector through distribution.

•
Prior experience owning or supporting partner attribution framework rollouts or channel operations transformations.

•
Background in working or partnering and contributing to designing formal sales or technical training content for partner ecosystem.

Our customers are often application owners, product managers, line of business executives, CxO’s, Head’s of invitation, omni channel and digital strategy partners. description:
About Team & About Role
Rubrik’s Channel team is how we bring cyber resilience to the organizations across Japan that people rely on every day, including hospitals, banks, government bodies, manufacturers and utilities. As Channel Development Manager for Japan, you’ll own the relationships with our reseller, SI and distribution partners and turn them into a repeatable engine for pipeline and Partner Initiated Deals. This is an individual contributor role with real autonomy over which partners you invest in, how you plan with them, and how fast you help them grow.

Rubrikのチャネルチームは、病院、銀行、官公庁、製造業、公益事業など、人々の日常を支える日本全国の組織にサイバーレジリエンスを届ける役割を担っています。日本担当チャネルデベロップメントマネージャーとして、リセラー、SI、ディストリビューターとのパートナーリレーションを統括し、パイプラインとパートナー起点の案件(Partner Initiated Deals)を継続的に生み出す仕組みへと育てていただきます。本ポジションは個人貢献型(IC)の役割で、どのパートナーに投資するか、パートナーとどのように計画を立てるか、そしてパートナーの成長をどれだけ早く後押しするかについて、大きな裁量があります。

What You’ll Do

• Build and execute joint business plans with key Japan resellers, SIs and distributors, so partners have a clear path to growing their Rubrik business and Rubrik has a clear view of where it will come from.

• Drive Partner Initiated Deals and net-new pipeline by working with partner sales teams to identify, qualify and close opportunities alongside Rubrik Account Executives.

• Run account mapping and joint planning sessions between Rubrik field teams and partners, opening access to partner customer bases, both existing accounts and new logos.

• Lead enablement for partner sales and SE teams, so partners can position, demo and deploy Rubrik independently and customers see value from day one.

• Develop and manage distribution relationships, using them to extend Rubrik’s reach into the mid-market, public sector and regional enterprise accounts.

• Identify, onboard and grow new partners that fill gaps in regional, vertical or solution coverage.

• Work with Channel Marketing and Field Marketing to plan and host partner and customer events and campaigns that put Rubrik in front of the right buyers.

• Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers at your partners, earning Rubrik a place as a strategic vendor in their portfolio.

• Report on partner performance, pipeline and forecast to Channel and Sales leadership, giving the business a clear read on Japan.

主な業務内容

• 日本の主要なリセラー、SI、ディストリビューターと共同ビジネスプランを策定・実行し、パートナーがRubrikビジネスを拡大するための明確な道筋と、Rubrikが売上の見通しを把握できる状態をつくる。

• パートナーの営業チームと連携し、Rubrikのアカウントエグゼクティブとともに商談の発掘、案件化、クロージングを行い、パートナー起点の案件と新規パイプラインを創出する。

• Rubrikのフィールドチームとパートナーとの間で、アカウントマッピングおよび共同プランニングセッションを実施し、既存顧客・新規顧客の両面でパートナーの顧客基盤へのアクセスを広げる。

• パートナーの営業チームおよびSEチームのイネーブルメントをリードし、パートナーが自立してRubrikの提案、デモ、導入を行え、お客様が初日から価値を実感できる状態をつくる。

• ディストリビューターとの関係を構築・管理し、ミッドマーケット、公共部門、地方の大企業顧客へのリーチを拡大する。

• 地域、業種、ソリューションのカバレッジに不足がある領域で、新規パートナーを発掘、オンボーディングし、成長を支援する。

• チャネルマーケティングおよびフィールドマーケティングと連携し、適切な購買層にRubrikを届けるパートナー向け・顧客向けのイベントやキャンペーンを企画・開催する。

• パートナーの経営層・意思決定者との信頼関係を築き、パートナーのポートフォリオにおけるRubrikの戦略的ベンダーとしての地位を確立する。

• パートナーの実績、パイプライン、フォーキャストをチャネルおよびセールスのリーダーシップに報告し、日本の状況を明確に共有する。

Experience You’ll Need

• Strong track record in a channel development, channel sales or partner management role at a technology vendor, working with resellers, SIs and distributors in Japan.

• An Account Executive who has successfully managed client accounts may transition into a Channel Development Manager role.

• Good working knowledge of the data protection, data management, cybersecurity or storage market.

• Established relationships and a strong reputation with Japan partners and distributors.

• Experience identifying, initiating and closing deals with partners in close coordination with direct sales teams.

• Experience running quarterly and annual planning for partner sales activity and reporting on pipeline and forecast.

• Confidence presenting to larger audiences and hosting events with partners and end customers.

• A collaborative approach to working across Sales, Systems Engineering, Marketing, Alliances and Sales Operations.

• Business-level fluency in Japanese and English proficiency at a beginner level, to work with Japan partners and with regional and global teams.

求める経験・スキル

• テクノロジーベンダーにおけるチャネルデベロップメント、チャネルセールス、またはパートナーマネジメントの実績があり、日本のリセラー、SI、ディストリビューターと協業した経験

• 顧客アカウントの運営で成果を上げたアカウントエグゼクティブが、チャネルデベロップメントマネージャーへ転身することも可能です

• データ保護、データ管理、サイバーセキュリティ、またはストレージ市場に関する実務的な知識

• 日本のパートナーおよびディストリビューターとの確立した関係と高い評価

• 直販チームと緊密に連携し、パートナーとの案件の発掘、開始、クロージングを行った経験

• パートナー営業活動の四半期・年間計画の策定と、パイプラインおよびフォーキャストの報告の経験

• 大規模な聴衆の前でのプレゼンテーションや、パートナー・エンドユーザーとのイベント開催に自信を持って取り組める方

• セールス、システムエンジニアリング、マーケティング、アライアンス、セールスオペレーションと協力して業務を進める協調的な姿勢

• 日本のパートナーや地域・グローバルチームと業務を行うための、ビジネスレベルの日本語、および初級レベルの英語力

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience selling or partnering on competitive backup and recovery or cyber resilience solutions.

• A background running partner enablement or training programs.

• Experience building joint solutions with adjacent security and infrastructure vendors (e.g. identity, endpoint, network or storage).

• Experience acquiring and onboarding new partners.

歓迎する経験・スキル

• 競合するバックアップ・リカバリーまたはサイバーレジリエンスソリューションの販売、またはそれらでのパートナー協業の経験

• パートナーイネーブルメントまたはトレーニングプログラムの運営経験

• 隣接するセキュリティ・インフラベンダー(ID、エンドポイント、ネットワーク、ストレージなど)との共同ソリューション構築の経験

Sales Development Representative, Singapore

Location: Singapore

About Team & About Role

Rubrik’s Sales organization is a united group of elite cross-functional sales professionals that help companies & government entities achieve resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We offer continuous professional growth and opportunity through our world-class sales enablement program. Our One Rubrik selling approach provides all the resources you need to exceed your goals, maximize your earnings potential, and take your career to the next level. All this while doing something truly purposeful, protecting the world's data.

Rubrik’s Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) form the core of our ambitious go-to-market strategy and sales pipeline engine. Through independent outbound hunting and a proportion of inbound leads, the SDR team books high-quality meetings with potential new customers for Rubrik’s sales organization. We do this by having a targeted set of prospects that we research, personalize our messaging to, and influence to evaluate Rubrik. This is your opportunity to build the ASEAN SDR team in one of the world’s most challenging and rewarding fields.

What You’ll Do

• Identify high-potential customers, research Rubrik’s value fit, personalize messaging to prospects, and generate high-quality new business meetings for the company

• Responsible for outbound/inbound activities for our enterprise customer prospecting by contacting via email, social, and phone calls to qualify prospects to set meetings

• Follow up on inbound leads generated by Marketing and stay within compliance metrics, i.e. timely follow-up and attempts to connect

• Collaborate with the field sales team you’re aligned with and develop strategies for breaking into new accounts

• Stay up-to-date on market trends, competition, and industry developments – we’re seeing cybersecurity breaches daily in today’s world. Rubrik can make an impact.

• Be an expert on what we do and how we help our customers keep their businesses up and running.

• Use customer relationship management (Salesforce & Outreach) software to manage leads and sales activities

• Own your business and your sales targets, and be able to report on your results to your stakeholders. What you put in is what you get out!

• Develop how to think on your feet and learn the art of sales through team pitch competitions, boot camps, training, and more – we love friendly competition!

• You will receive coaching and development on an ongoing basis, our managers will assist with developing your skills and approach to calls, thus improving Rubrik’s service to its customers. (Note: Telephone calls to and from prospects & customers, may be recorded and listened to from time to time by yourself and management.)

• Engage multiple stakeholders: present to IT administrators, security and compliance teams, and executive economic buyers, tailoring the message to each audience.

• Consultative approach: comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across IT, security, and executive buyers in mid-market and enterprise accounts.

• Overlay/specialist experience: prior success working in a platform-selling model alongside core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success.

• Track record: consistent history of quota attainment and strong pipeline generation.

• Education: bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID/Azure AD, or Salesforce administration.

• Experience selling a data security or resiliency platform that spans SaaS, cloud, and on-premises workloads.

• Existing relationships with IT, security, or compliance buyers in target accounts

Rubrik is a leader in data security and cyber resilience, helping the world's leading organizations secure and recover their data from cyberattacks and operational disruptions. About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Singapore

About the Department

The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.

The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.

About This Role

In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of public sector and enterprise accounts in the Philippines market . The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.

You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.

Role Responsibilities

• Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.

• Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.

• Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.

• Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.

• Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.

• Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.

• Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).

• Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.

Required Experience

• Fluent in English and Tagalog to engage with customers in Philippines

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

• Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.

• Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.

• Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.

• Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.

• Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).

• Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.

• Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.

• Ability to travel as required.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role
Join Anthropic's Customer Success team as one of the founding members of our Japan Customer Success team as we pioneer the future of enterprise AI adoption. As a Customer Success Manager at Anthropic, you'll be the strategic partner and trusted advisor to our most complex customers across Japan, helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities: API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code.
You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us.
In partnership with the broader account team, you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives. You'll work closely with them to provide best practices and guidance, and support them as their usage (consumption and seat based) grows and evolves.
Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, implement change management strategies, optimize use cases, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies. That makes you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.
As one of the founding members of our Customer Success team in Japan, you'll help shape how we build the function in-region. That includes establishing regional processes, developing new customer relationships, and representing Anthropic's brand in a high-growth market alongside a small, growing team. You'll operate with significant autonomy while maintaining strong alignment with global teams. This requires someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and can work effectively across time zones.
Key responsibilities

• Build trusting, strategic relationships with key Japanese customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion

• Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions

• Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer and regional nuances to proactively drive usage planning, understanding current and future consumption and adoption and how it creates realized value for the customer

• Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both our consumption-based and seat-based products to drive full value from contracted commitments

• Serve as the customer's thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic's product roadmap, driving awareness of new products, and engaging Product PMs as the voice of Japanese customers

• Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment

• Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows

• Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement

• Own the customer experience across their lifecycle: manage comprehensive account and success plans grounded in the customer's business objectives, conduct Quarterly Business Reviews, and serve as the primary conduit between the customer and Anthropic

• Build Anthropic's brand and customer relationships as part of our founding in-region CS team, developing Japan-specific processes, playbooks, and best practices where needed that account for regional business cultures

Minimum qualifications

• Experience in customer-facing roles (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architect, Solutions/Functional Consultant, Success Engineer or similar)

• Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns

• Experience explaining and demonstrating technical products to various audiences

• Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple customer relationships

• Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems

• Fluency in English and Japanese

Preferred qualifications

• 6+ years of experience in relevant field

• Experience driving success across both consumption-based and seat-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each

• Strategic mindset to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans

• Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs

• Experience working in and building a growing region, while navigating across time zones with US-based headquarters

• A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality. You are a true team player

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

The team

Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. We serve as consultants, offering strategic advice on how best to excel on Agoda’s commercial platform. Pinterest brings millions of people the inspiration to create a life they love. As an Editor for Japan, you will help Pinners discover relevant ideas through high-quality content curation, Japanese-language editorial writing and trend-led experiences.

You will work with regional and global Editorial partners, Japan Creator Partnerships, Product and Sales to improve content quality, support business needs and bring Japanese seasonal and cultural trends to life on Pinterest.

What you’ll do

• Curate visually compelling, culturally relevant and inclusive content for Japanese Pinners across a range of categories including Entertainment, Art, Fashion or Beauty and seasonal moments.

• Execute editorial programming from content selection, Japanese copywriting and visual assets handling through launch, performance review and optimization.

• Create, edit and review Japanese headlines, descriptions, articles, page copy, emails and localized materials for accuracy, natural expression, brand consistency and local relevance.

• Plan and develop optimized web or email contents for the Japanese audience.

• Curate content that supports client and business needs while maintaining a useful, inspiring Pinner experience.

• Use platform data, search behavior and market signals to identify trends, audience needs and opportunities to improve content quality and new-user acquisition.

• Share performance insights and editorial recommendations with cross-functional and global stakeholders.

• Use AI tools to improve research, analysis and workflow efficiency, while independently validating output for accuracy, cultural nuance, quality and brand safety; own final editorial decisions.

• Manage multiple priorities and stay current on Japanese trends, creators, brands, publishers and audience behavior, particularly among Gen Z.

What we’re looking for

• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in editorial, content, curation, publishing, media, marketing, lifestyle, technology or a similarly fast-paced consumer environment.

• Native-level Japanese, plus business-level English for global collaboration.

• Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of the Japanese content market, consumer behavior and local trends.

• A data-informed, customer-centered approach to analyzing content performance and turning insights into action.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI-enabled tools responsibly and critically evaluate the quality and appropriateness of outputs.

• Ability to manage multiple projects independently, communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.

• Experience with CMS tools, Google Workspace and Excel or similar tools.

• Experience with Canva, Figma or Adobe Photoshop; SEO-oriented content development is a plus.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

ポジションについて

Pinterest は、インスピレーションを見つけたり、アイデアをまとめたり、ショッピングを楽しんだりといったポジティブな体験ができるビジュアル探索プラットフォームです。日本担当のエディターとして、質の高いコンテンツキュレーション、日本語コンテンツの編集・執筆、トレンドを軸とした体験づくりを通じて、ユーザーが素晴らしいアイデアを発見できるよう支援するエディターを募集します。

リージョナルおよびグローバルのチーム、日本のコンテンツパートナーシップチーム、プロダクト、セールスと連携し、コンテンツの品質向上、ビジネスニーズの支援、日本の季節性や文化的トレンドをPinterest上で魅力的に表現することに取り組むポジションです。

業務内容

• エンターテインメント、アート、ファッション、ビューティーなどのカテゴリや季節毎のイベントにおいて、日本のユーザーが楽しめる、魅力的で包括的なコンテンツをキュレーションする。

• 日本語の編集枠におけるプログラムのコンテンツの選定、日本語コピーの執筆、ビジュアルアセットの取り扱いから公開、パフォーマンスのレビュー、最適化まですべてを一貫して担当する。

• その他日本語コンテンツに関する各業務、見出し、説明文、記事、ページコピー、メール、翻訳資料などの作成・編集・レビューを行い、ユーザーの目に触れる日本語コンテンツの正確性、自然な表現、ブランドの一貫性、ローカル市場との関連性などを担保する。

• 日本のオーディエンスに特化したWebコンテンツやメールコンテンツを企画・制作する。

• 素晴らしいインスピレーションを得られるユーザー体験を維持しながら、クライアントおよびビジネス上のニーズに応えるコンテンツをキュレーションする。

• プラットフォームデータ、検索行動、市場シグナルを活用し、トレンド、オーディエンスのニーズ、コンテンツ品質向上や新規ユーザー獲得の機会を特定する。

• パフォーマンスに関するインサイトと編集上の提案を、部門横断およびグローバルの関係者と共有する。

• AIツールを活用してリサーチ、分析、業務フローの効率を高めつつ、正確性、文化的ニュアンス、品質、ブランドセーフティの観点から出力内容を独立して検証し、最終的な編集判断に責任を持つ。

• 複数の優先事項を管理しながら、特にZ世代を中心とした日本のクリエイター、ブランド、出版社、オーディエンスの人気コンテンツや行動について、常に最新の知見を持つ。

応募要件

• 編集、コンテンツキュレーション、出版、メディア、マーケティング、ライフスタイル、テクノロジーなど急速に変化するBtoC環境で、3年以上の関連実務経験をお持ちの方。

• ネイティブレベルの日本語力と、グローバルな協業に必要なビジネスレベルの英語力をお持ちの方。

• 優れた編集判断力を持ち、日本のコンテンツ市場、消費者行動、ローカルトレンドに精通している方。

• コンテンツのパフォーマンスをデータに基づき、かつ顧客中心の視点で分析し、得られたインサイトを具体的なアクションへとつなげられる方。

• AIを活用したツールを責任を持って使用し、その出力の品質や妥当性を客観的に評価できることを示した経験をお持ちの方。

• 複数のプロジェクトを自律的に管理し、明確にコミュニケーションを取りながら、職能や地域をまたいで効果的に協働できる方。

• CMSツール、Google Workspace、Excel、または同等のツールの使用経験をお持ちの方。

• Canva、Figma、またはAdobe Photoshopの使用経験をお持ちの方。SEOを意識したコンテンツ開発の経験があれば歓迎します。

• 関連分野の学士号、またはそれに相当する実務経験をお持ちの方。

本ポジションは、転居支援の対象外です。

私たちは、業務内容に応じた最適なコラボレーションの形を大切にしています。そのため、常にオフィスで勤務するわけではありませんが、重要な協働や交流の機会には出社の必要があります。

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems which monitor and ensure the health of our data centers. APAC CDS’ mission is to safely provide our customers with the unmatched reliability, security, and performance that AWS is known for. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines of deployments (of control systems in new data centers), projects (of controls capital improvement works at live data center sites), and service (of control systems at live data center sites), with additional specializations in the disciplines of colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, on-call support (of data center control systems in the Americas (AMER), Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), as part of a global “follow-the-sun” support arrangement), and governance.

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.

To be successful in this team, you will also have:
- Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
- Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
- Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed
Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Technicians support data center building automation systems, including Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). In this role, you will deploy and service these critical systems to ensure optimal data center health and performance.

Your responsibilities include deploying new BMS or EPMS installations during data center construction, upgrading existing Amazon-owned or leased facilities, and implementing Amazon hardware in colocated environments. You'll also provide regional servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally support global operations.

Success in this position requires effective collaboration with multiple Amazon teams, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams. You'll maintain strong vendor relationships that drive successful deployments and operations.

Key job responsibilities
- Deploy and maintain critical systems: Install, upgrade, and troubleshoot BMS and EPMS systems across multiple data centers, ensuring optimal performance through diagnostics, programming, and hardware maintenance.
- Execute technical projects: Manage installations from server provisioning to sensor calibration, supervise contractor work, and ensure all activities meet AWS safety and quality standards.
- Drive operational excellence: Provide commissioning support, conduct root cause analysis, create system documentation, and follow change management processes to maintain system integrity.
- Enable team success: Mentor facilities teams on system operations, collaborate with vendors on Factory Witnessed Tests, and recommend design improvements based on operational insights.
- Deliver reliable service: Respond to emergencies, manage on-call rotations, oversee service agreements, and prioritize work through ticketing systems to maintain data center availability.

You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.

description:
Role Description

As a Customer Success Manager at Dropbox, you will own the post-sale customer strategy and relationship for a portfolio of customers. You will help customers realize measurable value from their investment while driving product adoption, retention, growth, and Net Revenue Retention (NRR).

You will serve as a trusted advisor throughout the customer journey, developing a deep understanding of each customer’s business priorities, technical environment, key stakeholders, and evolving needs. Using customer insights, product adoption signals, stakeholder relationships, and demonstrated business value, you will proactively set priorities, address risks, and identify opportunities to strengthen the customer’s long-term partnership with Dropbox.

You will develop strong technical fluency across the Dropbox platform and engage confidently with IT administrators on product capabilities, security, configuration, integrations, governance, and customer workflows. You will help translate customers’ business and technical requirements into practical use cases, recommendations, and actionable insights for internal teams.

You will partner closely with Sales and cross-functional teams to align on account strategy, navigate technical and commercial complexities, mitigate renewal risks, identify appropriate growth opportunities, and deliver successful customer outcomes.

The successful candidate is results-driven, commercially minded, technically savvy, and customer-focused. They are comfortable navigating complex customer organizations, taking ownership of customer strategy, and influencing both technical and business stakeholders. They bring strong Customer Success experience and a demonstrated ability to drive adoption, manage risk, support successful renewals, and deliver measurable retention and growth outcomes in a B2B SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

• Build strong relationships across customer organizations, serving as a trusted advisor to executive sponsors, business leaders, technical administrators, and other key stakeholders.

• Take ownership of the customer strategy across an assigned portfolio, setting priorities and proactively driving adoption, value realization, stakeholder engagement, retention, and growth.

• Develop strong technical fluency across the Dropbox platform and confidently engage with IT administrators on questions involving product capabilities, security, configuration, integrations, governance, and customer workflows.

• Understand customers’ technical environments and business requirements, helping translate them into practical use cases, recommendations, and actionable feedback for internal teams.

• Lead strategic customer engagements—including product education, use-case development, Success Business Reviews, and value-based renewal discussions—that connect Dropbox capabilities to business outcomes.

• Partner closely with Sales and cross-functional teams to develop account strategies, remove technical and commercial blockers, mitigate renewal risks, and identify appropriate expansion opportunities.

• Use customer feedback, product usage, business context, and stakeholder engagement to prioritize actions, represent the voice of the customer, and contribute to repeatable playbooks and best practices.

Requirements

• 4+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, or a comparable customer-facing role, with experience driving product adoption and business value, managing ongoing customer relationships, and engaging technical stakeholders.

• Business and commercial acumen, with a willingness to develop the skills needed to own assigned customer renewals from 2027, including early renewal planning, commercial discussions, and coordination with Sales and relevant teams to support retention and identify appropriate growth opportunities.

• Technical aptitude and product curiosity, with the ability to learn SaaS products, customer environments, configurations, and workflows. Comfortable engaging with IT administrators, investigating unfamiliar technical questions, and translating product capabilities into practical guidance.

• Ability to build relationships across customer organizations, from technical administrators to executive stakeholders, and manage a portfolio across Japan and Korea. The initial allocation is expected to be approximately 80% Japan and 20% Korea, with flexibility to adjust based on business and customer needs.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use customer insights, usage data, and business context to assess customer health, identify renewal risks, prioritize actions, and recommend practical solutions.

• A proactive self-starter who can ramp up quickly, seek out information, navigate ambiguity, and take ownership of moving customer plans forward without close day-to-day direction. Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate with Sales, Product, Support, Legal, Finance, and other teams.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Fluent spoken and written Japanese, including business communication.

• Business-level Korean and English.

• Ability to engage customers in Japanese and Korean and collaborate with global teams in English.

• Willingness to travel for customer visits in Japan and Korea, and internationally for company offsites and sales kickoffs.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience owning or contributing to customer renewals and retention, with examples of identifying risk, coordinating mitigation plans, demonstrating customer value, and supporting successful renewal outcomes.

• Experience managing strategic customer relationships with multiple stakeholders, complex decision-making processes, and changing business priorities, ideally in Japan or Korea.

• Experience developing and presenting executive business reviews that connect product adoption and customer outcomes to business value and continued investment.

• Experience working with channel partners and navigating partner-led customer relationships.

• Familiarity with CRM, customer-success, health-scoring, or renewal-management systems, and experience using customer usage data or ROI analysis to guide retention and growth opportunities.

• Experience working with multiple SaaS products, and an interest in or familiarity with generative AI and related technologies.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

• Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others .

• Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations .

• Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change .

• Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust .

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

The revenue is the result of trust, not a pitch.

description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
Why Snowflake ?
Snowflakeはデータ革命の最前線に立ち、世界最高のデータとアプリケーションのプラットフォームの構築に取り組んでいます。私たちのミッションはデータサイロ化を解消して、「世界中のデータをモビライズすること」を目指しております。急成長していくデータの未来を私たちと共に築いていきましょう！

Sales team’s Mission ?
営業チームは、様々なインターナルチームやパートナー様と協業しながら、お客様にSnowflakeの価値や魅力を伝えていくと共に、長期的なデータ戦略のアドバイザーとして活動しております。
日本のフィールドセールスチームは顧客サイズや業界ごとにチームを分けて活動しております。ビジネスの拡大に伴い、エンタープライズアカウントを担当頂ける優秀な方を募集しております。一緒に日本市場をSnowflakeで盛り上げていきませんか？

The Impact You will Make

• Snowflake製品のエキスパートになり、ディスカバリーコール、カスタマイズデモ、見込み顧客へのプレゼンテーションを実施する。

• お客様の既存および将来のITロードマップを理解することで、信頼できるアドバイザーとなり、Snowflakeのソリューションを市場内で推進する。

• 見込み客の認定、新規顧客の開拓、継続的な既存顧客の開拓。

• 担当アカウントの販売機会の獲得及び導入、拡大、深耕。

• ターゲットとなる見込み客リストとアカウントプランを用いて、営業戦略を策定し、四半期および年次ベースで、割り当てられたアカウント／テリトリーにおける売上目標達成を達成する。

• CxO、ITエグゼクティブ、LOBエグゼクティブ、および他の主要なステークホルダーと密接な関係を築き、信頼を構築。

• セールス エンジニアリング、プロフェッショナル サービス、マーケティング、パートナーを含むクロスファンクショナル・チームと緊密に連携する。

Who You Are

• エンタープライズ（特に通信業界）またはB2Bソフトウェア営業の経験を持ち、新規開拓と既存深耕の両方に強みがある方。

• 担当テリトリーを主体的にマネジメントし、優先順位をつけながら自律的に動ける方。

• 顧客の課題を捉え、社内の関係者を巻き込みながら案件を前に進められる方。

• アカウントプランニング、パイプラインマネジメント、顧客との関係構築を通じて成果創出できる方。

Japan Benefits（一部）

• Free lunch at office

• 401K（企業型確定拠出年金）

• RSU

• Phone & Gym reimbursement

• 3 day Summer Vacation & 5 day Year-end Holidays

• Paid Parental Leave

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
How do you want to make your impact?

We are hiring an Account Executive, Public Sector to grow Snowflake's footprint across Singapore's public sector. Agencies are scaling AI across government and need data foundations that are secure, well governed and ready for trusted AI. You will help ministries, statutory boards and government technology organisations get there, turning their data and AI priorities into lasting partnerships with Snowflake.

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, PUBLIC SECTOR AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

• Own a named territory of Singapore public sector agencies, building account plans that connect the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to each agency's mission, digital roadmap and AI ambitions.

• Run complex, procurement-driven sales cycles end to end, including tenders, RFPs, quotations and framework or bulk tender arrangements, through to contract and expansion.

• Show how Snowflake Horizon governance, secure data sharing, Cortex AI and Snowpark help agencies unify data across silos and deliver AI use cases that are transparent, auditable and secure.

• Build trusted relationships from programme and data teams through to CIO and CDO level, influencing how agencies approach their data and AI strategy.

• Co-sell with the systems integrators, cloud partners and marketplaces (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) that deliver for the Singapore government, building joint pipeline and account plans.

• Work alongside Solution Engineers, Professional Services and Partner teams to run proofs of value and drive consumption after go-live.

• Forecast with discipline, keep a healthy pipeline and share field insight with APJ leadership, Marketing and Product.

OUR IDEAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, PUBLIC SECTOR WILL HAVE:

• 8+ years of enterprise software, cloud or security sales experience, including meaningful time selling to Singapore public sector organisations.

• A consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

• Hands-on experience with Singapore government procurement and a clear understanding of how agencies evaluate, fund and buy technology.

• A working understanding of public sector cloud, data governance and security frameworks, and how they shape buying decisions.

• Strong working relationships with the systems integrators and partners that serve government.

• Fluency in a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC or Value Selling.

• Clear, credible communication with technical teams and senior non-technical leaders alike.

• A degree or equivalent practical experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

• Experience at a cloud partner or consultancy with a public sector practice, a cybersecurity vendor, or a data, analytics or integration software company.

• Experience selling data platforms, AI or GenAI solutions.

• Familiarity with consumption-based commercial models.

• Exposure to public sector, healthcare or education accounts elsewhere in APJ.

• Curiosity about using AI tools to sharpen account research, planning and forecasting.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?
Singapore's public sector is one of the most digitally ambitious in the world, and data is central to how agencies plan to deliver better services with AI. In this role you will help shape that journey as part of an experienced, collaborative Singapore sales team, with the full depth of Snowflake's product, partner and engineering expertise behind you.
You will build long-term relationships, close meaningful deals and grow your career while seeing the real-world impact of your work on citizens and communities.

description:
Enterprise Account Executive, Korea

[Singapore]

Korea is one of Asana's fastest-growing markets, and we're making a significant investment to accelerate that momentum. We're looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to own our go-to-market strategy for Korea, from defining where and how we win to closing the complex, multi-stakeholder deals that get us there.You'll be the face of Asana in market: building relationships with senior decision-makers in Korea's leading enterprises, drawing on your existing network and deep experience selling in Korea, shaping a channel and partner ecosystem that extends our reach, and positioning our AI work management platform, including AI Teammates, AI Studio, and Dash, as the way modern organizations coordinate human + AI work. You'll partner closely with regional and global colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Partnerships to turn Korea's growth into a durable, scalable business.

This role is based in our Singapore office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about in-office requirements.

What you'll achieve

• Own the Korea go-to-market strategy, including account segmentation, target industries, territory planning, and pipeline generation, and translate it into a clear plan with measurable revenue outcomes.

• Lead complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles from first conversation to close, building consensus across business, IT, procurement, and executive stakeholders.

• Build and scale relationships with channel and distribution partners in Korea, driving co-selling, joint pipeline, and partner-sourced revenue.

• Leverage your relationships across Korea's enterprise and partner community to open doors at target accounts, accelerate early pipeline, and establish Asana as a credible, trusted brand in market.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to C-level and line-of-business leaders, translating Asana's value into business outcomes that resonate in the Korean market.

• Position and sell Asana's AI portfolio, including AI Teammates, AI Studio, and Dash, helping customers identify high-impact use cases for human + AI collaboration.

• Anticipate roadblocks and objections with foresight, crafting win-win solutions that ensure every stakeholder sees the value of Asana.

• Partner seamlessly with SDRs, Field Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive long-term expansion.

• Act as the voice of the Korean market internally, sharing customer and competitive insights with Product, Marketing, and regional leadership to inform localization and strategy.

About you

• Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

• Native or professional fluency in Korean and English, with a deep understanding of how enterprise buying works in the Korean market.

• Direct experience selling into Korean enterprises, with a clear understanding of local buying culture, decision-making hierarchies, procurement processes, and relationship-driven sales cycles.

• An established network in the Korean market, such as senior business and IT decision-makers, channel partners, resellers, and system integrators, that you can credibly leverage to build pipeline.

• [8+] years of experience closing business, including [4+] years selling directly into the Enterprise segment, ideally in SaaS or enterprise software.

• Proven track record of closing large, complex deals with consistently high quota attainment, and a working mastery of a structured methodology such as MEDDPICC or Challenger Sales.

• Experience working and managing channel, reseller, or alliance partnerships, and driving partner-sourced or co-sold revenue.

• Demonstrated ability to build a market or territory strategy, ideally in a high-growth or "first-in-market" environment.

• Experience leading multi-threaded sales processes with thoughtful planning and internal coordination across global and regional teams.

• Expertise in cultivating trust and long-term relationships with diverse stakeholders, with a bias toward action.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we'll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

Compensation for this role follows an On-Target Earnings (OTE) structure, which includes a competitive base salary and performance-based sales incentive pay (based on the terms of the Sales Incentive Plan). These ranges are a guideline; actual base salary and OTE may vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process, and the ranges for this role may be modified.

In addition, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and benefits. We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

• Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits

• Career coaching & support

• Inclusive family building benefits

About us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

Renewals Manager

As a member of our growing Renewals team, you will be instrumental in defining, testing, and scaling a renewals model that balances high-volume scale with top-down positioning across the Japan market. Based in our Tokyo office, you will partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders such as Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Finance, and Legal to ensure Asana customers are set up for continued success from their Asana investment. Your primary focus will be managing customer renewals to maximize retention, identify expansion opportunities, and drive a high degree of customer satisfaction. You will play a critical role in protecting and growing Asana's customer base by proactively managing renewal risk, demonstrating customer value, and driving timely contract execution.

This role is based in our Tokyo office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Thursday and one additional day of choice, which may be determined by your team. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on the two other weekdays they are not in office. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

• Own, drive, and lead the renewals process for customers in the Japan market, in collaboration with the account team, to preserve and improve customer contracts and relationships.

• Actively engage with key decision-makers to understand customer requirements, demonstrate the value of Asana, and uncover roadblocks to ensure on-time renewals.

• Negotiate and execute renewal contracts that align with customer goals in partnership with Finance and Legal.

• Engage with at-risk customers and develop prescriptive strategies to mitigate potential churn and improve retention.

• Communicate renewal risk clearly, take the lead in developing resolution strategies, and escalate wherever appropriate.

• Discover and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities during the renewal process to maximize customer growth.

• Maintain and report an accurate 90–120-day rolling forecast of renewals and proactively manage risks and opportunities within the forecast.

• Track and contribute to key business outcomes, including Renewal Rate, Net Retention Rate (NRR), renewal attainment, and expansion.

• Maintain accurate customer and renewal information in Salesforce and other relevant systems.

• Assist with enhancing and improving systems, tools, and processes to increase team efficiency and scalability.

About you

• Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

• Business-level fluency in Japanese and English.

• 2–5 years of experience in customer-facing SaaS roles, such as software/subscription renewals, account management, sales, customer success, or Deal Desk, with experience managing commercial conversations and customer relationships.

• Experience managing commercial negotiations, discovery, value selling, and closing, with a track record of achieving business or revenue targets.

• Comfortable working with technology and business systems such as Salesforce, Asana, and other SaaS tools, with the ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with clear written and verbal communication and the ability to manage a book of business effectively.

• Strong collaborative spirit when partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and other cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals.

• Ability to drive momentum and on-time renewals by connecting dots across large organizations, influencing stakeholders, and fostering collaboration.

• Ability to understand customers’ business challenges and translate those needs into relevant, value-based solutions and recommendations.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing multiple customer priorities, managing renewal risk, and maintaining high customer satisfaction.

テクニカルアカウントマネージャー (Technical Account Manager)

Asanaのテクニカルアカウントマネジャー（Technical Account Manager: TAM）は、顧客が日々の業務において「明瞭さ（Clarity）」を見出し、Asanaを活用して成果を上げることを支援します。TAMはAsanaのエキスパートであり、顧客の成功に情熱を注ぐ生産性のプロフェッショナルです。顧客からの質問、機能リクエスト、インシデント報告に対応し、中長期的な視点でのAsana活用のためのベストプラクティスを提供します。また、Asana社内では顧客の声を製品開発に反映させるための代弁者となり、製品開発チームと対話します。TAMの成功指標は「顧客の成功」であり、顧客への深い共感（Empathy）を通じてそれを実現します。

AsanaのTAMとして、あなたは大規模かつ複雑な要件を持つエンタープライズ顧客に対し、戦略的な技術アドバイザーとしてサポートを提供します。顧客のステークホルダーと深く連携し、技術的なイネーブルメント（定着化）を推進し、継続的な利用を確実にするとともに、Asanaの機能を顧客の長期的目標に合致させます。この役割は、強力な技術的適性、卓越した顧客への共感力、そして社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込む影響力が求められる、クロスファンクショナルなポジションです。

【勤務地・働き方】

このポジションはAsana Japanの技術本部長にレポートします。

私たちは、居住地に関わらず最適な人材をお迎えしたいと考えています。そのため、ご本人の状況に合わせて以下のいずれかの働き方を用意しています。

•
関東圏にお住まいの方： 東京オフィスを拠点とした、オフィス中心のハイブリッドスケジュール（原則 月・火・木曜出社）となります。

•
関東圏以外にお住まいの方（日本国内）： リモートワークでの勤務が可能です。ただし、チームビルディングや重要会議のため、 月1〜2回程度、東京オフィスへの出社をお願いしています （詳細は面接時にご案内します）。

なお、重要な会議やオンサイト支援など、状況に応じて顧客先への訪問や国内出張が発生する場合があります。

【主な業務内容】

•
顧客への技術的アドバイザリーとベストプラクティスの提供

•
エンタープライズ顧客の導入後における「技術的な成功（Technical Success）」に責任を持ち、Asana活用拡大の主要な技術アドバイザーおよびパートナーとして機能する。

•
Asana API、サードパーティサービスとの連携、認証（SAML/SCIM）、クラウドセキュリティおよび管理者ガバナンスに関するベストプラクティスを、顧客の環境や目標に合わせて設計・提案する。

•
顧客のシステムアーキテクチャ、ビジネス上の優先順位、技術構成に関する深い知識を維持し、ニーズを先読みした提案を行う。

•
顧客の健全性維持とリスク管理

•
顧客との定期的なコミュニケーションや技術レビューを通じて顧客におけるAsana利活用にプロアクティブに関与し、製品価値の定着と継続的な利用を促進する。

•
セールス、カスタマーサクセスマネージャ（CSM）と共同で利用パターンやエンゲージメント傾向からヘルススコアを監視し、リスクの早期発見や、利用拡大・再エンゲージメントの機会を特定する。

•
各種エスカレーション、移行プロジェクト、重大インシデント対応を社内各部門と連携して主導し、予防・早期検知・透明性のあるコミュニケーションを通じてリスクを最小化する。

•
社内連携と製品へのフィードバック

•
社内の技術ナレッジの標準化を推進し、再現性のあるベストプラクティスを策定・共有することで、チーム全体の提案力向上に貢献する。

•
セールス、サポート、プロダクト、エンジニアリングチームと緊密に連携し、統一された顧客体験を提供する。

•
顧客の声を代弁し、実際のユースケースや課題に基づいたフィードバックを行うことで、製品ロードマップへ影響を与える。

【応募資格】

•
経験とドメイン知識

•
SaaS業界における、顧客対面型の技術的役割（TAM、ソリューションエンジニア、導入コンサルタントなど）での5年以上の経験。

•
ワークフロー、自動化、ビジネスプロセス管理（BPM）など、業務プロセスに関わるSaaS・ソフトウェアを直接取り扱った経験。

•
※インフラやセキュリティ領域専業ではなく、ビジネスロジックやアプリケーション層の課題解決に関わった経験を重視します。

•
大規模なエンタープライズ顧客の複雑なステークホルダー管理を行い、プロジェクトを成功に導いた実績。

•
技術的専門性

•
API、システム連携、認証プロトコル（SAML, SCIM）、および技術アーキテクチャについて、顧客と自信を持って議論できる技術的知見。

•
SaaSインフラ、セキュリティ基準、エンタープライズIT環境に関する広範な理解。

•
顧客の技術的な課題や質問を素早く理解し、複雑な概念を噛み砕いて解決策を提示する能力。

•
コミュニケーションと言語能力

•
日本語によるネイティブレベルのコミュニケーション能力（口頭および記述）。

•
英語力は必須ではありませんが、英語の読み書きに抵抗がないこと（会社が用意するAIツールを使用しての対応でも可）

•
優れたドキュメンテーション能力、ファシリテーション能力、プレゼンテーション能力。

•
技術的な内容を、現場の運用担当者から経営層（非技術者）まで、相手に合わせて分かりやすく伝える能力。

•
マインドセットと姿勢

•
標準化へのリーダーシップ： 属人化を防ぎ、チーム全体の成果を最大化するために、ナレッジの共有やベストプラクティスの標準化（Playbook作成など）を率先して推進できること。

•
プロセス主導型： すべての顧客に標準化された極めてポジティブな体験を提供するためのプロセスを作成、実装、改善することへの強い意欲。

•
学習意欲： 新しい製品機能や技術トラブルシューティング、AIツールなどの新技術を自ら学び、業務の効率化や顧客への価値提供に活かす姿勢。

•
プロアクティブな行動とコミュニケーション： 常に先回りして行動を起こし、かつ透明性の高い発信を行うことで、周囲からの信頼を確実に獲得できること。

About the Role
Miro is looking for an exceptional General Manager to lead our Japan business. Japan is one of Miro's fastest-growing markets, and that growth is about to accelerate: we've made a significant recent investment in a Japan Data Center, removing a long-standing barrier for enterprise customers and opening the door to a new tier of commercial ambition.

This is a business catalyst role. We need a senior executive who can drive an ambitious commercial agenda while building a team and culture strong enough to carry it, for our people and for the customers we serve. This person earns trust quickly, leads with transparency, and represents Japan credibly inside a global organization while being the external face of Miro Japan.

You'll lead a team that understands customers' most strategic challenges, knows exactly who the key stakeholders are, and helps those customers transform their business with Miro, all while building a Tokyo hub that people are proud to belong to.
What you’ll do
Commercial Leadership
● Set the strategy for Japan's High Touch Sales organization and own its execution
with clear accountability.
● Own an ambitious, sustainable growth target for the region.
● Win new logos, particularly lighthouse accounts, and drive wall-to-wall expansion
across the existing customer base.
● Build effective co-sell motions with partners: new logo acquisition into TSE-listed
parent companies, and expansion into their subsidiaries.
● Act as a trusted Miro expert for enterprise customers, credible with practitioners
and executives alike.

People & Culture Leadership
● Build a Tokyo hub culture grounded in transparency, strong team dynamics,
accountability, and psychological safety.
● Lead and develop a multi-layered team, visibly investing in coaching and growth.
● Act as a genuine bridge between Japan and JAPAC/global leadership, translating
strategy and context in both directions.
● Be an active, engaged member of the regional senior leadership team as well as
the cross functional global leadership team.
● Hold the standard we hold every leader to: how you lead people matters as much
as the results you deliver.
What you’ll need
Experience & Track Record
● 15+ years of experience across direct and partner-led sales.
● A proven track record in direct SaaS sales within enterprise segments.
● A demonstrable partner sales track record, including co-sell motions for new logo
acquisition and subsidiary expansion into TSE-listed groups.
● Experience leading through a layer of management, leading people managers
rather than only individual contributors, across a growing team of 20+.
● Country Manager or GM experience in a global company is a strong plus, as is a
background in SaaS, PLG, or collaboration software.

Leadership & Culture
● A track record of building trust with your team, stakeholders, peers, and
customers.
● Demonstrated ability to build or turn around team culture, backed by concrete
examples of impact.
● Strong experience operating in a global, matrixed organization and working well
amid ambiguity.
● A consistent, accountable, and transparent leadership style.
● A genuine investment in developing talent, evidenced by people on your team
who grew and excelled under your leadership.
What's in it for you
We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. The Role

As a Sales Manager, you'll lead a team of Account Executives and own one of our most critical growth levers in-market: developing talent that consistently outperforms while helping Japanese sellers succeed. This role is about building a high-performance sales organization where every hire raises the bar, every coaching conversation sharpens execution, and every decision is grounded in data — all within the realities of the Japanese market.

You'll operate at the intersection of local and global. You'll adapt our global playbooks to how deals are actually won in Japan — where trust is earned over time, decisions are made by consensus, and relationships matter as much as the commercial case. You'll bring the rigor, along with the energy.

You'll be expected to coach in the work, not after it. You'll diagnose pipeline health before it becomes a forecasting problem, develop future leaders before promotions become necessary, and create an operating rhythm that enables predictable, repeatable growth in a market with long, relationship-driven sales cycles.

You'll partner cross-functionally — locally and with regional/global HQ — to improve how we sell in Japan, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the talent bar. Success is measured not only by quota attainment, but by the strength of your team, the quality of your pipeline, and the leaders you develop.

Build a High-Performance Team

• Hire bilingual Account Executives who can run complex, multi-stakeholder deals in-market, and raise the bar with every addition to your team — competing effectively for scarce sales talent in Tokyo.

• Develop a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous learning and high standards, balanced with the trust and cohesion that Japanese teams are built on.

• Identify future top performers early and create development plans that accelerate their growth.

• Ramp and retain talent in a competitive local labour market where strong bilingual sellers have options.

Co-Sell on Complex Deals

• Sell alongside your team in discovery, business case development and negotiation on your most important pursuits.

• Engage senior stakeholders directly — including owners, operations and finance — and help your team multi-thread and navigate consensus-driven, bottom-up decision-making rather than selling to a single champion.

• Bring commercial judgment to pricing, deal structure and competitive displacement against local players.

• Advance the deal while leaving the AE more capable of running the next one without you.

Coach Through Data & Business Intelligence

• Lead your business through rigorous pipeline inspection, forecasting and performance diagnostics.

• Use leading indicators to identify performance gaps early and coach reps toward sustainable improvement.

• Turn data into action by identifying trends, diagnosing root causes and driving measurable improvements across your team.

• Forecast accurately on long-cycle deals, which depends on stage integrity rather than optimism — and account for local cycle length and relationship-building phases.

Drive Operational Excellence

• Establish predictable operating rhythms around forecasting, pipeline management and business reviews.

• Build disciplined execution that creates consistent, repeatable revenue outcomes.

• Continuously improve how your team sells by refining processes, simplifying execution and eliminating friction.

• Build repeatable plays for how this segment is won in Japan — from acquisition through implementation and expansion.

Lead Through Influence

• Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Enablement, Operations, Partnerships and Product — locally and at regional/global HQ — to improve the customer journey and strengthen commercial execution.

• Act as a two-way bridge: bring global best practice into Japan, and bring the Japanese customer voice and field intelligence back to shape strategy and influence product evolution.

• Use customer insights and local market knowledge to localise strategy for Japan's cashless transition (the national push toward ~65% cashless by 2030) and the merchant landscape.

• Lead through change by helping your team adapt quickly while maintaining high performance.

You Have

• 6+ years experience as a sales manager, including time leading teams selling into complex, multi-stakeholder accounts with cycles measured in months.

• Native or business-level fluency in Japanese, plus professional business-level English — able to lead in-market in Japanese and collaborate effectively with regional/global stakeholders in English.

• Deep knowledge of the Japanese market — including the Seller landscape, buying behavior, business etiquette, and consensus-based decision-making — and ideally experience in payments, fintech, SaaS or a related B2B category.

• An understanding of the Japanese cashless/payments environment and competitive dynamics (e.g. QR-code wallets, card networks and bank-led offerings), and how these shape merchant decisions.

• Experience hiring, ramping and retaining Account Executives who can run considered, competitive deals — ideally within the Japanese talent market.

• Experience developing already strong performers into people who win larger and more complex deals.

• Proven track record in collaborating across different teams, including across a local–global structure, with the ability to inspire change.

• Leadership and coaching experience and a desire to help others be their best.

• Expertise in creating structure around sales metrics and managing yourself and others to achieve these metrics, including forecast accuracy on long-cycle deals.

• An understanding of how to refine decision-making and consider the downstream and upstream effects of potential decisions.

• Experience localising global sales playbooks and enablement for the Japanese market.
