description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

As a Vanta Customer Success Manager, you will play a pivotal role in guiding customers through their security and compliance journeys with Vanta's specialized solutions. By combining your customer-centric approach with expertise in Vanta's products and security best practices, you will contribute to the overall success and satisfaction of Vanta's customers in achieving robust security and compliance outcomes through retention of customers and health of the book of business.

Vanta’s success over the last year was exponential and we are now working to solve the problem of how to provide world-class customer experience to as many security-minded software companies as possible. As a Vanta Customer Success Manager, you will be the voice of Vanta, responsible for helping keep our customers moving toward their goals and ultimately successful and happy.

This role is hybrid in our Tokyo office 3 days per week and is not eligible for remote work.

What you’ll do as a Customer Success Manager at Vanta:

• Guide our customers in our Growth segment through onboarding, implementation, product adoption, and value-driven success.

• Work with Vanta customers across industries, functions, and stages of their customer journey in a strategic manner.

• Proactively partner with Account Managers by flagging at-risk accounts, providing customer insights, and highlighting expansion opportunities

• Empower customers to become self-sufficient Vanta champions, solving their immediate needs while focusing on their long-term success, value realization, and retention.

• Monitor and prioritize your book of business based on key indicators of customer health via Catalyst, our CS platform.

• Serve as the point of contact for your customers and drive them to specific business outcomes on their timelines.

• Become a product expert on Vanta and how our platform can be used to improve security posture through our compliance offerings (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, USDP and Custom Frameworks), Trust Reports, and Risk Management solution.

• Provide insightful technical answers and recommend the most efficient way for customers to achieve compliance using our platform while leveraging cross-functional resources and specialized teams.

• Partner with your CS team to co-create plays to drive engagement across the Vanta customer base with impactful adoption and retention results.

• Liaise with Support to help quarterback resolutions for customer issues

• Serve as the voice of your customers cross-functionally, providing feedback to the Product team and broader business

How to be successful in this role:

• Have 3+ years of experience in Customer Success at a SaaS company.

• Background in running a book of business of ~150-170 accounts.

• Background in running a strategic book of business

• Willingness to collaborate with others and drive mutually beneficial outcomes

• Self-motivated and curious: Bias for action and committed to iterating when necessary

• Work effectively in a highly ambiguous, ever-changing environment

• Possess clear and thoughtful communication skills, with strong critical thinking ability

• Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention.

• Experience with hitting retention targets and creating happy, healthy customers

• Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up

• Fluent in Japanese and English , with strong verbal and written communication skills in both

• Use AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar

• Experience working in the security or compliance industry is a bonus

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

• Industry-competitive salary and equity

• Healthcare stipend towards health insurance for you and your dependents

• 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

• Health & wellness stipend

• Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

• Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

• 15 days of Annual Leave per year

• 9 company-paid holidays

• Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

• Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

We’re looking for a driven, consultative Enterprise Account Executive to lead our growth efforts in the ASEAN region. You’ll be responsible for driving new business and expanding existing relationships with enterprise clients across key verticals.

The ideal candidate has at least 8 years of SaaS selling experience within CRM, Marketing Automation, CDP, Analytics, or Content Marketing Solutions. You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, you have a knack for simply selling complex tech solutions, and you excel in fast-paced environments.

• Own the full sales cycle , from prospecting and qualification through to negotiation and close — managing multiple complex deals with enterprise clients (deal sizes ranging from $100K to $1M+).

• Engage C-suite and senior decision-makers across Marketing, Product and IT to define and deliver transformative customer engagement solutions.

• Drive value-based selling using MEDDPICC, clearly articulating Braze’s business impact and ROI.

• Prospect strategically using market research, networking, and partnerships to identify and create new opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Business Development, Marketing, Solutions Consultants, Customer Success, and Services to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

• Grow existing accounts through expansion and upsell opportunities that align with customer goals.

• Champion innovation , leveraging AI tools and modern productivity platforms to maximize efficiency and performance.

WHO YOU ARE

• Experienced: 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience in CRM, Marketing Automation, CDP, Analytics, or related MarTech solutions.

• Proven Performer: Consistent track record of exceeding quota in complex enterprise deal cycles.

• Executive Communicator: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills — confident in leading conversations with C-level executives.

• Collaborative: Skilled in navigating internal teams and partner ecosystems to build strong relationships across various departments and deliver strong business outcomes.

• Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with Salesforce CRM and modern sales productivity tools, including AI-driven applications.

• Entrepreneurial: Resourceful, adaptable, and motivated to build and grow the Braze community in the market.

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here . More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

• Competitive compensation that may include equity

• Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans

• Flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave

• Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend

• A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

• Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching

• Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze

• Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

• To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.

• To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a retroactive manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com .

Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page .

Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144)

Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review.

To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. Please submit any other request to our Talent Acquisition team at talentdata.privacy@braze.com promptly after applying. Summaries of the most recent bias audit results for such tools are available here .

Please see our Candidate Privacy Policy for more information on how Braze processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights.

description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

About the Pipeline Generation Team

The Pipeline Generation team builds the system that turns market signal into qualified pipeline for the Account Executive team across APAC. This is a founding, AI-first function: a small group of operators who design and run an automated prospecting motion instead of a manual outbound desk. What this team proves in Singapore becomes the playbook the wider region runs.

About the Role

The Business Development Associate runs Mixpanel's AI-driven prospecting system to deliver qualified, Account-Executive-accepted pipeline across APAC. You will operate the outbound engine day-to-day: building target lists, running campaigns, supervising AI agents that research prospects and draft first-touch outreach, and applying a critical eye to ensure only genuinely qualified opportunities reach an Account Executive. You will work inside targeting logic and quality bars set with the team, sharpen them as you learn what converts, and help document what works. Success is qualified pipeline and system leverage, measured on outcomes rather than activity.

Responsibilities

• Run outbound and prospecting campaigns that produce qualified opportunities for the Account Executive team, owning the flow from signal to accepted handoff.

• Build target lists and enrichment inputs against a defined ideal customer profile, and keep data clean so leads move end to end with minimal manual handling.

• Deploy and supervise AI agents for prospect research, list building, personalization, and first-touch drafting, keeping a human check on quality before anything ships.

• Qualify opportunities against the agreed bar with Account Executive input, so accepted opportunities convert and Account Executive time is protected from low-fit leads.

• Prioritize high-intent accounts using Mixpanel's own product-usage and self-serve signals.

• Analyze metrics to see what is working, and adjust targeting, messaging, and channel mix.

• Document what works and feed it into shared playbooks and templates.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

• A hunter's instinct: proactively finds new pipeline and starts cold conversations, moving outreach forward with persistence rather than waiting on inbound.

Why This Role Is Different — AI Solutions
This is not a standard payments sales role. Airwallex has built AgentOS — a production-grade toolkit that lets AI agents work directly with a company's Airwallex account, so founders and finance teams can run cross-border finance operations in plain English instead of clicking through a dashboard. We're one of the first cross-border platforms in the world to ship this, and Singapore is one of the first markets where we're taking it to founders.
As the AI Solutions AE for Singapore startups, you'll be on the front line of that motion. You won't just sell accounts and FX — you'll help AI-native and AI-curious founders reimagine how their finance function runs: multi-currency cash visibility, supplier onboarding, corporate cards and spend, and billing, increasingly driven by agentic workflows. You'll be expected to become genuinely fluent in our AI finance story, translate an early and fast-moving capability into concrete value for each company, and help us build some of our first AgentOS customer stories. Comfort with ambiguity and a real interest in where AI is taking finance are essential — this is beta-stage, frontier work.

What You'll Do
As an Account Executive on the Startups team, you will own the full sales cycle — from sourcing and prospecting through to close, onboarding, and ongoing account growth. You will work closely with venture capital partners, ecosystem organisations, and founders directly to build pipeline, convert high-value startup customers, and grow their usage of the Airwallex platform — including our AI finance and AgentOS capabilities — over time.
This is a role for someone passionate about the startup world, energised by founder conversations, excited by AI, and looking to be known in the ecosystem as a trusted partner who helps startups get their financial plumbing right and points them toward what's next.

Responsibilities

Full-Cycle Sales & Consultative Selling

• Own the end-to-end sales process for startup prospects — from initial outreach and discovery through to commercial negotiation, onboarding, and go-live.

• Lead consultative, needs-based conversations with founders, finance managers, and CFOs to uncover cross-border pain points and map Airwallex solutions to their specific stage, vertical, and expansion plans.

• Develop a strong command of our product and common startup financial operations challenges — including multi-currency treasury, FX cost management, corporate card and spend management, entity setup across jurisdictions, and global payouts — and position Airwallex as the platform that consolidates and simplifies these workflows.

• Build and present tailored business cases that go beyond feature comparison, helping prospects understand the downstream implications of their current setup and the strategic value of upgrading their financial infrastructure early.

AI Finance & AgentOS Solutioning

• Develop deep, credible fluency in Airwallex's AI finance offering and keep pace as the product rapidly evolves.

• Identify which prospects and existing customers are the best fit for agentic finance workflows, and design concrete, company-specific use cases that map AgentOS skills to real pains.

• Run discovery and demos that bring the workflow shift to life, while framing trust and safety honestly for non-technical founders (the agent prepares and drafts; humans approve anything that moves money).

• Help seed and document our first AgentOS customer stories in Singapore, and feed learnings back to product and the broader Startups team to sharpen the motion.

Backbook Ownership & Account Growth

• Retain and grow a named portfolio of existing startup customers, ensuring they remain active, satisfied, and expanding their usage of the platform.

• Monitor customer activity levels, flag churn risks early, and proactively identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities — particularly around product adoption (e.g. spend management, billing/PA, yield, and AI finance workflows).

• Serve as the primary relationship holder for your portfolio, maintaining regular touchpoints with founders and finance teams and acting as their internal advocate.

• Identify and action graduation opportunities — surfacing high-growth accounts to enterprise or theme teams when deal complexity or GP potential warrants a co-sell or handover.

• Work closely with our Venture Partnerships function to convert VC relationships into qualified, warm introductions to portfolio companies.

• Develop familiarity with the portfolio companies of our priority VC partners and maintain a clear view of which companies represent the strongest product-market fit for Airwallex.

• Contribute insights back to the Venture Partnerships team on what's resonating with portfolio companies, what objections arise, and where we can sharpen our value proposition to VCs.

• Actively participate in startup community events, founder networking sessions, VC-hosted gatherings, and ecosystem activations.

• Represent Airwallex at external events with credibility and enthusiasm, engaging founders in genuine conversation and building relationships that extend beyond a single transaction.

• Comfort with cross-border financial operations concepts.

description:
About the position

We’re looking for an experienced OTC Derivatives Reporting Specialist to help our Legal and Compliance team build and operate reliable swap reporting across APAC, with a particular focus on Singapore and Hong Kong.

You’ll work closely with our internal Trading, Operations and Legal and Compliance teams, and our software engineers, to turn reporting requirements into working systems. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how swaps are traded, documented, booked and managed throughout their lifecycle, and who enjoys working through the details of how those transactions should be reported.

Additional responsibilities of this role will include:

• Resolving interpretation questions with your Legal and Compliance colleagues, then translating requirements into clear, field-level mappings–from internal bookings and lifecycle events to reporting schemas

• Working with software engineers to specify source data, transformation logic, and exception handling, and testing implementations to ensure reports are complete and accurate

• Understanding where internal booking representations differ from the transactions and events that need to be reported, and identifying reporting challenges caused by booking conventions, missing data or product complexity

• Investigating rejected submissions, reconciliation breaks, and incorrect or missing reports; tracing issues to their root causes; and helping implement corrections and controls to prevent recurrence

• Engaging early on new products and trading flows to explain reporting requirements and to find practical ways to support trading while meeting regulatory obligations

• Keeping pace with regulatory and technical changes, maintaining clear documentation, and working with reporting providers and counterparties to resolve issues

About you

• Have 5+ years experience with both Singapore’s MAS and Hong Kong’s OTC derivatives reporting regimes, including implementing reporting systems or taking meaningful responsibility for their day-to-day operation

• Understand swap economics and trade lifecycles, including amendments, resets, novations, terminations, valuations, and collateral-related data

• Familiar with ISDA documentation and definitions, including how confirmations and relevant agreement terms relate to trade economics and reporting

• Comfortable inspecting trade-level data and reporting messages, querying datasets and discussing data models with software engineers; SQL skills are valuable, and scripting experience is a plus

• Can explain a reporting problem you’ve worked through in detail, connecting the trade economics and internal booking to the applicable requirement, field mapping, implementation, and checks you used to establish that the reporting was correct

• Can communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical colleagues, exercise sound judgement and take ownership of detailed problems through to resolution

• Experience with other APAC reporting regimes is a plus, but we’re primarily looking for depth in both Singapore and Hong Kong

• Fluent in English

description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a PostTrade Strategy Specialist to join our PostTrade team in Singapore. Encompassing the firm’s Global Funding & Clearing, Middle Office, and Product Control teams, the PostTrade team ensures the smooth daily operation of our global PostTrade platform and helps to drive strategic optimization of our existing trading and enable new, complex trading initiatives.

In this role, you will lead initiatives to improve our current processes while designing and building new solutions to seamlessly trade on an even wider range of asset classes, exchanges, and products. You will work closely with the PostTrade Tech team to define the requirements and architect the infrastructure required to support these new trading opportunities and strategically optimize our existing setup.

Being a member of the PostTrade team at HRT means working on a tight-knit, highly productive team. The ideal candidate is a strong cross-functional communicator with a can-do attitude and expertise in financial instruments who loves utilizing technology and automation tools to own and execute a wide scope of operational projects.

Responsibilities

• Evaluate and deploy advanced post-trade technologies and risk controls

• Design and develop scalable onboarding processes to reduce go-to-market time for new initiatives globally

• Drive collaboration with internal stakeholders to devise and implement new global strategic optimizations

• Evaluate existing processes, relationships, and systems to proactively identify opportunities for strategic improvement, automation, and growth within HRT’s PostTrade functions

• Serve as the subject matter expert and collaborate with development teams to optimize PostTrade’s cataloging and ingestion of external data to facilitate consolidated and standardized sources for uses in reconciliation, reporting, and analytics

Qualifications

• Expert-level knowledge of the trade lifecycle, financial instruments, and the global trading landscape

• 5+ years in a senior, hands-on operational role supporting trading; the ideal candidate will have a mix of buy-side and sell-side experience

• Deep, global understanding of the strategic role that prime brokers play at a multi-strategy trading firm

• Ability to build new and strengthen existing relationships with prime brokers to facilitate platform needs and act in the best interests of HRT

• Ability to navigate and negotiate with technical and nontechnical stakeholders on complex problems, from internal developers building trading systems to external vendors on the sell-side

• Excellent cross-functional communication skills

• Proven ability to foster a collaborative work environment with a sense of ownership and a “no task too small” attitude

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.

Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.

Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job

As an Enterprise Account Executive, based in Singapore, you'll join our established APJ sales team to continue accelerating growth in the India & SEA region. You'll drive new business sales and collaborate with our APAC teams including our Sales Development Representatives, Solutions Engineers, Customer Success Managers, Partners and Marketing.

What you'll do:

• Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing and drive new business sales.

• Establish and navigate relationships with senior executives and decision-makers

• Prospect into Ecommerce, Marketing, Product, Analytics and Tech teams.

• Cultivate new relationships for Contentsquare through your own outbound efforts and with the help of our SDR team

• Collaborate with our Singapore and APJ teams across Sales Development, Solutions Consulting, Marketing, Customer Success Managers, Leadership, etc. to build strategic adoption plans for customers

What you'll need to succeed:

• Extensive experience as a sales hunter (new logo / new revenue acquisition) with relevant enterprise SaaS experience

• Possess aptitude to learn quickly and establish credibility.

• High EQ and self-aware

• Strong desire to be successful; driven, competitive, passionate.

• Ability to articulate the business value of complex technology

• The ability to develop senior level relationships quickly and effectively

• Experience presenting to senior managers and the C-suite at leading companies

What makes you stand out:

• Sales methodology training; MEDDICC, SPIN, Challenger, Command of the Message

• Passionate about a career in martech & analytics

Why you should join Contentsquare

We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.

Here are a few we want to highlight:

- Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year

- Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies

- Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)

- Lifestyle allowance

- A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work

- Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success

- We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts

- And more benefits tailored to each country

Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here .

Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.

description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.
We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.
Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.
Are you ready to join us?
The Product Team organisation at Back Market, is a distributed team in New York, Europe and Tokyo as well as fully remote, ensuring a richly diverse mindset in our approach and deliverables and a passion to build interfaces with the user as our focus.
We zoom out to see the bigger picture, but also understand the devil is in the details. We are responsible for the user experience on Back Market, whether that be our customers or professional refurbishers, and through designing, prototyping, testing, and iterating, we evolve it in collaboration with different (and extraordinary) people.
We do this because we want to make the world a better place. Our credentials speak for themselves; we’re certified BCorp, and we’ve prevented 1 million tons of carbon emissions from entering the atmosphere already. A lot of people talk about tech circularity - we’re making it real. <3

About the Job:

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join us to make Back Market the most successful destination for buying refurbished in Japan.
As a Senior minded PM, you’ll autonomously own the product vision and strategy for our Japan Market, meaning creating new features and innovative journeys for Japanese citizens, taking into consideration their specific needs, which might vary from EU or US.
You’ll collaborate with our Engineers, Product Designers, User Researchers, and Product Managers in other squads/regions to bring a plethora of concepts and product evolution. You’ll work on a daily basis with developers to validate the technical feasibility of your proposals and to ensure the fulfillment of your craft, and you’ll also be connected with other Back Markets functions (Marketing, Brand, Business, Customer Care, Supply etc.) to help articulate the needs and expectations of the customer and the business.

You will also manage the relationships with business stakeholders, other product managers, and localization partners to deliver impactful results.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

• You create your squad’s vision , and you are responsible for defining the Northstar metrics and KPIs: it drives the team toward concrete goals and impacts.

• You will work closely with the Japan General Manager and Marketing Director to align on the short and long term priorities: you liaise with them to ensure your product fits perfectly into the Back Market experience.

• You are the Engineering Manager’s daily partner : you adjust priorities if needed, and your communication skills and ability to collaborate with engineers ensure our quality standards and commitments are met.

• The product management skills have no secret for you, you master the discovery steps (link with research, design, data), as well as delivery (testing and QA are part of the game!).

• You communicate clearly and regularly on the risks and impacts of your roadmap and features: you know how to anticipate problems and dependency to ensure a smooth delivery.

• Data is your best friend : data drives your decisions and vision… you never work without data!

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

• You have a strong Product Manager experience (minimum 5-7 years) and you are comfortable working with Product Designers, UX researchers, as well as Engineering teams.

• You have product management experience in an agile environment (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) and you are able to shape product discovery and delivery according to agile principles.

• You have a good understanding of the Japanese market and, more specifically, ecommerce behaviours and trends in Japan : PayPay or Rakuten do not have any secrets for you.

• You are a brilliant communicator; your peers define you as a facilitator and leader. Your interpersonal skills will be crucial for that role to build strong relationships with stakeholders and top management.

• You have a problem-solver attitude, comfortable navigating ambiguous situations using data and putting the user at the center of all your thoughts.

• Your native language is Japanese and you are comfortable communicating professionally in English, as we are an international team.

• You have an analytical mind , and even better, an analytics background. Monitoring our key performance indicators / being able to define targeted increments is part of your daily life. Data is your secret weapon to better frame and measure the quality of our features and increments.

• You use common sense. You have a strategic but simple vision of your product. For you, the product must amplify the value of business expectations .

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼
At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).
No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:
- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.
- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.
- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.
At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.
We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.
If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

description:
foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Quick commerce sits at the heart of our organisation's strategy. This role supports the maths behind that growth. You will build the models that turn a wide set of initiatives & drivers - basket size, order frequency, cost per order, assortment mix, store throughput, promotional spend - into one cohesive narrative.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Own the numbers end to end. Build and maintain projections, unit economics, ROI cases and scenario plans for new initiatives, store formats and commercial levers.

• Break problems into levers and reconnect them. Size each driver individually, then wire them into a single output, so a change in any input flows through to contribution, margin or growth without manual rework.

• Pressure-test your own assumptions. Ground the model in real data, and be candid about which inputs are solid and which are educated guesses.

• Build workflows at scale. Deep Excel plus AI tooling - LLM-based automation, scripting, low-code - so recurring analysis runs itself.

• Turn output into a decision. Say what we should do, what it costs, what it returns, and what would have to be true for it to fail.

• Support budget planning and resource allocation discussions through analysis and recommendations to help meet growth and profitability targets

• Drive coordination , analysis, progress tracking, and follow-up for the company’s OKR process

• Actively engage and participate in key regular touchpoints: performance updates, financial reviews, budgeting & strategy, etc.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

• 3–6 years in strategy, consulting, investment banking or private equity, commercial finance, or a modelling-heavy role in a high-growth operating business.

• Deep Excel knowledge - ability to build financial models & scenarios with logical assumptions.

• Hands-on use of AI tools to automate analytical work. SQL and/or Python is a strong plus.

• Structured problem solving: you can take a vague question and reach a defensible answer.

• The judgement to know when an estimate is good enough to decide on, and when it is not.

• Comfortable reading and interpreting financial documents, including country P&Ls and investment proposals, and deriving actions from them.

HOW WE WORK

• Quick commerce is at the heart of our strategy. It is one of the fastest-growing parts of our business, which brings a distinct set of problems - and the chance to shape answers that do not exist yet.

• Roll your sleeves up. This is a hands-on role. You will be in the detail as often as you are in the strategy.

• Ship fast. We would rather deliver a solid solution this month and improve it in the open than a perfect one next quarter.

• Ambiguity is the starting point. Problem statements arrive half-formed. You are expected to shape them, following a logical, well-reasoned path to an answer.

• Relationships are the key. Nothing gets done alone. Building trust with cross-functional stakeholders across markets, brands and functions .

Our promise: a fun ride and a deeply enriching professional experience.

• Executive Communication: Excellent top-down communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to distill complex analyses into crisp executive summaries, build trust with local country leaders, and collaborate seamlessly with central product and strategy teams.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

As part of the APAC Client Solutions Group in Singapore, you will support the development and execution of initiatives across our Private Markets platform. You will manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, contribute to project execution, and help drive efficient processes to support fundraising and client servicing efforts.

• A strong academic background in a relevant discipline, with a demonstrated interest in finance, markets, and private assets

• Experience in product strategy, capital raising, investor relations, client servicing, or investment-related roles within asset management and/or investment banking. Existing exposure to private markets and an understanding of the fund life cycle are an advantage

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English, with the ability to build relationships and engage stakeholders across different levels. Additional language skills in Chinese and/or Japanese will be an advantage

• Strong attention to detail, organisational and project management skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment and adapt to shifting priorities

The Investor Relations Manager supports the Investor Relations team in executing the company’s investor communication programme and in maintaining relationships with the investment community. This role has day-to-day responsibility for preparing earnings and investor materials, covering a defined group of investors and analysts, and providing the analysis that supports targeting and messaging. 2. Draft and maintain the core investor presentation and supporting materials, ensuring the equity story is communicated accurately and consistently.
3. Act as day-to-day contact for a defined group of institutional investors and sell-side analysts, handling routine inquiries and escalating material feedback to senior IR.

8. Support the preparation of materials and logistics for Board and Board committee meetings, working with senior IR and the Company Secretary’s office.
9. Conduct ad hoc research and analysis on peer benchmarking, market developments and specific investor topics to support senior IR and management.

11. Collaborate with Finance, Legal, Communications and the business to gather information and ensure consistency across investor-facing content.

Job Title: B2B Sales & Marketing Manager — Wellness Therapy, Health Supplements & Skin Beauty
Company: Kenko Holdings Pte Ltd
Job Description
The B2B Sales & Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and leading the business-to-business sales and marketing strategy for Kenko Holdings Pte Ltd across wellness therapy services, health supplements, and skin beauty products and services.
The role drives revenue growth, profitability, and market expansion by securing corporate clients, developing distribution channels, and building long-term strategic partnerships. The Director will lead commercial planning, key account development, trade marketing, and sales team performance while working closely with management and operational teams to ensure effective delivery of business commitments.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Strategy and Commercial Leadership

• Develop and execute B2B sales and marketing strategies across the three business categories.

• Establish annual revenue, gross profit, sales pipeline, and marketing budget targets.

• Identify priority customer segments, market opportunities, and potential distribution channels.

• Develop pricing frameworks, partnership models, and commercial proposals that support sustainable growth.

• Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to guide business decisions.

• Present performance updates, forecasts, and growth recommendations to senior management.

2. Corporate Sales and Business Development

• Identify, engage, and secure corporate customers, distributors, retailers, and strategic partners.

• Build relationships with corporate HR and benefits teams, procurement departments, hospitality groups, wellness operators, beauty businesses, and relevant retail channels.

• Lead the sales process from prospecting and needs assessment through proposal development, negotiation, and contract closure.

• Develop tailored solutions, including corporate wellness programmes, therapy packages, product supply arrangements, and promotional partnerships.

• Negotiate pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities, service commitments, and renewal conditions within approved authority.

• Maintain a qualified sales pipeline and accurate revenue forecasts.

3. Wellness Therapy Partnerships

• Develop corporate wellness offerings such as employee therapy benefits, on-site wellness activities, corporate vouchers, and group service packages.

• Build referral and commercial partnerships with hotels, fitness centres, membership organisations, and other relevant businesses.

• Coordinate with branch and operational teams to confirm service capacity, delivery arrangements, and customer experience standards.

• Review programme participation, client feedback, and commercial performance to improve renewals and repeat business.

4. Health Supplements and Skin Beauty Channel Development

• Develop wholesale, distribution, retail, and professional sales channels for health supplements and skin beauty offerings.

• Identify and evaluate distributors, resellers, beauty salons, spas, and other suitable channel partners.

• Negotiate channel agreements covering product range, sales targets, territory, promotional support, and commercial terms.

• Work with product and operational teams on product positioning, launch plans, sales training, and partner support.

• Monitor partner sales, stock movement, reorder patterns, and expiry exposure where applicable.

• Manage channel conflicts and promote consistent brand positioning and pricing practices within company policies.

5. B2B Marketing and Brand Development

• Lead B2B marketing campaigns that generate qualified leads and support account acquisition.

• Oversee the development of corporate presentations, product catalogues, proposals, case studies, and sales materials.

• Plan trade exhibitions, industry networking activities, product demonstrations, and partner events.

• Work with the marketing team on digital campaigns, email marketing, and professional platforms such as LinkedIn.

• Develop joint marketing initiatives with distributors, corporate clients, and strategic partners.

• Measure marketing effectiveness through lead quality, conversion rates, acquisition costs, and commercial returns.

6. Key Account and Partner Management

• Build strong relationships with decision-makers and senior stakeholders at key accounts.

• Develop account plans to support renewals, repeat orders, cross-selling, and account growth.

• Conduct regular business reviews with major clients and distribution partners.

• Resolve commercial issues and coordinate service or product concerns with the relevant teams.

• Maintain accurate records of contracts, account activities, opportunities, and customer commitments.

• Reduce overdependence on individual customers or channels by building a balanced account portfolio.

7. Financial and Operational Coordination

• Monitor revenue, gross margins, discounting, marketing expenditure, and account profitability.

• Work with Finance to assess credit terms, monitor overdue payments, and support collections.

• Coordinate demand forecasts with procurement, inventory, and operational teams.

• Ensure sales commitments reflect available stock, service capacity, and delivery timelines.

• Review commercial risks and escalate exceptions or significant contractual commitments for approval.

8. Team Leadership and Performance Management

• Recruit, lead, and develop the B2B sales and marketing team.

• Set clear individual targets, account responsibilities, and performance expectations.

• Coach team members in prospecting, consultative selling, negotiation, and key account management.

• Establish consistent sales reporting, pipeline reviews, and customer relationship management practices.

• Foster accountability and effective collaboration across sales, marketing, operations, and finance.

9. Responsible Marketing and Business Conduct

• Ensure product information, promotional claims, and sales materials are reviewed and approved before use.

• Coordinate with relevant internal specialists to verify applicable product, labelling, advertising, and market-entry requirements.

• Ensure partners use approved materials and represent the company’s offerings accurately.

• Maintain confidentiality, responsible handling of customer data, and ethical business practices.

Job Requirements

• Degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Typically eight or more years of relevant B2B sales and marketing experience, including at least three years in a senior leadership role.

• Proven track record of achieving revenue and profitability targets, securing corporate accounts, and developing distribution partnerships.

• Experience in wellness, health supplements, beauty, consumer health, hospitality, or related sectors.

• Strong commercial judgement, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.

• Experience managing sales budgets, forecasting, pricing, and account profitability.

• Ability to lead teams and coordinate across multiple business categories and sales channels.

• Familiarity with CRM systems, sales analytics, and digital lead generation.

• Regional market development experience and an established industry network are advantages.

• Willingness to travel for client meetings, partner development, and industry events when required.

Key Performance Indicators

• B2B revenue growth and gross profit achievement.

• New corporate accounts and active distribution partners secured.

• Qualified pipeline value, conversion rate, and forecast accuracy.

• Account retention, contract renewals, and repeat orders.

• Revenue growth within existing key accounts.

• Channel productivity and product reorder performance.

• Marketing-generated opportunities and return on marketing expenditure.

• Receivables performance and compliance with approved credit terms.

• Sales team productivity and target achievement.

description:
Electro Optic Systems (EOS) is a global defence technology company specialising in the design, development and manufacture of advanced defence systems and remote weapon systems.
EOS Defence Systems Singapore supports customers across the Asia-Pacific region through after-sales support, maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), depot servicing, spare parts management, field services and long-term equipment sustainment programmes.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Sustainment Commercial Manager to lead the commercial and contractual management of EOS Defence Systems' MRO and sustainment business.
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing customer contracts, commercial negotiations, pricing strategies, contract profitability, financial performance and business development opportunities relating to long-term equipment sustainment and lifecycle support programmes.
This role requires a strong understanding of commercial contract management, defence or aerospace MRO operations, customer relationship management and financial planning.
The candidate will work closely with the MRO, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and Quality teams to ensure effective contract execution, commercial performance and customer satisfaction across Singapore and the Asia-Pacific region.

Key Responsibilities
1. Commercial & Contract Management

• Lead the commercial management of MRO, sustainment, depot servicing, field support and spare parts contracts.

• Review, negotiate and manage commercial terms and conditions, including contract scope, pricing, payment terms, warranties, service-level agreements (SLAs) and contractual obligations.

• Ensure contractual deliverables, milestones, obligations and commercial commitments are properly monitored and fulfilled.

• Manage contract variations, extensions, renewals, amendments and additional work scopes.

• Identify and mitigate commercial, contractual and financial risks throughout the contract lifecycle.

• Ensure compliance with company policies, customer requirements and applicable contractual and regulatory obligations.

2. Financial Management & Contract Profitability

• Develop and manage contract budgets, pricing models, cost estimates and commercial proposals for MRO and sustainment programmes.

• Monitor contract revenue, cost performance, gross margins, cash flow and profitability.

• Work closely with Finance and Operations teams to establish accurate cost structures for labour, materials, spare parts, repairs and field services.

• Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, optimise pricing and enhance contract profitability.

• Monitor financial performance against approved budgets and business targets.

• Prepare regular commercial and financial performance reports for senior management.

3. Customer & Stakeholder Management

• Establish and maintain strong commercial relationships with defence customers, government agencies, military organisations and international business partners.

• Lead commercial discussions, contract negotiations and customer business reviews.

• Act as the primary commercial point of contact for key sustainment and MRO accounts.

• Address customer commercial issues, contractual disputes, claims and service-related escalations.

• Work closely with technical and operational teams to ensure customer expectations and contractual deliverables are achieved.

• Support customer retention and long-term partnership development.

4. Business Development & Sustainment Opportunities

• Identify new commercial opportunities arising from existing defence equipment programmes and installed customer systems.

• Develop strategies to secure long-term sustainment, MRO, spare parts, upgrade and lifecycle support contracts.

• Identify opportunities for contract extensions, renewals, additional service packages and aftermarket support.

• Lead the preparation of commercial proposals, quotations, tenders and business cases.

• Support bid management activities, including pricing strategy, cost modelling, commercial risk assessments and tender negotiations.

• Monitor market trends, competitor activities and regional defence sustainment opportunities across the Asia-Pacific region.

5. MRO Operations & Cross-Functional Coordination

• Work closely with the MRO Depot Centre, Engineering, Field Service and Supply Chain teams to align commercial commitments with operational capabilities.

• Ensure MRO pricing and contract assumptions are supported by realistic resource, labour, material and spare parts requirements.

• Monitor service delivery performance against contractual SLAs and customer commitments.

• Support inventory, spare parts and repair cost optimisation initiatives.

• Review operational performance and identify commercial improvement opportunities.

• Ensure effective coordination between commercial and operational teams during contract execution.

6. Reporting & Governance

• Prepare management reports on contract performance, revenue, profitability, risks, business pipeline and customer accounts.

• Establish and maintain appropriate commercial governance, contract review and approval processes.

• Maintain accurate records of contracts, quotations, variations, claims and commercial correspondence.

• Present commercial performance updates and recommendations to senior management.

• Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned by senior management.

Job Requirements

• Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Engineering, Supply Chain Management or a related discipline.

• Minimum 8–12 years of relevant commercial, contract management or business management experience.

• Experience in defence, aerospace, aviation MRO, marine, offshore, engineering or industrial equipment industries is highly preferred.

• Proven experience managing complex service, maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), aftermarket or long-term sustainment contracts.

• Strong knowledge of commercial negotiations, contract administration, pricing strategies and financial management.

• Experience in managing contract budgets, cost structures, revenue, gross margins and profitability.

• Demonstrated ability to prepare commercial proposals, tender submissions, quotations and business cases.

• Strong customer relationship management and stakeholder engagement capabilities.

• Good understanding of contractual risk management, claims, variations and dispute resolution.

• Strong analytical, negotiation, communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and engage effectively with senior management and international customers.

• Willingness to travel locally and internationally when required.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

• Previous experience supporting defence, military, aerospace or government-related contracts.

• Experience managing long-term product sustainment, lifecycle support, aftermarket services or integrated logistics support (ILS) programmes.

• Familiarity with defence procurement processes, government contracts and international customer requirements.

• Knowledge of MRO cost structures, spare parts pricing, repair services and field service commercial models.

• Experience with contract profitability, P&L management and business development.

• Professional qualifications in contract management, project management, finance or commercial management would be advantageous.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to manage regional defence sustainment and MRO business activities.

• Exposure to international defence customers and long-term lifecycle support programmes.

• Involvement in strategic commercial planning and business development.

• Opportunity to contribute to the growth of EOS Defence Systems' regional sustainment business.

Company: SG Aluminium Pte. Ltd.
Location: Singapore

Department: Sales & Business Development
Reports To: Sales Manager / Management
ABOUT THE ROLE
SG Aluminium Pte. Ltd. is looking for a customer-oriented and commercially driven Sales Assistant & Sales Coordinator to support our growing residential aluminium and glass business.
The successful candidate will support the sales team in handling B2C enquiries, customer consultations, quotations, sales coordination and project follow-ups , covering aluminium doors, windows, gates, grilles and glass-related products.
This role combines customer-facing sales, administrative coordination and project support , making it suitable for candidates who enjoy interacting with customers, managing sales enquiries and coordinating projects from enquiry to completion.
Candidates with experience in construction materials, renovation, aluminium, glass, hardware or building products are strongly preferred.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. B2C Sales & Customer Engagement

• Attend to customer enquiries through WhatsApp, phone calls, walk-ins and online platforms.

• Understand customers' requirements and recommend suitable aluminium and glass solutions.

• Promote and sell residential aluminium doors, windows, gates, grilles, glass doors and related products.

• Assist customers with product selection, specifications, pricing and installation arrangements.

• Follow up on quotations and enquiries to convert potential customers into confirmed sales.

• Maintain professional customer relationships and generate repeat business and referrals.

• Support sales targets and contribute to overall business growth.

2. Sales Coordination & Quotation Management

• Prepare quotations, sales orders and customer proposals accurately.

• Coordinate site measurements, technical assessments and customer appointments.

• Follow up on quotation approvals, deposits and outstanding payments.

• Maintain accurate records of customer enquiries, quotations and sales progress.

• Coordinate with the Technical, Operations and Installation teams to ensure smooth project execution.

• Monitor project status and keep customers informed of installation schedules and progress.

• Assist in resolving customer enquiries, service issues and after-sales matters.

3. Customer & Project Administration

• Maintain customer databases and sales records.

• Update sales pipelines, enquiry status and follow-up schedules.

• Prepare sales reports and support management with sales performance tracking.

• Ensure all customer requirements, measurements and specifications are properly documented.

• Coordinate internal communication between Sales, Technical, Purchasing and Operations.

• Ensure timely follow-up on outstanding enquiries and pending projects.

4. Construction Material Sales Support

• Assist in promoting and selling construction-related materials and products.

• Develop product knowledge covering aluminium profiles, glass systems, door hardware, accessories and related building materials.

• Support customer enquiries from homeowners, contractors, renovators, interior designers and industry partners.

• Identify potential sales opportunities and support business development activities.

• Maintain awareness of product pricing, market trends and customer requirements.

REQUIREMENTS

• Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in sales, customer service or sales coordination.

• Experience in aluminium, glass, construction materials, renovation, hardware or building products is an advantage.

Business Development Executive (FMCG / HORECA Sales)
About the Role
We are a distribution and retail company specializing in FMCG products, with a strong focus on chocolate and confectionery items.
If you are a chocolate and snacks lover, passionate about sales, and excited to grow your career, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!
We are looking for an energetic, passionate, motivated, and results-driven individual to join our Sales team and help drive market expansion. Whether you are an entry-level candidate eager to kick-start your sales career or an individual with some sales experience looking for your next challenge, we welcome you to apply.
You will have the opportunity to develop your business development and sales skills, build strong relationships with customers, and contribute directly to the growth of our business across the FMCG, retail, and HORECA sectors.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales & Business Development

• Identify and develop new business opportunities and potential customers.

• Prospect and acquire new customers across FMCG, retail, and HORECA channels.

• Build and grow relationships with existing customers and accounts.

• Develop and execute sales strategies to increase market penetration and revenue growth.

• Assist in expanding distribution opportunities across supermarkets, convenience stores, F&B outlets, hotels, corporate accounts and distributors.

• Follow up on sales enquiries, quotations, and business opportunities.

Client & Account Management

• Build, manage, and grow long-term relationships with customers.

• Conduct regular customer visits and follow-ups to understand customers' needs and identify growth opportunities.

• Provide excellent customer service and after-sales support.

• Manage the sales process from prospecting and lead generation to closing and follow-up.

Sales Performance & Market Development

• Achieve and exceed monthly sales targets, KPIs, and revenue goals

• Monitor sales opportunities and maintain an active sales pipeline.

• Identify market trends, competitor activities, and potential business opportunities.

• Share ideas and recommendations to improve sales performance and market growth.

Promotions & Product Activities

• Support product launches, promotional campaigns, and marketing activities.

• Conduct product presentations and introduce products to potential customers.

• Participate in roadshows, events, and other business development activities where required.

Sales Operations & Administration

• Prepare quotations, proposals, and other sales-related documents.

• Maintain accurate and timely updates of customer and sales information in the company's ERP system.

• Ensure proper documentation of all sales activities

Job Requirements:

• Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.

• Entry-level candidates are welcome to apply.

• Candidates with experience in FMCG, retail, HORECA, B2B sales, or customer service will have an advantage.

• A strong interest in sales, business development, and building customer relationships.

Key Skills:

• Energetic, proactive, and self-motivated.

• Strong interest in sales and achieving results.

• Customer service oriented with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Confident in approaching and engaging with new customers.

• Good negotiation and relationship-building skills.

• Willingness to learn and take on new challenges.

• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Positive attitude and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

• Able to manage multiple tasks and follow up on business opportunities.

• Tech Proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); familiarity with ERP systems is a plus.

• Mobility: Possess own vehicle and valid driving license (preferred).

Why Join Us?

• A perfect opportunity for chocolate and snack lovers to work with products they enjoy!

• Opportunity to build and develop a rewarding career in Sales and Business Development.

• Gain valuable exposure to the FMCG, retail, and HORECA industries.

• Dynamic and fast-paced working environment.

• Friendly and supportive working environment.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume, stating their current and expected salary and availability to commence work .

Drive Your Career Forward with Us!

Assistant Relationship Manager – Corporate Banking
Job Summary
Support Relationship Managers in managing and developing corporate client relationships, including credit assessment, transaction execution, client servicing and ongoing account monitoring. Work closely with internal stakeholders to deliver timely client service and ensure compliance with the Bank’s policies and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Client Coverage and Business Development
• Assist Relationship Managers in managing corporate client portfolios, understanding client needs and identifying business opportunities.
• Support the assessment of new transactions and preparation of credit proposals, deal presentations and other business submissions.
• Participate in client meetings, customer visits and roadshows, and follow up on agreed action items.
Credit Assessment and Portfolio Monitoring
• Conduct financial and credit analysis, identify key risks and assist in structuring facilities with appropriate risk mitigants.
• Prepare credit applications, annual and interim reviews, including financial spreading, industry analysis and assessment of repayment capacity.
• Monitor account conduct, financial performance, facility utilization and compliance with approved conditions and covenants.
• Identify and escalate emerging credit concerns, excesses and deviations, and assist in obtaining necessary approvals or waivers and following up on remedial actions.
• Maintain complete and updated credit files and ensure timely completion of credit reviews and post-lending monitoring.
Transaction Execution and Client Servicing
• Assist in coordinating facility documentation, security arrangements and fulfilment of conditions precedent, working with internal teams, legal counsel and other lenders where required.
• Coordinate loan drawdowns, rollovers and other transaction requests, ensuring the necessary documentation and approvals are in place.
• Handle day-to-day client enquiries, including account matters, payments, balances and rate quotations, in coordination with relevant teams.
• Follow up on service issues and escalate matters appropriately to the Relationship Manager or relevant internal stakeholders.
Client Onboarding and Compliance
• Coordinate with clients, onboarding teams and Compliance to ensure timely completion of account opening, KYC, customer due diligence and periodic or trigger-event reviews.
• Assist in AML, sanctions and transaction-monitoring checks, including obtaining supporting information and following up on alerts with relevant teams.
• Ensure required checklists, client records and supporting documents are complete and maintained in accordance with the Bank’s policies and regulatory requirements.
Team Support
• Work closely with Relationship Managers, Operations, Risk and Compliance to support effective client coverage and transaction execution.
• Provide backup support to team members and undertake other duties assigned by the Head of Department or Relationship Managers.
Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline.
• Preferably 1–3 years of relevant experience in corporate banking, commercial banking or related financial services. Fresh graduates with a strong interest in corporate banking may also be considered.
• Basic understanding of financial statements, credit analysis and corporate banking products. Knowledge of trade finance, loan documentation and credit administration is an advantage.
• Familiarity with KYC, AML and relevant regulatory requirements is an advantage.
• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to prepare clear written submissions.
• Good communication, interpersonal and coordination skills.
• Well organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Proficiency in written and spoken English and Mandarin to support Chinese corporate clients and liaise with Chinese-speaking internal and external stakeholders on cross-border business.
• A responsible and proactive team player who can work independently and demonstrates a willingness to learn.

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. Assistant Vice President / Vice President, Corporate Banking Relationship Management - Sales

Why Join
As a Corporate Banking Relationship Manager at OCBC, you'll have the opportunity to build long-term relationships with our corporate clients and help them achieve their business goals. You'll be part of a dynamic team that's dedicated to delivering exceptional service and tailored financial solutions. This role is all about understanding our clients' needs and providing them with the right products and services to help them succeed.

How you succeed
To excel in this role, you'll need to take a client-centric approach, understanding their business goals and challenges, and providing them with tailored financial solutions. You'll need to build strong relationships with our clients, identify new business opportunities, and work closely with our product specialists to deliver innovative solutions. Your ability to communicate effectively, think strategically, and work collaboratively will be key to your success.

What you do
A. Strategic Client Coverage & Relationship Management

• Develop, manage and deepen strategic relationships with SWF and their respective investment platforms, subsidiaries and portfolio companies.

• Establish trusted relationships with senior executives, investment professionals, treasury teams and key decision-makers.

• Develop a deep understanding of clients' investment strategies, business priorities, operating models and evolving financial needs.

• Lead strategic client engagements, relationship reviews and senior management dialogues to strengthen OCBC's positioning as a preferred banking partner.

• Formulate and execute comprehensive account plans to drive long-term relationship development and client engagement.

B. Business Origination & Revenue Growth

• Proactively identify, originate and execute high-value banking opportunities across the clients' investment ecosystems.

• Drive revenue growth and wallet share expansion through lending, cash management, treasury solutions, capital markets and investment banking opportunities.

• Identify financing and cross-selling opportunities arising from clients' investment activities, acquisitions, divestments and portfolio management initiatives.

• Partner with product specialists to structure and deliver tailored financial solutions that address complex client requirements.

• Develop actionable business pipelines and execute strategies to achieve financial targets and broader relationship objectives.

C. Strategic Advisory & Ecosystem Coverage

• Develop strong insights into sovereign wealth funds, investment holding companies, financial sponsors and their investment ecosystems.

• Anticipate emerging client needs by monitoring investment trends, capital deployment strategies and market developments.

• Identify opportunities to extend OCBC's banking relationships across portfolio companies, investment partners, fund managers and other relevant counterparties.

• Connect clients with OCBC's regional and global capabilities to support their financing, investment and treasury requirements.

• Provide strategic insights and differentiated banking propositions that reinforce OCBC's relevance to key clients.
