• Work closely with credit and risk teams to evaluate, structure and execute financing transactions in accordance with the Bank's risk appetite.

• Prepare and present credit proposals, including financial analysis, transaction rationale and assessment of key risks.

• Monitor portfolio performance, emerging risks and evolving client requirements.

• Ensure compliance with internal governance, regulatory requirements and applicable risk management standards.

• Maintain disciplined portfolio management while balancing commercial opportunities with appropriate risk-return considerations.

E. Cross-Bank Collaboration & Franchise Development

• Collaborate closely with Global Investment Banking, Global Markets, Transaction Banking and other product teams to deliver coordinated client solutions.

• Facilitate cross-border opportunities by working with OCBC's regional and international coverage teams.

• Coordinate internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution and a consistently high standard of client service.

• Contribute to strategic initiatives that strengthen OCBC's franchise and deepen its relationships with leading institutional clients.

• Represent the Bank professionally in client meetings, industry engagements and strategic discussions.

• At least 8–10 years of relevant experienc in corporate banking, institutional client coverage, investment banking or a related financial services role.

• Demonstrated experience managing sophisticated corporate or institutional relationships, preferably involving sovereign wealth funds, investment companies, financial sponsors or large multinational corporations.

• Strong client-facing capabilities, with a proven ability to build credibility, influence stakeholders and develop long-term relationships.

• Sound understanding of corporate banking products, including lending, cash management, treasury solutions and capital markets.

• Strong commercial acumen with demonstrated ability to identify business opportunities, originate transactions and drive revenue growth.

• Strong analytical and credit assessment capabilities, with the ability to evaluate complex transactions and financial structures.

• Self-motivated, proactive and results-oriented, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across teams.

description:
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Solution Manager – Net Zero& Integrated Energy Solutions to support Linyang’s growing Net Zero Energy business in Singapore and Southeast Asia.
This role will work closely with the Singapore Business Development team as the primary solution counterpart, translating customer needs into technically feasible, commercially competitive and executable integrated energy solutions. The role is expected to take solutions beyond conceptual architecture, working from site assessment and preliminary system design through localisation, technical coordination and implementation readiness.
The role will focus on integrated energy solutions for Net Zero Factories, Green Factories, Low-Carbon / Net Zero Industrial Parks and other industrial customers, combining technologies such as Solar PV, BESS, Microgrid, EMS/SCADA, Energy Efficiency, EV Charging and energy/carbon platforms according to customer requirements, with selected coverage of distributed wind energy opportunities.
The role will also serve as a key bridge between customers in Singapore and Linyang’s solution, engineering, R&D and product teams in China, mobilising the appropriate technical resources to support opportunity development, solution design, proposal preparation and project execution.
Key Responsibilities

• Partner with the Singapore BD/Sales team throughout customer engagement, technical discovery, solution development and proposal stages.

• Lead technical discovery workshops to understand customers’ energy consumption, site conditions, operational constraints, carbon footprint, sustainability targets and investment priorities.

• Develop integrated energy solutions for industrial customers, including Net Zero Factories, Green Factories and Low-Carbon / Net Zero Industrial Parks.

• Develop preliminary solution architectures and lead technology selection and system integration across Solar PV, BESS, Microgrid, EMS/SCADA, Energy & Carbon Platform, Energy AI, EV Charging, Energy Efficiency and Flexible Loads.

• Support selected regional opportunities in distributed renewable energy, including distributed solar, energy storage and distributed / low-wind-speed wind applications.

• Conduct or coordinate preliminary energy assessments, decarbonisation pathway analysis, technical feasibility studies and solution-level CAPEX/OPEX and ROI analysis.

• Translate customer requirements into clear technical scopes, system architectures, functional requirements and solution proposals.

• Coordinate Linyang’s China-based solution, engineering, R&D and product teams, ensuring customer requirements are accurately understood and efficiently converted into deliverable solutions.

• Lead or support technical presentations, customer workshops, site surveys, RFI/RFP responses, tender clarification and technical-commercial proposal development.

• Identify and address local grid, regulatory, certification, engineering, safety and implementation requirements, including assessing whether proposed technologies/products can be deployed in Singapore and coordinating local alternatives, partners or approval requirements where necessary.

• Support site assessment, preliminary equipment configuration and layout considerations, and coordinate local EPCs, vendors, consultants and technology partners to move solutions from concept into executable projects.

• Develop reusable solution packages and reference architectures for priority sectors including semiconductor, advanced manufacturing, food & cold chain, logistics and industrial estates.

• Support the development of Singapore lighthouse projects and subsequent replication across Southeast Asia.

• Develop and coordinate the local solution ecosystem, including ESCOs, EPCs, consultants, engineering partners, technology providers and research institutions.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Building Services, Sustainability or related disciplines.

• Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience; 8–15 years preferred.

• Solid experience in integrated energy solutions, industrial energy systems, renewable energy, microgrids, BESS, EMS/SCADA or energy efficiency; exposure to industrial decarbonisation is an advantage.

• Hands-on experience in integrated energy, Solar PV, BESS, Microgrid/EMS, energy efficiency or comparable energy-system projects, including solution development and/or implementation, is strongly preferred.

• Good practical understanding of technologies such as Solar PV, BESS, Microgrid, EMS, SCADA / energy control systems, energy management, metering, energy efficiency, HVAC/utility optimisation and energy-carbon management. Expert-level depth in every technology is not required; the key requirement is system-level integration and sufficient practical knowledge to structure an executable solution.

• Ability to develop solution-level technical and commercial analysis covering CAPEX, OPEX, energy savings, carbon reduction, ROI and implementation roadmap.

• Strong system-level thinking; able to integrate multiple technologies rather than focusing only on individual products.

• Strong project coordination capability and experience working across engineering, product, commercial and delivery teams.

• Strong customer-facing communication, technical presentation and workshop facilitation skills.

• Ability to operate independently in a lean and entrepreneurial Singapore team while effectively mobilising larger technical resources from headquarters.

• Excellent command of English is essential. Mandarin proficiency is highly preferred for coordination with China-based technical and engineering teams.

Preferred Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate combines:
Integrated Energy Solution Development + System Integration + Customer Engagement + Project Execution / Technical Coordination
We are not looking for a pure design engineer, product specialist or advisory consultant. The successful candidate should be capable of understanding the customer’s operational and energy requirements, conducting practical site-level assessment, structuring an integrated solution, identifying the appropriate technologies and local implementation requirements, and mobilising internal and external technical resources to convert an opportunity into an executable project.
Experience across both customer-facing solution development and technical project delivery will be highly valued.

description:
Role Summary:
We are building the next generation of AI Native products for life sciences, moving Patsnap beyond a traditional SaaS platform into an intelligent product ecosystem powered by MCPs, Skills, and Agents. Our goal is to embed Patsnap directly into our customers’ daily workflows and help them complete complex research, clinical, BD, competitive intelligence, and regulatory tasks more effectively.
We are looking for a domain knowledge scientist who sits at the intersection of deep life sciences expertise and product building. This is not a traditional PM role. Your job is to translate complex, messy, real-world life sciences problems into focused, usable products that customers want to open every day.
If you have a PhD background in life sciences, bioinformatics, computational biology, or equivalent industry experience, and you have often felt that existing tools are “almost good enough, but not quite right,” this is an opportunity to build the tools you always wished existed.
This role is an in-office role based in our Singapore office.
What You'll Be Doing:
As a Life Science Scientist, you'll bring scientific expertise and product judgement together to identify, design and launch AI-native capabilities for life sciences professionals.
You'll work across the product lifecycle — from understanding a scientist's real-world problem to helping shape a working solution, putting it in front of users and learning from what happens next.
You will:

• Identify high-value life sciences workflows across areas such as clinical development, translational medicine, business development, competitive intelligence and regulatory affairs where AI can meaningfully improve how work gets done.

• Get close to our users , spending meaningful time with researchers, scientists, BD teams, clinical operations professionals and other life sciences customers to understand their daily work.

• Go beyond feature requests , uncovering what users are actually trying to accomplish and the scientific, data and workflow challenges standing in their way.

• Find the “last 200 metres” of the problem — the point where existing databases, search tools and software stop, and users resort to manual research, spreadsheets, multiple tools or their own scientific judgement to finish the task.

• Turn PatSnap's life sciences data into AI-native products , combining assets such as clinical trials, sequences, targets, deals and patents with MCPs, Skills and Agents to solve specific workflow problems.

• Prototype and launch quickly , getting early capabilities into users' hands in research-preview mode within weeks rather than waiting for everything to be perfect.

• Learn from real-world usage , using customer feedback and observed behavior to continuously improve what we build.

• Design for different scientific and commercial users , recognizing that the same underlying data can mean very different things to a researcher, clinical operations professional, scientific analyst or BD leader.

• Make strong prioritization decisions , helping determine what we should build, what we shouldn't build and where PatSnap has a unique opportunity to create value.

• Act as a domain authority for our life sciences products , helping product and engineering teams understand the scientific and industry context behind the problems they're solving.

• Help define what “good” looks like , bringing scientific rigor and product judgement to prototypes and challenging solutions that are technically impressive but don't solve the user's real problem.

• Partner with marketing and go-to-market teams , helping ensure our positioning and content communicate the genuine value of our products rather than simply describing their features.

• Help build product taste across the organization , raising the team's understanding of what great AI-native life sciences products should feel like.

Job requirements
What We'd Love From You
We're looking for someone who:

• Has a PhD in life sciences, bioinformatics, computational biology or a related field , or equivalent deep industry experience.

• Has strong knowledge of pharma, biotech, clinical development, translational medicine, BD, competitive intelligence or another relevant life sciences area.

• Understands how scientists and life sciences professionals actually work — including the messy, manual parts that aren't captured in formal processes.

• Is genuinely curious about how AI and Agents will reshape life sciences workflows .

• Has strong product intuition and can quickly judge whether an early prototype is likely to solve a real user problem.

• Can translate complex scientific problems into focused, practical product opportunities.

• Has delivered something end to end, such as a research paper, scientific tool, internal product, data pipeline or workflow solution.

• Is comfortable working with uncertainty, experimenting quickly and building at the edge of current AI capabilities.

• Can communicate complex scientific concepts clearly across technical, product and commercial teams.

Even Better If You Have:

• Hands-on experience with LLMs, AI Agents, MCP or prompt engineering .

• Experience working with structured biomedical data such as clinical trials, sequences, target/disease ontologies, deals or patents.

• Experience building products or tools for researchers, data scientists, scientific analysts or other technical users.

• Open-source contributions, technical writing, public projects or another portfolio of work that demonstrates your ability to build.

What Makes This Role Different:
You won't simply write requirements or manage a roadmap. You'll help define what the next generation of AI-native life sciences products should actually feel like.
You'll combine scientific expertise, customer understanding and product judgement to build tools that aren't just impressive demonstrations of AI, but genuinely useful parts of how scientists, analysts and decision-makers work every day.

description:
Specialist, Product Delivery (Middle Office Solutions)
Company: FairPrice Group
Department: Digital & Technology (Middle Office Solutions)
Location: Singapore
Employment Type: Full-Time
Seniority Level: Mid-Senior level
About the Role
As a Specialist, Product Delivery within our Digital & Technology (Middle Office Solutions) team, you will act as the technical delivery anchor and domain subject-matter expert bridging front-end omnichannel solutions with core enterprise systems.
In this role, you will lead complex technical projects spanning retail merchandising and financial operations—governing integrations across space planning and planograms, promotion optimization, promotional financial booking flows, and SAP-based digital wallet/top-up architectures. Working closely with commercial COEs and engineering teams, you will orchestrate seamless connectivity across SAP ERP (S/4HANA), MuleSoft, GCP, SAP BTP, and specialized vendor platforms across our diverse store banners.

Key Responsibilities
1. End-to-End Project Delivery & Release Management

• Go-Live & Cutover Execution: Orchestrate end-to-end production cutovers, data migration dry-runs, and go-live deployment schedules across multiple store formats (Super, Finest, Hyper, and Unity).

• Hypercare & Operations Governance: Establish structured hypercare support models, track defect triage/remediation workflows, and ensure rapid post-deployment stabilization.

• Change Advisory (CAB) & Reliability: Lead formal Change Advisory Board (CAB) submissions, operational risk assessments, and implementation approvals to safeguard platform uptime.

• Continuous Platform Enhancement: Scope, evaluate, and prioritize functional change requests (CRs), access governance workflows, and platform optimization backlogs.

2. Domain Delivery: Space Management, Promotions & Financial Flows

• Planogram & Space Management Solutions: Lead the technical delivery and interface design for space planning and planogram platforms, ensuring reliable sync between store layouts, category assortments, and execution systems.

• Promotion Optimization & Scheduling: Oversee integrations with promotion optimization engines, price/rebate execution pipelines, and store operational schedules.

• Promotion Booking & Financial Flows: Drive the end-to-end integration of promotion booking workflows, vendor rebates, and downstream accounting/financial settlements into SAP ERP, ensuring audit compliance and transaction integrity.

3. SAP Digital Wallet, Top-Up & Payment Architecture

• Wallet & Stored-Value Mechanisms: Architect and deliver customer wallet mechanisms, top-up journeys, balance tracking, and ledger accounting powered by SAP backend integrations.

• Payment & Settlement Integration: Define data pipelines and API contracts connecting front-end consumer apps, payment gateways, and SAP financial ledgers for real-time top-ups, transaction logging, and reconciliation.

4. Technical Architecture, Security & Vendor Leadership

• Architecture Governance (KDD & EA): Author comprehensive Key Design Decision (KDD) documentation and secure Enterprise Architecture (EA) approvals for middleware pipelines (MuleSoft, GCP microservices, SAP BTP).

• Vendor & Partner Management: Direct external engineering and development partners, establishing technical acceptance criteria, SOW milestones, and delivery cadences.

• Stakeholder Enablement: Partner closely with Commercial Asset Centres of Excellence (COEs), Finance, and Store Operations to deliver operational playbooks, user training, and rollout governance.

• Identity & Access Administration: Oversee enterprise identity and access controls, including Okta and SAP Identity Authentication Services (IAS) profiles, secure vendor VPN provisioning, and license optimization.

What We Are Looking For

• Experience: 5–8+ years of technical delivery, solutions delivery, or enterprise systems integration experience within retail, omnichannel commerce, or consumer financial platforms.

• Retail Domain Expertise:

• Demonstrated subject matter expertise in space planning, macro/micro space management, and planogram integration tools.

• Strong knowledge of promotion optimization systems and the end-to-end financial accounting and settlement flows for retail promotion bookings and vendor funding.

• SAP Wallet & Payment Experience: Proven experience designing and delivering digital wallet ecosystems, stored-value accounts, and top-up mechanisms tightly integrated with SAP backbones (SAP ERP / S/4HANA Financials / SAP BTP).

• Integration & Cloud Architecture: Hands-on working knowledge of enterprise middleware and cloud platforms (MuleSoft, SAP BTP, GCP microservices, REST/SOAP APIs, and event-driven architectures).

• Release & Governance Disciplines: Proven track record running formal CAB processes, cutover runbooks, rollback plans, and defect resolution cycles using Jira, ServiceNow, or equivalent ITIL toolsets.

• Identity & Security Standards: Familiarity with modern authentication protocols (SSO, SAML/OIDC) and platforms such as Okta or SAP IAS.

• Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Certifications in SAP, Cloud Architecture, or Agile/PMP are strong advantages.

We are looking for a technically inclined and customer-oriented individual to join our team. Reporting to the Product Specialist Manager, you will support product research, technical enquiries and customer solution development while building your knowledge of industrial products and their applications.

description:
Job Description
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Position Summary
This Southeast Asia (SEA) focused TEM/XPS Product Specialist / Sales Development representative will work with a motivated and successful team at the forefront of electron microscopy in SEA, APAC and around the world, including applications, product development, sales and marketing. You will become a product expert and help to deliver TEM and/or XPS business growth in SEA, working closely with our academic and industrial research customers, to understand their application needs and find effective ways to promote our solutions. You will help to understand and build relationships with key researchers and match our technology and solutions to customer needs, and help to increase materials science electron microscopy and surface analysis sales in the region.

Job responsibilities will include:
• Keeping up to date on the latest products and technology (mainly TEM and/or XPS), by developing relationships both inside and outside the APAC region, including with hands-on experience if possible.
• Establishing and maintaining strong relationships with customers to better understand how to make them successful, both in academia and industry.
• Explaining new products, workflows and solutions to customers including in the battery, steel, automotive, and coatings industries, as well as to academic researchers.
• Supporting the sales team to improve win-rate for electron microscopy and surface analysis opportunities
• Supporting the planning, preparation and execution of product demonstrations
• Partner with regional sales managers to execute our annual operation plan, develop and drive business development projects for target market segments. Overlook the progress to ensure the key projects in good shape, on track and deliver the target pipeline growth.
• TEM/XPS market and competition intelligence, including participating in microscopy societies and conferences, identifying key opinion leaders, understanding competitor products and strategies, and sharing microscopy technical expertise and advice to internal and external customers
• Helping with event planning and execution including conferences, workshops, trade shows and webinars, and presenting at such events.
• Discussing with the MSBU product team about customer and market trends and requests, to improve the development of the next generation of electron microscopes
• Adapting or translating marketing materials for local use.
• Helping to train and develop other members of the team.

The ideal candidate would have:
• Good knowledge of TEM and/or XPS techniques and applications (preferably some knowledge of SEM and DualBeam as well), and passion about the fields of electron microscopy and materials science
• Strong background in materials science research, academic or industrial, or good understanding of a range of materials science customer applications, and experience interacting with industrial or academic scientists and researchers
• A university degree or equivalent, preferably a PhD or similar research experience in the field of materials science, metallurgy, electron microscopy, nanotechnology or engineering.
• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, (primarily in English, but other languages welcome) including the ability to explain technical concepts, workflows and applications clearly to a range of audiences, to gain trust, to influence and persuade others, to present at conferences, to work well in teams, and to listen and understand customer needs.
• Ability to achieve results and work to agreed timelines.
• Be able to produce and implement new ideas, and to see new opportunities and realize them.
• Good judgement and decision-making skills.
• Enthusiasm to work within a diverse, cross-functional team across multiple sites
• A high level of integrity and a desire to improve customer outcomes and achieve customer satisfaction
• Ability to travel up to 50-75% within assigned territory, mainly within SEA and some APAC regions

description:
Job Purpose
We are seeking an Investment Solutions & Product Analyst to support the development, analysis, management and commercialization of investment products, portfolios and investment solutions across wealth management and institutional channels.
The role will work closely with the CEO/CIO and Portfolio Managers to translate the firm’s investment views and capabilities into well-constructed portfolios, clear and differentiated product propositions, and commercially viable investment solutions .
Responsibilities
1. Portfolio Analysis & Investment Solutions

• Support the development and analysis of model portfolios and investment solutions across multiple asset classes.

• Analyse portfolio performance, risk, exposures, return drivers and positioning.

• Support portfolio construction and implementation, including asset allocation, portfolio weights and investment constraints.

• Conduct portfolio and scenario analysis to support investment and product decisions.

2. Product Development & Management

• Develop and manage investment products based on market trends, client needs and the firm’s investment capabilities .

• Work closely with the CEO/CIO, Portfolio Managers and sales to define product objectives, target clients, investment approach and key product features.

• Conduct market and competitor research to identify product opportunities.

• Coordinate with Risk, Legal & Compliance, Operations and external partners throughout product development and launch.

3. Investment & Product Analysis

• Maintain a strong understanding of financial markets and multiple asset classes and financial instruments, including fixed income, equities, currencies, derivatives, funds/ETFs and structured products .

• Analyse investment strategies and products, including their key characteristics, risks, return drivers and suitability for different client segments.

• Evaluate new investment and product ideas and support the development of investment proposals.

4. Client, Sales & Business Development Support

• Support sales in product launches, client discussions and business development activities.

• Participate in selected client, distributor and institutional partner meetings where investment/product expertise is required.

• Prepare pitchbooks, product proposals, client presentations, factsheets and investment/product papers .

• Translate investment concepts and portfolio analysis into clear, concise and commercially relevant communication .

• Support client and distributor enquiries and follow-up actions.

Requirements

• 3–7 years of relevant experience in asset management, investment solutions, product development, wealth management or institutional investment.

• Strong knowledge of financial markets and multiple asset classes and financial instruments, including fixed income, equities, currencies, derivatives, funds/ETFs and structured products.

• Good understanding of investment products, asset allocation and portfolio construction.

• Ability to translate client objectives, constraints and investment views into practical portfolio construction and investment solutions.

• Strong analytical and research capabilities.

• Excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Able to communicate effectively with investment professionals, senior management, distributors, clients and external institutional partners.

• Commercially minded, with an ability to understand client needs and translate investment capabilities into practical product solutions.

• Comfortable working across Investment, Sales/Distribution, Risk, Legal & Compliance and Operations.

• Proficiency in Chinese language is preferred as substantial communication with our Head Office and clients in Chinese speaking markets

• Responsible for achieving sales targets and goals for a specific product group

• Responsible for a defined Product Marketing set of classes

• Create, implement and monitor action plan for focus suppliers within the branches

• Maintain and improve key suppliers’ relationship

• Responsible for SLA on timely completion of quotes

• Responsible to make sure that Product Group develops proficiency in aggressively quoting to win key opportunities from Sales branches

• Maintain proper follow-up systems

REQUIREMENTS

• A Degree qualification or equivalent in a relevant field of study.

• Minimum 3 years in product marketing or equivalent.

• Experience in electronics industry experience within distribution, component manufacturers and/or EMS companies is highly advantageous but not a must.

• Must be able to travel when required locally and overseas.

Our client is seeking an AI Product Specialist to drive the development and evolution of its AI-enabled digital platforms. The role focuses on transforming strategic initiatives into coherent, trusted and outcome-driven digital products that align with the organisation’s talent philosophy, methodology and long-term objectives.
Operating in an environment without an established product function, this position offers the opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of product strategy, roadmap development and delivery, working closely with internal stakeholders and external digital platform vendors.
The Role
Reporting to the Head of Organisational Development, the AI Product Specialist Owner will be responsible for defining product vision, translating business needs into actionable development plans, and ensuring successful delivery and adoption of AI-enabled digital solutions.
Key responsibilities include:

• Product Vision & Strategy: Define the product vision, strategic direction and problem statements for AI-enabled digital platforms, ensuring alignment with organisational priorities and user needs.

• Roadmap & Prioritisation: Develop and maintain the product roadmap, prioritising initiatives based on business value, feasibility, risk and organisational readiness.

• Backlog & Requirements Management: Translate product strategy into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, while managing the product backlog and guiding development teams throughout delivery.

• Vendor & Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for external development vendors, aligning product scope, priorities and delivery expectations with internal stakeholders across leadership, coaching, People & Organisation (P&O),and IT teams.

• Development & Delivery: Drive product development from concept through MVP and pilot stages, ensuring deliverables meet agreed standards for quality, usability, data integrity, trustworthiness and explainability.

• Product Adoption & Evolution: Gather feedback from early users and pilot programmes, identify opportunities for improvement, and establish product practices that support continuous development, scalability and long-term maturity.

The Requirements

• Demonstrated experience in digital transformation, platform development, product ownership or complex cross-functional initiatives, particularly in ambiguous or early-stage product environments.

• Proven ability to define product direction, identify user needs, establish priorities and drive delivery from concept through pilot or production-ready implementation.

• Experience working with external development vendors, including scope definition, backlog management, delivery oversight and quality assurance.

• Exposure to AI-enabled or data-driven digital products, with an understanding of data governance, explainability and responsible AI use.

• A track record of delivering measurable organisational outcomes, such as improved adoption, decision-making quality or process effectiveness.

• Familiarity with vibe-coding and an understanding of iterative delivery methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban would be advantageous.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex organisational dynamics and translate between business, technical and user perspectives.

• High emotional intelligence, strong facilitation skills, learning agility and a structured, outcomes-oriented mindset.

• A bachelor's degree in any discipline, supported by strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. A master's degree in IT would be an advantage.

• Formal training or practical experience in product management, agile delivery or digital transformation would be beneficial.

The Next Step
Interested candidates may submit their resumes via this portal or email their CVs (in Wordformat) to evan.lim@chaptrconsulting.com .

Aenon Pharmaceuticals SEA Pte Ltd
Singapore
About Us
Aenon Pharmaceuticals SEA Pte Ltd is a growing specialist healthcare company focused on bringing premium evidence-based healthcare products to medical professionals across Singapore and the region.
Founded by healthcare professionals with extensive pharmaceutical industry experience, we work closely with doctors, specialists, hospitals and healthcare institutions in areas such as Women's Health, Pediatrics, Dermatology and Travel Medicine.
Our portfolio includes premium supplements, dermatology products and travel vaccines. We believe in building long-term partnerships through strong clinical support, ethical promotion andconsultative engagement.
As we continue to grow, we are looking for motivated and relationship-driven individuals to join our team.
About The Role
This role is suitable for individuals who enjoy consultative selling, building long-term healthcare relationships and working in an agile and entrepreneurial healthcare environment.
You will work closely with doctors, specialists, clinics and healthcare institutions to grow the company's specialist healthcare portfolio across Singapore.
Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain strong relationships with doctors, specialists, clinics and healthcare institutions

• Develop and grow assigned medical territories and accounts

• Conduct product detailing and scientific discussions with healthcare professionals

• Implement sales and marketing strategies to achieve business objectives

• Identify new business opportunities and develop account plans

• Organize and support educational meetings, Lunch & Learn sessions and product presentations

• Provide market insights and customer feedback to management

• Maintain strong customer service and follow-up with healthcare professionals

• Work closely with management in a collaborative and fast-moving environment

What We Are Looking For

• Minimum 2 years of pharmaceutical, healthcare or medical sales experience preferred

• Candidates with experience in Pediatrics, OBGYN, Dermatology or Plastic Surgeons and General Surgeons will have an advantage

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Comfortable engaging doctors and healthcare professionals

• Positive attitude with strong ownership and learning mindset

• Self-motivated and able to work independently

• Team player who enjoys working in a small and collaborative company

• Candidates with healthcare-related backgrounds such as Nursing, Biomedical Science and Pharmacy are welcome to apply

• Singaporeans and PRs preferred

Candidates with own transport will have an advantage and preferred.
What We Offer

• Competitive salary package

• Attractive sales incentive scheme

• Medical and dental benefits

• Mobile and transport support

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Exposure to multiple specialist healthcare areas

• Opportunity to work closely with company leadership

• Supportive and collaborative working environment

Why Join Aenon Pharmaceuticals SEA Pte Ltd
Unlike large multinational companies, every team member at Aenon plays an important role in shaping the business and driving growth.
This is an opportunity for individuals who want:

• Greater exposure and responsibility

• A more entrepreneurial healthcare environment

• Closer mentorship and leadership access

• Meaningful long-term career growth

• The opportunity to make a real impact in healthcare

If you are passionate about healthcare, relationship building and consultative selling, we would love to hear from you.

We are seeking a motivated and technically inclined Product Specialist (Server Computing) to support product management, business development, and presales activities related to server computing solutions.

• Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

description:
About the Role
We are looking for motivated and client-oriented individuals to join our team as Investment Specialists. This is a client-facing role focused on building long-term relationships and providing tailored wealth management to clients across different wealth segments, including mass-market, high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals.
You will have the opportunity to work with a range of investment products, including multi-asset funds, equities, fixed-income funds and wealth accumulation solutions. Client leads will be provided , alongside structured training and ongoing professional development to support your success in the role.
Whether you are an experienced professional or looking to make a mid-career switch into the financial services industry, we welcome candidates who are eager to learn, grow and build a rewarding career in wealth management.
Job Scope

• Build and expand the company's client base by developing relationships with new and existing clients.

• Engage with clients across mass-market, HNW and UHNW segments to understand their financial objectives, investment preferences and risk profiles.

• Conduct financial needs analysis and recommend suitable investment and wealth accumulation solutions based on clients' needs and objectives.

• Work with a range of investment products, including multi-asset funds, equities, fixed-income funds and accredited investor funds, subject to applicable eligibility and regulatory requirements.

• Leverage company-provided client leads and implement targeted strategies to acquire and develop client relationships.

• Monitor client investment portfolios, provide relevant updates on market movements and support ongoing client relationship management.

• Conduct due diligence, investment research, market analysis and the necessary documentation in accordance with company procedures and regulatory requirements.

• Organise and invite clients to investment-related events, seminars and industry programmes.

• Attend monthly investment training sessions conducted by leading fund houses, fully funded by the company.

• Stay updated on current affairs, financial news, market conditions and industry developments to better support client conversations.

Remuneration Package & Benefits

• Competitive base salary ranging from S$4,000 to S$8,000 , subject to experience and suitability.

• Uncapped earning potential based on individual performance.

• Company-provided client leads to support business development.

• Fast-track career progression opportunities.

• Structured career development and professional training.

• Monthly investment training conducted by leading fund houses.

• Opportunities to attend investment events and industry programmes.

• Exposure to diverse client segments, including HNW and UHNW individuals.

• Employee assistance programme.

• Flexible schedule.

• Professional development opportunities.

• Unlimited paid time off, subject to company policy.

• Hybrid work arrangement in Singapore.

Requirements

• Local Polytechnic Diploma or Degree in any discipline.

• Strong communication, interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

• Good organisational and time-management abilities, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and assignments.

• Self-motivated, proactive and willing to learn.

• Interest in financial markets, investments and wealth management.

• Comfortable working in a client-facing, target-driven environment.

• Entry-level candidates and individuals looking for a mid-career switch are welcome to apply.

• Relevant financial services experience is an advantage but not essential, subject to applicable licensing and regulatory requirements.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Singapore

description:
Job Overview
The successful candidate will be responsible for providing investment advisory services, developing tailored investment strategies, and managing investment portfolios for high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) clients.
The role requires strong expertise in financial markets, investment products, portfolio advisory, and client relationship management. The Investment Consultant will work closely with Private Banking Relationship Managers, internal product teams, and senior stakeholders at the Taiwan Head Office to deliver investment solutions aligned with clients' financial objectives and risk profiles.
Key Responsibilities

Investment Advisory & Portfolio Management

• Provide investment advisory services and develop customized investment strategies based on clients' financial objectives, risk appetite, and investment horizons.

• Conduct comprehensive financial and portfolio analyses to identify suitable investment opportunities.

• Advise on investment products, including equities, fixed income, mutual funds, structured products, and other wealth management solutions.

• Monitor financial markets, economic developments, and investment trends to provide timely market insights and recommendations.

• Facilitate trade execution and portfolio rebalancing in accordance with clients' investment mandates and applicable controls.

• Conduct regular portfolio reviews, performance assessments, and investment reporting.

Client Relationship Management

• Partner with Private Banking Relationship Managers to provide investment advisory support to HNW and UHNW clients.

• Build and maintain strong client relationships through regular investment discussions, portfolio reviews, and market updates.

• Present investment strategies and product recommendations clearly and professionally to clients and senior stakeholders.

• Identify opportunities to enhance clients' investment portfolios and deepen existing banking relationships.

Regulatory Compliance & Stakeholder Management

• Ensure investment recommendations and transactions comply with MAS regulations, suitability requirements, and internal compliance policies.

• Maintain accurate documentation of investment recommendations, client interactions, and transactions.

• Collaborate with internal investment, product, risk, and compliance teams to ensure appropriate investment solutions.

• Coordinate with senior management and stakeholders at the Taiwan Head Office on investment initiatives, market developments, and reporting requirements.

• Participate in team discussions, product training, and business development initiatives.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Banking, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Wealth Management, Private Banking, Investment Advisory, or Investment Consulting.

• Proven experience advising HNW/UHNW clients and managing diversified investment portfolios.

• Strong knowledge of financial markets and investment products, including equities, fixed income, mutual funds, structured products, and other investment solutions.

• Demonstrated ability to develop investment strategies, conduct portfolio reviews, and provide investment recommendations.

• Must have completed CACS Paper 1 and Paper 2.

• Good understanding of MAS regulatory requirements, investment suitability, and compliance standards applicable to Private Banking in Singapore.

• Strong analytical, communication, presentation, and client relationship management skills.

• Ability to work closely with Private Banking Relationship Managers and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders at the Taiwan Head Office.

• Proficiency in investment analysis, portfolio monitoring, and financial reporting tools.

• Professional certifications such as CFA, CFP, or equivalent qualifications will be an advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is an experienced Investment Consultant, Investment Advisor, or Investment Specialist from a Private Banking or Wealth Management environment, with strong expertise in multi-asset investment advisory and portfolio management.
The candidate should possess excellent investment product knowledge, the ability to provide sophisticated investment recommendations to HNW/UHNW clients, and strong stakeholder management capabilities to work effectively with the Singapore Private Banking team and Taiwan Head Office.

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their resumes along with a cover letter outlining their relevant experience and achievements to apply79@talentvis.com or click apply now!

4S is building a dedicated fundraising function for the first time, following the launch of our first integrated fundraising campaign, Adopt-A-Wish, in February 2026. This role will lead that build —establishing the donor pipeline, partnership base, systems and stewardship practices 4S does not yet have, with a particular focus on Community-based Centres (4S Active Ageing Centre and 4S Eldercare Centre @ Eunos Crescent). The role will also contribute to 4S’s overall financial sustainability and support fundraising, partnership and sponsorship opportunities across its facilities.
This is a founding role in a function 4S is investing in as a strategic priority under its 2024–2028 Roadmap. You will have real latitude to shape how 4S fundraises, working closely with the CEO, HQ’s Community Engagement and Corporate Communications & Marketing staff.
Responsibilities
Fundraising Foundations

• Design and stand up 4S’ core fundraising approach — a donor pipeline and a repeatable calendar of campaigns/appeals.

• Support the procurement and implementation of 4S’ Donor and Volunteer Management System (DVMS), then manage its donation-related functions, including donor records and donation tracking, to support donor engagement and regular giving across the organization.

• Develop and implement plans to meet agreed year-one and year-two fundraising targets and grant KPIs, with an initial focus on the Community-based Centres’ funding needs. Track progress and propose higher targets for agreement with the CEO where feasible.

Partnership Development

• Build 4S's first structured base of corporate, foundation and community partnerships — moving beyond one-off donations toward small numbers of well-managed, renewable relationships.

• Prepare partnership proposals and manage the resulting agreements/MoUs. Coordinate sponsorships and donations (cash/in-kind) with the relevant facilities, including donor follow-up.

Donor Stewardship

• Establish a simple, consistent stewardship cadence (acknowledgement, updates, impact reporting) for 4S's existing and new donors.

• Use what Adopt-A-Wish surfaced about donor behavior to refine the next campaign.

Governance

• Keep accurate fundraising records and ensure activities comply with the Charities Act, Commissioner of Charities and NCSS requirements.

• Provide the CEO, Board and relevant Management Committees with straightforward updates on pipeline, funds raised and donor retention at agreed intervals, attending meetings as required. Prepare progress and outcome reports in line with grant requirements.

What you’ll partner on not own:

• Digital fundraising platforms, campaign content and social media: partner with the HQ’s Community Engagement and Corporate Communications & Marketing staff on campaign delivery, content, publicity and brand alignment.

Requirements

• Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications or related field.

• 5 years' relevant experience in fundraising, partnerships or business development, including experience helping build or scale a fundraising function (not only operating within an established one) — this is a build role, not a maintenance role.

• A proven track record in donor or partnership acquisition, ideally including hands-on campaign delivery rather than only strategy.

• Strong proposal writing, communication and relationship-building skills; comfortable working with limited existing infrastructure.

• Working knowledge of Singapore charity governance and compliance (Charities Act, IPC requirements).

• Genuine interest in eldercare / community-based social service work.

Working Arrangements

• Reports to Chief Executive Officer

• 44 hours per week, 5-day work week

• Availability to attend meetings or work on weekends when required

• Willingness to work five days per week at Eunos Crescent, Singapore

description:
Role Summary:
As Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of South Central Community Family Service Centre, you will lead an organisation dedicated to “Poverty Transformation With-in Empowered Communities”. This is an extraordinary opportunity to shape the future of a vibrant, mission-driven organisation delivering critical services in areas such as Social Work interventions, Home Ownership, Livelihood, and Child Learning & Development programmes.
You will inspire and lead a passionate team, foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence, and drive digital transformation and evidence-informed practice to ensure services make a tangible difference for families. The CEO will also champion organisational sustainability, strengthen partnerships with government, funders, and the community, and elevate SCC as a thought leader in the social service sector.
As CEO, you will exercise direct strategic and operational oversight over flagship KeyStart Home Ownership Programme, including complementary programmes such as the Livelihood Programme and Fresh Start Support Programme — driving integration across internal and external ecosystems to empower families in public rental housing to achieve home ownership and social mobility.
If you are a values-led, visionary leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, impact, and people, this role offers a platform to create lasting change for families and communities, leaving a legacy that extends far beyond the organisation itself.

Key Accountabilities:
1. Organisational Leadership

• Drive Strategic Direction: Implement Board-approved strategies and policies to advance SCC’s mission and ensure long-term sustainability. Provide strategic advice to the Board on organisational priorities, emerging risks, and sector developments

• Strengthen Organisational Capability: Ensure systems, structures, and processes remain fit for purpose to deliver high-quality, integrated services and achieve measurable outcomes for families and children

• Lead and Develop People: Lead, manage, and develop the senior management team and staff, fostering a professional, ethical, and values-driven organisational culture. Establish and maintain sound HR policies, performance management frameworks, staff development initiatives, and succession planning. This includes nurturing a passionate staff team that is aligned with the purpose, principles and methods of the organisation

• Champion Organisational Culture: Promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organisation to build an engaged, high-performing workforce aligned with SCC’s mission and values

2. Accountability to Board & Governance

• Work closely with the Board to chart the vision and strategies to fulfil its mission

• Provide timely, accurate, and relevant information to enable effective Board oversight and informed decision-making

• Ensure compliance with the Charities Act, Code of Governance for Charities and IPCs, and SCC’s internal policies

• Recommend to the Board the necessary and appropriate human resource requirements for effective execution of the work

• Work closely with the Executive Director and other Committees and regularly update on organisational progress, needs and issues

3. Programme Governance & Service Development

• Ensure the effective planning and development, delivery, and quality assurance of all SCC transformation services and programmes, including interventions that support family stability and resilience across key vertical programmes such as Home Ownership, Livelihood, and Child Learning & Development

• Provide team management and supervision to oversee the appropriate implementation of strategies and interventions

• Maintain full compliance with MSF, NCSS, and funder requirements, including service standards, KPIs, and reporting, with due regard to outcome frameworks relating to housing stability, economic self-reliance, and child development outcomes

• Promote outcome-based practice, service integration, and continuous improvement across the organisation to achieve holistic and measurable improvements in family and child well-being

4. Home Ownership & Livelihood (HOLI) Vertical Leadership and Oversight - The CEO exercises direct senior leadership over the HOLI vertical, encompassing the KeyStart Programme, Livelihood Programme, and Fresh Start Support Programme. In this capacity, the CEO:

• Leads the strategic direction, planning, and execution of the Home Ownership and Livelihood verticals, ensuring alignment with SCC’s mission of poverty transformation and integration across internal and external ecosystems

• Oversees the planning and management of HOLI programme operations, ensuring each programme’s service model is efficient and evidence-based, and champions continuous improvement in programme design, implementation, and cost-effectiveness

• Upholds high standards of practice and service delivery across both Home Ownership and Livelihood departments through supervision and strategic oversight, ensuring families receive holistic, family-centred support to achieve poverty transformation

• Oversees reporting and documentation across all HOLI programmes for submission to management, funders, and the Board, ensuring compliance with funding and audit requirements

5. Financial Stewardship & Sustainability

• Ensure prudent financial management, including budgeting, financial planning, and resource allocation

• Maintain robust financial controls and ensure timely audits with clean audit opinions

• Strengthen organisational sustainability through funding diversification and effective grants management

• Work closely with the Board and funders to drive fundraising and financial sustainability for non-funded initiatives, including identifying, developing, and securing funding streams across all verticals through proposals, institutional grants, and donor partnerships

6. Shared & Corporate Services Oversight and Team Operations

• Oversee all corporate and support functions of SCC, including finance, human resources, administration, facilities and admin/operations communications, and fundraising, ensuring effective operations and regulatory compliance

• Lead risk management and oversight, ensuring organisational compliance with legal, regulatory, and funding requirements, supporting audits and internal controls

• Provide oversight of information technology and digital systems, including the planning, implementation, and governance of technology-enabled solutions, to support service delivery, operational effectiveness, data integrity, and regulatory compliance

• Oversee the Research, Evaluation and Development (RED) function, ensuring the systematic collection, analysis, and reporting of service and organisational data to support outcome measurement, programme improvement, accountability to funders, and evidence-informed practice

• Ensure the establishment and maintenance of sound internal controls, robust operational and digital systems, and an enterprise risk management framework, including the identification, assessment, and mitigation of financial, operational, cyber, and data-related risks, in accordance with the Code of Governance for Charities and IPCs

• Ensure organisational readiness and compliance in areas of business continuity, safeguarding, and data governance, including adherence to the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), data protection policies, access controls, incident response procedures, and information security requirements

7. Stakeholder, External Relations and Risk Management

• Represent SCC and promote collaborative key relationships with government agencies, stakeholders, funders, and community partners

• Ensure robust enterprise risk management across SCC, identifying and proactively mitigating operational, reputational, and financial risks, and upholding full compliance with legal, ethical, and practice standards through sound governance frameworks and timely remedial action

• Advocate for the needs of families and communities served by SCC, consistent with Board-approved positions

• Drive sector-level thought leadership and contribute to SCC’s participation in national social service transformation efforts, including areas of housing stability, social mobility, and livelihood development

Qualifications and Experience:

• Degree in a relevant discipline; post graduate qualification preferred

• At least 10 years of senior leadership experience, preferably in the social service, non-profit, or public sector

• Demonstrated experience in organisational leadership, financial stewardship, and regulatory compliance

• Strong understanding of the Singapore social service and charity governance landscape

• Experience in programme management, strategic planning ,and cross-sector collaboration within the social services domain, including familiarity with housing, livelihood, and social mobility sectors, is an advantage

Note:

• By submitting your resume or by disclosing your personal data in connection with your job application, you are deemed to have consented to the collection, use and disclosure of your personal data for use in accordance with our Privacy Policy - https://to.sccfsc.org.sg/privacy

• If you wish to withdraw your consent, please write to dpo@sccfsc.org.sg and we will respond accordingly

• All job applications will be processed with strict confidence and only shortlisted candidate will be contacted

description:
About Hagar Singapore
Hagar is an international organisation dedicated to supporting survivors of human trafficking, modern slavery and abuse. Through survivor-centred, trauma-informed programmes, Hagar works to support recovery, rebuild lives, strengthen communities and prevent further exploitation.
Hagar Singapore plays an important role in supporting Hagar's international programmes while developing local initiatives aligned with its mission.
We are seeking a committed, resourceful and experienced Programme Manager to help strengthen our programme development, implementation and impact measurement capabilities.
About the Role
The Programme Manager will lead the development, implementation and evaluation of Hagar Singapore's local programmes while supporting overseas field offices in strengthening programme proposals, implementation plans and impact reporting.
This is a dual-portfolio position combining hands-on programme management with international programme development and fundraising enablement.
The successful candidate will work closely with local community partners, Hagar's international field offices, and the Resource Development team to ensure programmes are evidence-based, financially realistic, responsive to community needs and supported by measurable outcomes.
A key responsibility is translating programme needs into compelling concept notes, funding proposals, programme updates and credible impact reports that demonstrate meaningful change in the lives of survivors and vulnerable communities.
The role requires someone who can combine strategic programme thinking with practical implementation, strong stakeholder engagement, analytical capabilities and excellent written communication.
Key Responsibilities
A. Local Programme Development & Implementation (50%)
1. Programme Strategy and Development

• Identify emerging community needs, service gaps and opportunities aligned with Hagar's mission in Singapore.

• Conduct needs assessments, environmental scans, stakeholder consultations and feasibility studies to inform programme development.

• Design local programmes and intervention models addressing survivor recovery, reintegration, prevention, community awareness and trauma-informed care.

• Establish programme objectives, target beneficiaries, eligibility criteria, intended outcomes and sustainability considerations.

• Develop theories of change, logic models, programme plans, implementation schedules and budgets.

• Identify opportunities to pilot, adapt or scale proven Hagar international interventions within the Singapore context.

2. Programme Implementation and Operations

• Lead the planning, coordination and implementation of approved local programmes and pilot initiatives.

• Develop implementation plans, milestones, operating procedures, resource requirements and performance indicators.

• Manage programme budgets, timelines, operational requirements and risks in collaboration with relevant colleagues.

• Coordinate delivery partners, service providers, volunteers and other stakeholders.

• Monitor programme performance, address implementation challenges and recommend corrective actions.

• Ensure programme delivery complies with appropriate professional, ethical, safeguarding and operational standards.

3. Partnership and Stakeholder Engagement

• Develop relationships with government agencies, social service agencies, community organisations, educational institutions and potential programme partners.

• Identify collaborative opportunities that strengthen programme effectiveness, reach and sustainability.

• Establish partnership arrangements with clearly defined objectives, responsibilities and performance expectations.

• Represent Hagar Singapore at relevant programme meetings, sector engagements and stakeholder discussions.

4. Programme Evaluation and Improvement

• Establish appropriate monitoring and evaluation frameworks for local programmes.

• Collect and analyse programme participation, delivery quality, beneficiary feedback and outcome data.

• Conduct regular programme reviews to assess effectiveness, relevance, efficiency and sustainability.

• Identify improvement opportunities and document programme learning and good practices.

• Prepare programme progress reports, case studies and outcome evidence for management, the Board and donors.

B. International Programme Development, Fundraising Enablement & MEL (50%)
1. International Programme Development and Field Collaboration

• Serve as a key programme liaison between Hagar Singapore and relevant international field offices.

• Work with field teams to understand programme priorities, community needs, implementation challenges, resource requirements and funding gaps.

• Review and strengthen programme concept notes, proposals, implementation plans and budgets to improve clarity, quality and funding readiness.

• Support field offices in translating programme activities into clearly articulated objectives, outputs, outcomes and intended long-term impact.

• Ensure programme proposals accurately reflect local conditions, implementation capacity, realistic commitments and community needs.

• Develop and maintain a structured portfolio of funding-ready programme opportunities for Hagar Singapore's Resource Development team.

2. Programme Proposals and Fundraising Support

• Collaborate with the Resource Development team to prepare compelling programme proposals for corporate partners, foundations, family offices, trusts and institutional donors.

• Develop concise programme summaries communicating the scale of the problem, urgency of intervention, proposed solutions and expected benefits to survivors and communities.

• Prepare comprehensive proposals incorporating needs assessments, programme rationale, theories of change, activities, implementation schedules, budgets, risks and measurable outcomes.

• Adapt programme documentation to different donor requirements while maintaining technical accuracy and programme integrity.

• Develop programme briefs, funding presentations, impact summaries and technical information for donor engagement and funding applications.

• Support donor meetings by providing programme insights, implementation details and evidence of outcomes.

• Collaborate with Finance and field offices to ensure programme budgets are realistic, complete and aligned with funding requirements.

3. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL)

• Develop and strengthen practical MEL frameworks for programmes supported by Hagar Singapore.

• Define appropriate performance indicators, baselines, targets, data sources, reporting frequencies and accountability arrangements.

• Ensure programmes clearly distinguish between activities, outputs, outcomes and longer-term impact.

• Establish reporting templates and programme dashboards to monitor implementation progress, funding utilisation and programme performance.

• Coordinate regular programme reviews with field offices to assess achievements, emerging risks, implementation challenges and learning opportunities.

• Support the collection and interpretation of quantitative and qualitative programme evidence, including beneficiary feedback and appropriately consented case studies.

• Translate programme results into accessible, credible donor-facing reports and impact narratives.

• Ensure impact claims are supported by appropriate evidence and distinguish verified results from anticipated longer-term changes.

4. Grant Management and Donor Accountability

• Maintain accurate programme records covering funding commitments, deliverables, milestones, reporting obligations and implementation progress.

• Coordinate with field offices, Finance and Resource Development to monitor programme expenditure against approved budgets.

• Track delivery against donor commitments and escalate material delays, budget variances and implementation risks.

• Coordinate timely preparation of programme updates, narrative reports and impact reports.

• Support donor visits, programme briefings, project reviews and due diligence processes.

• Maintain programme documentation and appropriate audit trails to support transparency, accountability and responsible stewardship of donor funds.

5. Programme Knowledge Management

• Develop and maintain a central repository of programme concept notes, proposals, budgets, results frameworks, progress reports and case studies.

• Establish common templates and minimum quality standards for programme documentation used in fundraising.

• Document effective interventions, implementation learning and programme outcomes across the Hagar network.

• Support consistent, evidence-based programme narratives that strengthen Hagar Singapore's credibility with donors and partners.

C. Cross-Cutting Responsibilities

• Uphold Hagar's survivor-centred and trauma-informed principles across programme design, implementation and reporting.

• Ensure appropriate safeguarding, confidentiality, consent and personal data protection practices.

• Promote meaningful participation and feedback from survivors and communities while minimising potential risks and burdens.

• Collaborate effectively with programme, fundraising, finance and international teams.

• Contribute to annual planning, organisational reporting, risk management and continuous improvement.

• Undertake other relevant responsibilities assigned by the Executive Director.

Requirements
Education and Professional Experience

• Bachelor's degree or Graduate Diploma in Social Work, Social Sciences, International Development, Psychology, Public Health or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.

• Minimum five years of relevant experience in programme development, programme management or social service delivery.

• Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, managing and evaluating social programmes.

• Experience preparing programme concept notes, funding proposals, implementation plans and budgets.

• Experience working with community partners, social service agencies, donors or international programme teams.

Technical Competencies

• Sound knowledge of programme planning, project management and implementation methodologies.

• Working knowledge of theories of change, logic models, results frameworks, performance indicators and outcome evaluation.

• Ability to translate community needs into structured programme interventions with measurable results.

• Strong proposal-writing skills, including the ability to communicate programme needs, urgency, interventions and expected outcomes to potential donors.

• Financial literacy, including programme budgeting, expenditure monitoring and grant accountability.

• Ability to analyse programme data and translate findings into meaningful reports and impact narratives.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, project management applications and basic reporting or dashboard tools.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Personal Attributes

• Strong commitment to Hagar's mission and the dignity, safety and wellbeing of survivors.

• Strategic and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving capabilities.

• Hands-on, resourceful and able to manage multiple priorities within a lean organisational environment.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate across cultures and organisational boundaries.

• Empathetic, culturally sensitive and committed to ethical, survivor-centred programming.

• Self-motivated, organised and accountable for delivering agreed outcomes.

• Comfortable working independently while contributing actively to a collaborative team.

Desirable Experience

• Familiarity with trauma-informed care, survivor rehabilitation, human trafficking prevention or safeguarding.

• Experience within Singapore's social service sector or international development organisations.

• Experience working with overseas programme teams or managing donor-funded programmes.

• Exposure to programme impact measurement, results-based management or grant reporting.

What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will contribute to:

• Developing and implementing credible, sustainable local programmes aligned with Hagar Singapore's mission.

• Building strong local programme partnerships and expanding opportunities for meaningful community impact.

• Strengthening the quality and funding readiness of international programme proposals.

• Equipping the Resource Development team with compelling, evidence-based programme propositions.

• Establishing practical MEL frameworks that demonstrate programme outputs, outcomes and longer-term impact.

• Improving programme reporting, donor accountability and organisational learning.

• Strengthening collaboration between Hagar Singapore and international field offices.

Why Join Hagar Singapore?
This is an opportunity to contribute directly to an organisation committed to helping survivors of human trafficking, modern slavery and abuse rebuild their lives.
You will have the opportunity to develop local initiatives, collaborate with international programme teams and help strengthen the connection between programme delivery, funding support and measurable social impact.
We are looking for someone who believes that good programmes should not only deliver activities but also demonstrate meaningful and lasting change in the lives of the people and communities they serve.
Join us in strengthening programmes, supporting survivors and creating meaningful, measurable impact.
