description:
About Dayos
Dayos is the AI-first version of the systems integrators and application management firms that have supported enterprise ERPs for decades. We're building this company in Singapore, for the long term.

Hero, our platform, doesn't just watch your systems. It logs in, does the work, and validates the output inside Oracle, Workday and SAP. At a Singapore enterprise, Hero closed 9 of 10 support tickets that had been open for an average of three weeks, taking roughly 10 minutes per request.

Every company in the world runs Oracle, Workday or SAP, and many run more than one. Yet no school teaches students how to implement and manage them, and fewer people do this work every year. That gap is what we're built to close.

Enterprises spend billions every year supporting these systems, and much of that work is still manual. Three years building Hero. Enterprise customers already in production. Now we're closing our seed round and building the Singapore go-to-market team from the ground up.

The Role
We're building our first Pre-Sales Consultant team in Singapore. This is a clear career path into enterprise AI sales, and it is not a high-volume seat. You'll research deeply, form a point of view, and open enterprise accounts other people can't.

You'll open accounts at the Oracle, Workday and SAP enterprises across Singapore and Southeast Asia who are quietly frustrated with what they're paying for support and what they're getting back. Your job is to find them, understand what's actually broken, and get them into a conversation with us.

You'll work directly with our founder, who runs every demo and owns every deal cycle as your Account Executive and serves as your workplace mentor. The AE owns the deal cycle, but the top of that cycle is yours: the research, the first outreach, the initial framing of the problem in our terms, and the handoff once the conversation is real.

You're not joining an established sales machine. You're helping build one. You'll be one of the first Pre-Sales Consultants on our team, learning together, competing for the best accounts, and writing the Singapore outbound playbook that every hire after you will follow.

This will be demanding. Enterprise sales means rejection, ambiguity and uncomfortable conversations with senior people. We'll give you unusual responsibility early, and we expect you to grow into it quickly.

Employment type: Full-time, permanent (12-month minimum commitment). Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents. Location: Singapore, on-site. Start date: December 2026 or January 2027.

What You'll Do
- Own the top of the funnel across a named-account territory of Oracle, Workday and SAP customers in the region
- Research the accounts struggling with the cost, responsiveness or quality of their current ERP and HCM support, and work out where Hero fits
- Write outreach that earns a reply. Across call, LinkedIn and email.
- Run discovery with the accounts that engage, and work out what's actually broken in their support model: tickets, cost, turnaround and quality
- Explain Hero in the buyer's terms, and answer first-line technical and commercial questions before the deal moves to your Account Executive
- Partner with your Account Executive on account strategy, and hand off qualified conversations when the fit is clear
- Join every demo you source and learn how enterprise deals actually close
- Feed the market back to us. You'll often know the market's real objection before anyone else in the company does
- Build pipeline strategy for a named territory, track outreach, reply and demo-booking rates, and defend it in weekly reviews with the founder
- Negotiate agreed next steps, demo commitments and scope with senior buyers, and support your Account Executive in first-line commercial discussions on Starter and Pro, to reach outcomes that work for both sides
- Use data analytics and AI tools to analyse outreach, reply and demo-booking data, build dashboards in HubSpot and Google Sheets, and generate insights that predict which target accounts are most likely to convert
- Document the Singapore outbound playbook from call reviews and live accounts, and coach the Pre-Sales Consultants who join after you on what works

Your Career Path
Our route to Account Executive runs through Solutions Engineering. We think the people who sell Hero should be able to demo it themselves.
- Months 0-3. Master enterprise prospecting, Hero, Oracle/Workday/SAP economics and executive outreach, with live shadowing on active accounts
- Months 3-6. Own account strategy and qualified pipeline across your named enterprise accounts, with weekly 1:1s with the founder
- Months 6-12. Begin running discovery and participating directly in enterprise deal cycles alongside our founder
- After 12 months, Solutions Engineer. Top-performing Pre-Sales Consultants who hit quota are considered for our Solutions Engineering training programme. You run your own demos and your base goes up 20%
- Next, Account Executive. Top-performing Solutions Engineers who make quota are considered for promotion, with another 20% raise

What You Bring
Formal sales experience isn't expected.
- Charisma and hustle. You read a room fast, get people talking, and don't wait for someone to hand you the next move
- Evidence of unusual performance. Your career, athletics, building something of your own, fundraising, sales: anywhere the results were measurable and stood out
- Real curiosity about big enterprises. You want to understand why a Fortune 500 finance team is stuck on a support ticket for three weeks, and you'll dig until you know
- Work experience outside sales. Finance, HR, procurement, IT or anywhere else. If you've worked inside Oracle, Workday or SAP, even better
- A strong writer. You can turn ten minutes of research on a company into a three-sentence email a CIO actually reads
- A strong communicator on the phone. You build rapport fast and hold your own with senior finance, procurement and HR leaders
- Resilient by disposition. Cold outreach means constant no's, and you treat each one as information about the market
- A growth mindset. You want the hard feedback from call reviews because it's the fastest way to get better
- Fluent with AI tools. You use them daily and have a point of view on how a lean go-to-market team should run on them

What You'll Learn
By the end of your first year, with weekly call reviews and direct coaching from our founder:
- Communicate with senior finance, IT and procurement leaders, handle objections, and hold your own in executive-level conversations
- Speak fluently about Oracle, Workday and SAP economics: what they cost, what they replace, and where they fail
- Understand how AI is reshaping enterprise operations, not at a headline level but in the details buyers care about
- Build pipeline strategy for a named territory and defend it in weekly reviews
- Run discovery, qualify opportunities, and progress deals toward close

Compensation and Benefits
- Base salary. S$3,000 to S$5,600 per month, depending on experience
- Commission. S$700 per qualified demo held, S$2,400 when that demo closes as Starter, S$3,600 when it closes as Pro. Uncapped, with accelerators above quota
- Career growth. +20% base on promotion to Solutions Engineer, another +20% on promotion to Account Executive
- Leave. Unlimited PTO, plus Singapore public holidays
- Medical. Comprehensive coverage included
- CPF. Contributions for eligible employees
- Global exposure. Customers across Southeast Asia, North America and Europe. Regional travel comes with the seat as accounts mature
- Equipment. Whatever you need to do the job well

Interview Process
- Phone screen, 30 minutes. Align on the role, your background and timing
- Written exercise. A short research task on a real enterprise, and the outreach you'd write off it
- Role play, 45 minutes. A cold call and an objection-handling scenario, together
- Founder conversation, 30 minutes. Mission, expectations, mutual fit

Founded in 1978 as Singapore's first family service centre, Allkin Singapore is a community-centric social service agency that believes everyone has the potential to create positive change, regardless of age, race, or background.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Allkin Singapore is a social service organisation that believes in the power of community to drive change. We work alongside partners and residents to strengthen families, build social connections, and foster a culture of care and contribution.

As Executive, Fundraising & Partnerships, you will play a key role in supporting fundraising initiatives and strategic partnerships that help sustain and grow our impact. Working closely with the Senior Executive, you will contribute to donor engagement, partnership development, fundraising campaigns, impact reporting, and stakeholder stewardship. This role is ideal for a resourceful and organised individual who is passionate about building meaningful partnerships and advancing positive social outcomes.

• Research and identify prospective donors, corporate partners, foundations, grantmakers, and funding opportunities.

• Support donor outreach, cultivation, and engagement activities.

• Donor & Partner Engagement

• Build and maintain positive, long-term relationships with donors and partners.

• Impact Reporting & Accountability

• Compile programme outcomes, impact data, and beneficiary stories for donor reporting.

• Prepare donor impact reports, partnership updates, and stewardship materials.

• Track reporting timelines, funding utilisation, and donor requirements.

• Support data collection and impact tracking to demonstrate the outcomes of donor and partner support.

• Fundraising Campaigns & Events

• Coordinate internal teams, partners, vendors, and service providers to ensure successful event delivery.

• Work with the communications team to develop fundraising content and campaign materials.

• Assist with post-campaign reporting, evaluation, and donor follow-up activities.

• Operations & Administration

• Maintain accurate donor, donation, and partnership records within relevant systems.

• Support fundraising reporting, budget tracking, invoice processing, and reconciliation activities.

• Monitor fundraising performance and prepare regular management updates.

• Ensure proper documentation and compliance with governance, audit, and reporting requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Social Sciences, or a related field.

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in fundraising, partnerships, marketing, stakeholder engagement, or a related function.

• Prior experience in the social service or non-profit sector is preferred but not essential.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse stakeholders.

• Experience in donor management, event coordination, CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce), and digital marketing will be an advantage.

• Passionate about community impact and committed to advancing Allkin Singapore's mission through meaningful partnerships and fundraising initiatives.

• Professional integrity with a collaborative, customer-centric approach and commitment to excellence.

description:
About Us
We are a Singapore-based investment company with exposure across global index ETFs, bonds, hedge funds, private credit, private equity (funds and direct investments), real estate and digital assets within approved limits. We operate through an institutionalised investment process with tiered due diligence, independent risk review and Investment Committee decision-making.
Role Overview
This is a hands-on investment role in a lean family office for an experienced professional who can take substantial ownership of the full investment lifecycle - from opportunity screening, analysis and due diligence through Investment Committee approval, transaction execution, ongoing monitoring and eventual exit. The role also contributes to portfolio implementation and monitoring within the CIO/IC-approved framework.
Candidates with approximately 6 years of relevant experience may be considered at Senior Investment Analyst level. Candidates demonstrating independent transaction ownership may be appointed Investment Manager. Candidates with strong portfolio-management experience - including portfolio construction, asset allocation and SAA/TAA - may be appointed Portfolio Manager.
Key Responsibilities
· Screen and prioritise fund, manager, private credit, private equity direct and co-investment opportunities and maintain a clear investment pipeline.
· Lead qualitative and quantitative fund/manager due diligence, including investment process, performance, risk, capacity, fees, terms, operational due diligence and conflicts.
· Lead or coordinate commercial, financial and investment due diligence on private equity direct and co-investments, including external legal, tax, financial and valuation work where required.
· Build and review financial models and analyse LPAs, PPMs, term sheets, shareholder agreements and transaction structures, identifying material commercial terms, downside protections and exit mechanics.
· Prepare concise, decision-ready investment memoranda and Investment Committee materials, and clearly present recommendations, key risks, open items and proposed mitigants.
· Support and, where assigned, independently manage post-IC execution, signing/closing, ongoing monitoring and eventual exit, coordinating with advisers, counterparties and financial institutions.
· Monitor portfolio positioning, liquidity, concentration and manager/fund exposures and recommend sizing, funding, rebalancing orhold/increase/reduce/exit actions within the approved framework.
Essential Requirements
· 6+ years of relevant experience in buy-side investing, family office, FoF/fund research, private equity, private credit, investment banking M&A or transaction services.
· Demonstrated hands-on experience taking ownership of end-to-end private investment transactions, including due diligence, structuring, adviser coordination, negotiation support, signing/closing and post-investment follow-up.
· Experience across fund/manager due diligence and direct/co-investment analysis, with strong financial modelling capability.
· Ability to independently read and analyse LPAs, PPMs, term sheets, shareholder agreements and related investment documents and identify the commercial implications of key provisions.
· Ability to assess liquidity, concentration, asset allocation and portfolio fit. Candidates considered for Portfolio Manager title should demonstrate strong portfolio construction, asset allocation and SAA/ TAA experience.
· Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to produce decision-ready Investment Committee materials and clearly articulate investment risks and open issues.
Preferred
· Multi-asset family office, FoF, private markets or portfolio-management experience.
· CFA, CAIA, CPA/CA or another relevant professional qualification; practical investment capability remains the primary consideration.
· Familiarity with PitchBook, Preqin, eFront or similar databases/systems.
· Relevant investment, GP, private-bank or professional networks in Singapore and/or China.

Project Description:
This role sits within a small team (~5) supporting Public Markets activities within a Singapore sovereign fund.
The role is responsible for driving and coordinating delivery of Public Markets data, reporting and analytics initiatives, working closely with front office, middle office, investment operations and technology/data teams.
The successful candidate will combine strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities with practical understanding of Public/Private Markets and investment data. The role requires the ability to take initiatives from problem definition and requirements through planning, execution, testing, implementation and BAU transition.

Responsibilities:
• Lead and coordinate Public/Private Markets data, reporting and analytics projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring clear scope, milestones, dependencies, deliverables and ownership.
• Work with front and middle-office stakeholders to understand business problems, define project objectives and translate investment requirements into actionable project deliverables.
• Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, logs, dependencies and delivery tracking, proactively identifying risks and driving resolution.
• Coordinate across business, data, technology and operations teams to ensure requirements, data dependencies, development, testing and implementation activities remain aligned.
• Facilitate requirements gathering, prioritisation and scope management, ensuring project outcomes remain aligned with business priorities and agreed objectives.
• Drive UAT, issue resolution and implementation readiness, coordinating business validation and ensuring identified defects or data issues are appropriately tracked through to closure.
• Provide regular project status reporting and stakeholder updates, highlighting progress, key decisions, risks, issues, dependencies and areas requiring escalation.
• Apply Public/Private Markets domain knowledge to challenge requirements, identify gaps and validate whether proposed solutions and data outputs are consistent with investment and operational processes.
• Support BAU transition and post-implementation stabilisation, ensuring delivered solutions have appropriate documentation, controls, ownership and support processes.
• Where required, remain hands-on in data analysis and SQL-based investigation to support project delivery, troubleshoot issues and validate investment data and reporting outcomes.

Mandatory Skills Description:
6–8 years (indicative) of relevant experience in:
• Project management / delivery roles within asset management, investment management, banking or financial services OR business/data analyst roles with significant responsibility for delivering investment, portfolio or data-related projects.
• Demonstrated experience in end-to-end project delivery, including project planning, stakeholder management, requirements, dependencies, risk/issues management, UAT, implementation and BAU transition.
• Strong business analysis, project management and stakeholder management capabilities with practical understanding of Public Markets and investment data
• Understanding of investment data concepts such as positions, transactions, P&L, exposures and portfolio data, sufficient to effectively manage projects involving investment data and reporting.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across front office, middle office, operations, technology and data teams and drive alignment across different stakeholder groups.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to understand data issues, assess root causes and drive issues to resolution.
• Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and fast-moving environments, taking ownership of deliverables and driving progress with limited guidance.
• Strong communication skills, including the ability to present project status, articulate risks and dependencies, facilitate decisions and communicate complex investment/data topics to different audiences.
• Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to independently investigate data issues, validate requirements and support project delivery.

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:
• Experience delivering Public Markets portfolio monitoring, investment reporting, data platform or analytics projects.
• Experience working with Tableau or similar BI tools.
• Experience with Snowflake or other data platforms / analytical data layers.
• Experience managing projects using JIRA, Confluence or similar project delivery tools.
• Experience with data migration, data quality, reconciliation, UAT and implementation activities.
• Experience working in Agile / iterative delivery environments.

Job Description
As a Technical Pre-Sales Business Consultant, you will work closely with the Business Development Director and business development team to understand clients' business and technical requirements, translate those requirements into suitable solutions, and support the team throughout the sales and solution-development process.
You will act as a bridge between clients, the commercial team, technology partners and solution providers. The role combines technical understanding, business analysis, client engagement and consultative solution development. You do not need to be a software developer, but you should be comfortable understanding how technologies and systems work and explaining them clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You will gain hands-on exposure to Nabcore's physical and digital brand protection, product authentication, tracking and anti-counterfeiting solutions. You will participate in client discovery sessions, solution design, demonstrations, proof-of-concept activities, proposal preparation and technical-commercial presentations.
You will be expected to understand the client's problem before recommending a solution. As your product and industry knowledge develops, you will progressively take greater ownership of solution discussions, technical presentations, proposals and pre-sales engagements.
For experienced professionals transitioning from another industry, we recognise that you may bring valuable transferable capabilities in areas such as Sales, IT, Enterprise solutions, Project management, Operations, Consulting, Technical sales, Account management or Customer engagement.

Job Requirement
We welcome candidates from different career stages and professional backgrounds. Prior experience in brand protection or anti-counterfeiting is not essential. We are interested in your technical aptitude, problem-solving ability, client-facing capabilities, potential, attitude and transferable experience.
• Interest in technology, business problem-solving and client-facing work.
• Ability to understand technical concepts and translate them into practical business solutions.
• Good written, verbal and presentation skills.
• Confidence engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, industries and business models.
• Resourcefulness and the ability to work through unfamiliar challenges.
• Initiative, ownership and the ability to follow through on commitments.
• Good organisation and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a dynamic SME environment.

• Technical pre-sales or solutions consulting
• Software, SaaS or enterprise technology
• Engineering or technical project management
• Business analysis
• Implementation or solution delivery
• Technical account management or customer success
• Technology consulting
• Operations involving technology or process improvement
• Business development with strong technical exposure
Fresh graduates, experienced professionals, candidates affected by restructuring or retrenchment, individuals returning to the workforce, and candidates seeking a career transition are welcome to apply. Moving into a new industry does not mean starting from zero; relevant transferable experience can provide a strong foundation for this role.

• Market, Product & Technology Intelligence: Research competitors, market trends and emerging technologies, and identify potential technology partners and new capabilities that can strengthen Nabcore’s solutions.
• Projects & Continuous Improvement: Participate in client and internal projects, collaborate with relevant stakeholders, document outcomes and continuously improve pre-sales processes, solution materials and client experience.
• Ownership & Delivery: Take ownership of assigned tasks and projects, ensuring agreed deliverables are completed effectively and on time

What You Can Develop at Nabcore
· Technical pre-sales and consultative solution selling
· Business and technical requirements analysis
· Solution design and solution architecture thinking
· Client discovery and stakeholder engagement
· Product and solution demonstrations
· Proof-of-concept and pilot planning
· Proposal, RFI, RFP and tender preparation
· Technical-commercial presentations
· Project coordination and implementation handover
· Brand protection and anti-counterfeiting technologies

The Account/Sales Manager (Automation) drives revenue growth bycultivating automation project opportunities within both existing clientaccounts and new prospective customers. description:
About Resaro
Resaro was founded on the belief that AI will change the world in ways we cannot even imagine, but every new technology needs safeguards to advance.
Resaro builds custom AI testing software that helps organisations validate the performance, robustness, and safety of mission-critical AI systems, spanning computer vision, generative AI, and autonomous systems. Our clients include government, military, and commercial organisations deploying AI in high-stakes environments. We work through embedded teams deployed on-site or closely integrated with our clients.
The Role
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Strategist to serve as the primary technical point of contact and strategic bridge between our clients, sales, product, and engineering teams.
In this hybrid technical-commercial role, you will lead solution design and technical pre-sales across Computer Vision, Generative AI, and Embodied AI / Autonomy verification and validation (V&V) programs. You will work closely with client executives, AI engineers, risk, compliance, and procurement teams to transform experimental AI concepts into durable, safe, and secure production deployments.
What You’ll Do
Lead Strategic Client Engagement & Technical Pre-Sales:

• Act as the first technical point of contact during pre-sales discussions, technical workshops, demos, and solution-design sessions for enterprise and defence clients.

• Build trusted relationships across business leadership, AI engineering, risk, governance, and security stakeholders.

• Scope complex client requirements across vision model assurance, LLM safety, and UGV/robotics autonomy testing into formal technical specifications and test strategies

Drive Forward Deployment & Solution Architecture:

• Design solution architectures that map client needs directly to Resaro’s AI assurance platform capabilities.

• Redesign operational evaluation processes and workflows to help clients navigate risk, streamline approval pathways, and accelerate deployment.

• Serve as the technical feasibility anchor—pushing back constructively on unrealistic requests, guiding client expectations toward workable alternatives, and informing internal product roadmap priorities.

• Advise clients on evaluation methodologies, including Operational Design Domain (ODD) specification, scenario design, simulation-based and real-world V&V, and model robustness testing.

Bridge Commercial, Engineering, & Field Execution:

• Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to ensure seamless handovers from scoping to on-site execution.

• Maintain long-term technical relationships with key government, military, and enterprise accounts to uncover expansion pathways.

• Lead technical proposal writing, RFP responses, and requirements documentation.

• Translate client deployment learnings into scalable playbooks and best practices.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience: 5 to 10 years of experience in technical consulting, ML/AI engineering, or solution architecture, forward deployment roles with heavy customer-facing scoping experience.

• Technical Breadth: Strong technical depth spanning Computer Vision, Generative AI / LLM evaluation, and Embodied AI / Robotics (perception stacks, ROS, simulation, sensor data analysis).

• Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of engaging credibly with both C-suite executives and hands-on ML engineers.

• Analytical & Scoping Depth: Ability to draft formal requirements, craft detailed test strategies, and contribute to complex RFP responses.

• Execution & Autonomy: High degree of self-direction, comfort operating in ambiguous environments, and sound technical judgment under incomplete information.

• T-Shaped Profile: Broad working knowledge across enterprise cloud and AI infrastructure paired with deep specialization in AI testing or V&V.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on experience with AI evaluation harnesses, red-teaming, guardrails, or model safety cases.

• Familiarity with robotics/autonomy V&V tooling (e.g., CARLA, Isaac Sim, Applied Intuition, Foretellix, OpenSCENARIO/OpenODD, rosbag/lidar analysis).

• Working knowledge of AI safety standards and governance frameworks (e.g., ISO 26262, SOTIF, ISO 34503, DO-178C).

• Background or existing network in Singapore government or defence procurement ecosystems.

• Experience with enterprise software implementations (e.g., Palantir, Applied Intuition, or top-tier management consulting).

Job Description

• Testing Strategy & Roadmaps: Establish standardized testing frameworks and site-specific commissioning schedules, ensuring all activity aligns with project milestones, allocated budgets, and hyperscale quality benchmarks.

• Technical Scripting & Protocol Governance: Draft and sign off on rigorous validation procedures, test scripts, and pass/fail thresholds tailored to complex electrical and thermal topologies.

• Procurement & Vendor Leadership: Manage technical scoping, RFP creation, and procurement for third-party commissioning agents (CxA) and specialist testing contractors; govern partner performance via regular delivery audits and scorecards.

• Field Execution & Milestone Verification: Oversee factory and site testing phases (FAT/SAT), pre-functional checks, individual component verification, and Integrated Systems Testing (IST) to validate compliance with owner project requirements.

• Cross-Phase Handover: Partner closely with construction managers to verify mechanical/electrical completion before energization, and lead the final turnover to site operations teams (including operations walkthroughs and systems training).

• Defect & Punch-List Resolution: Drive root-cause assessments of field anomalies, enforce strict QA/QC compliance, and shepherd punch-list issues through to resolution prior to final sign-off.

• Stakeholder Reporting: Lead technical review sessions and provide transparent reporting to leadership on schedule adherence, Ready for Service (RFS) targets, scope variance, and field risks.

• Continuous Feedback: Extract operational lessons from completed builds to update regional design standards, enhance testing efficiency, and lower total commissioning costs on future projects.

Qualifications

• Education & Industry Background:

• Bachelor’s/Master’s/Ph.D. degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline with 8+ years of technical project delivery experience; OR

• Mission-Critical Experience:

• Minimum of 5 years dedicated to building, commissioning, or technically managing mission-critical facilities (data centers, semiconductor fabs, or critical energy plants).

• Core Technical Competencies:

• Proven capability drafting complex commissioning scripts, sequences of operation, and integrated test procedures.

• Practical understanding of data center life-safety, power distribution (HV/MV/LV, UPS, backup generation), and precision thermal topologies.

• Proficiency with project management and documentation toolsets (MS Office suite, Visio, scheduling software).

• Mobility & Compliance: Willingness to travel to project sites as needed.

Preferred Credentials

• Active professional credential in commissioning or facility validation (e.g., ASHRAE BCxP, ACG CxA, or BCA CCP).

• Established health and safety certifications (e.g., OSHA 30-Hour or equivalent local safety accreditation).

• Formal training or certification in electrical workplace safety practices (such as NFPA 70E compliance).

• Certified Project Management Professional (PMP).

• Subject-matter depth across advanced cooling topologies (direct-to-chip, liquid immersion, high-efficiency chilled water loops) and supervisory control architectures (EPMS, BMS, DCIM).

description:
Resmed is transforming its global supply chain and manufacturing technology landscape to improve efficiency, traceability, compliance and capacity across its manufacturing network.
We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to lead the technology products supporting warehousing and material flow within our factories. This includes the systems and processes that enable raw-material receipt, warehouse operations, material staging and replenishment to manufacturing lines, receipt of finished goods and movement to distribution centres.
Reporting to the Senior Director, Business Partner for Manufacturing, you will connect operational priorities with technology strategy and delivery. You will take technical ownership of the relevant application landscape, shape platform capabilities, establish roadmap priorities and lead products through implementation and their ongoing lifecycle.
This is a senior technology leadership role requiring strong product judgement, manufacturing knowledge and the ability to influence senior leaders across the business and GTS. The role may include direct people leadership or leadership through clearly defined outcomes and performance measures.
What You’ll Do
Warehousing & Material Flow Product Strategy and Roadmap

• Translate manufacturing needs and business outcomes into a clear technical product strategy, roadmap and prioritized delivery plan.

• Own the technology direction and product capabilities supporting factory warehouse operations and material movement.

• Define the end-to-end technology scope across goods receipt, put-away, storage, inventory movements, material staging, line-side replenishment, finished-goods receipt and outbound warehouse movement.

• Assess competing requirements according to their operational value, including their potential to reduce lead times, improve warehouse utilization and support more efficient material flow.

• Develop scalable capabilities that can be introduced at one manufacturing site and subsequently adopted across the wider global network.

Platform, Automation and Partner Selection

• Lead the evaluation and selection of warehouse applications, platforms and automation technologies.

• Support RFI and RFP activities through vendor assessments, solution demonstrations, technical due diligence, fit-gap analysis and integration reviews.

• Evaluate both the technology platform and the implementation partner needed to deliver the solution successfully.

• Make informed decisions across configuration, extension and integration, maximizing standard platform capabilities while controlling unnecessary customization and technical debt.

Product Governance and Global Standards

• Establish governance for product priorities and determine which requirements deliver the greatest business value.

• Define global standards and reusable capabilities that can operate across Resmed’s manufacturing network.

• Set clear product guardrails and guide significant warehouse and material flow design decisions.

• Work with Business Product Owners, manufacturing stakeholders, architects, business analysts, vendors and system integration partners to create scalable and supportable solutions.

• Enable justified local variation without compromising global standards or long-term product sustainability.

Solution Delivery, Quality and Compliance

• Convert business and user requirements into a structured technical backlog, product capabilities and a practical delivery sequence.

• Prioritize requirements across WMS, WCS, ERP integrations, automation, security, non-functional needs, technical enablers and release dependencies.

• Guide key decisions, risks, dependencies and trade-offs throughout design, implementation, validation, deployment and ongoing support.

• Hold delivery teams, vendors and system integration partners accountable for quality and long-term supportability.

• Partner with quality, regulatory and validation teams to ensure solutions meet relevant quality gates, traceability, data integrity, audit and compliance requirements.

Value Realization and Adoption

• Establish clear business outcomes, adoption objectives and measures of success with Business Product Owners.

• Ensure product priorities are informed by the value delivered to manufacturing and material flow operations.

• Monitor adoption and product performance, using operational insights to guide roadmap decisions and continuous improvement.

• Promote outcomes such as shorter material lead times, improved warehouse utilization and more efficient movement of materials across the factory.

Product Lifecycle and Vendor Management

• Lead the technology product across implementation, deployment, adoption and its ongoing operational lifecycle.

• Own release and upgrade planning, platform health, technical debt, support strategy and vendor roadmap alignment.

• Manage strategic relationships with warehouse technology, automation and implementation partners.

• Lead technical escalations and ensure that product decisions remain aligned with Resmed’s long-term manufacturing technology strategy.

Innovation and Product Leadership

• Contribute to Resmed’s digital transformation by identifying opportunities to modernize warehousing and material flow.

• Evaluate smart warehousing, intralogistics and automation capabilities that can progressively reduce manual touchpoints.

• Influence senior business and GTS leaders on roadmap priorities, investment proposals and product trade-offs.

• Provide clear leadership across business, product, architecture, delivery, vendor and system integrator teams.

• Build a collaborative and accountable product culture focused on business value, standardization, quality and continuous improvement.

What You Bring

• At least 10 years of experience delivering medium-to-large enterprise technology solutions across product ownership, programme leadership, business analysis, requirements, solution design or technical delivery.

• Strong experience implementing or managing enterprise applications or technology platforms within a manufacturing environment.

• A sound understanding of manufacturing and supply chain processes, including how materials move through warehouse and production environments.

• The ability to translate operational requirements into platform capabilities, product roadmaps, prioritized backlogs and sequenced delivery plans.

• Experience determining business value and prioritizing investments according to operational impact, technical feasibility, risk and long-term supportability.

• An understanding of how ERP and warehouse management platforms interact within a manufacturing technology landscape. Experience may be gained with Oracle, SAP or an equivalent enterprise platform.

• Experience leading products or platforms through implementation, validation, deployment and ongoing lifecycle management.

• Strong stakeholder leadership, with the credibility to shape proposals and influence senior business and technology leaders.

• Experience working with delivery teams, technology vendors and system integration partners.

• Knowledge of validation frameworks, quality gates, data integrity, traceability and compliance requirements.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make complex technology decisions understandable to technical and non-technical audiences.

• A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience with Warehouse Management Systems, Warehouse Control Systems, intralogistics automation or comparable manufacturing applications.

• Experience with Oracle ERP, SAP or similar systems, particularly integrations between ERP, WMS, WCS and manufacturing applications.

• Experience leading digital transformation within manufacturing or supply chain operations.

• Experience in medical technology, life sciences, pharmaceuticals or another regulated manufacturing sector.

• Candidates from other manufacturing sectors may also be suitable where they have worked with structured validation frameworks, quality gates and compliance requirements.

• Experience in advanced manufacturing environments involving assembly and testing operations.

• Knowledge of smart warehousing technologies such as ASRS, conveyors, AMRs, AGVs, industrial IoT or equipment connectivity.

• Experience with vendor selection, RFI/RFP processes, technical evaluations, fit-gap assessments and implementation-partner engagement.

• Experience managing a team or leading people through defined objectives, performance measures and delivery outcomes.

• Proficiency with Jira, Confluence or comparable product delivery and documentation tools.

• An MBA or relevant advanced degree in Information Systems, Technology, Business or Operations

description:
Role overview:
The Cash Management Implementation Manager owns client onboarding for Transaction Banking, taking corporate and institutional clients from signed mandate to live, stable usage. The role covers cash management (accounts, liquidity and payment/collection services), SWIFT connectivity (MT/MX, FileAct), host-to-host (H2H) integration, online banking and e-commerce collection solutions.
You will be working closely with Corporate Banking, Product, IT, Operations, Legal & Compliance and China Head Office to deliver complex mandates on time, within risk appetite, and with a strong client experience.
Key responsibilities:
Client implementation and onboarding
• Lead end-to-end implementation of cash management mandates, from kick-off and requirements gathering through solution design, documentation, testing, go-live and post-implementation support.
• Act as the client's main point of contact during onboarding, running project plans, status meetings and issue logs to ensure timely and accurate delivery.
• Ensure complete and accurate onboarding documentation and system set-up, in line with KYC, legal and internal control requirements.
Connectivity and channels
• Implement host-to-host connectivity, including SFTP set-up, encryption/key exchange, file format mapping (ISO 20022 pain/camt, MT940/942, CSV and proprietary formats) and acknowledgement/status reporting.
• Onboard clients onto SWIFT channels (MT101, MT940/942, ISO 20022 MX, SCORE/FileAct), coordinating BIC/RMA set-up and testing with clients and Operations.
• Implement cross-border cash pooling structures, covering structure set-up, participating account linkage, sweep rules and testing with clients and China Head Office.
• Set up and configure online banking for corporate clients, including user entitlements, approval workflows, token/authentication set-up and user training.
• Implement e-commerce and digital collection solutions (e.g. payment gateway, PayNow/QR, virtual accounts, eGIRO/direct debit), including merchant onboarding, API/plug-in integration and reconciliation set-up.
Testing and go-live
• Plan and coordinate connectivity and user acceptance testing (UAT) with clients, IT and Head Office, track defects to resolution, and obtain sign-off before go-live.
• Manage go-live cutover, monitor initial live transactions, and resolve post-implementation queries and incidents promptly.
Stakeholder management and pre-sales support
• Partner with Corporate Banking and Product teams in pre-sales, providing technical and implementation input to proposals, solution designs and RFP responses.
• Liaise with China Head Office and IT on system configuration, enhancements and change requests to meet local client requirements.
• Provide clear implementation updates and pipeline reporting to management.
Process, risk and continuous improvement
• Develop, maintain and execute implementation procedures, checklists and templates; identify and streamline processes to shorten time-to-revenue and improve client experience.
• Ensure implementations comply with internal policies, MAS regulations, technology risk management guidelines and audit requirements; support risk assessments, audits and control testing.
• Capture client feedback and recurring issues, and feed them into the product roadmap and system enhancement requests.
• Keep abreast of market developments, including ISO 20022 migration, API banking and new payment rails, and help the team adapt implementation capabilities accordingly.

Requirements:
• A recognised university degree in Banking, Finance, Business, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent professional qualifications.
• At least 5 years of experience in cash management implementation, client onboarding, client service or channels management at a financial institution.
• Hands-on experience implementing: host-to-host, SWIFT, corporate online banking, or e-commerce/digital collection solutions.
• Good working knowledge of payment and collection products, clearing systems (e.g. MEPS+, FAST, GIRO, PayNow) and cross-border payment flows.
• Familiarity with banking file formats and standards (ISO 20022, SWIFT MT, BAI2, CSV), SFTP/encryption, APIs and ERP integration (e.g. SAP, Oracle).
• Strong project management skills, with proven ability to run multiple implementations in parallel and meet deadlines.
• Effectively bilingual in English and Chinese, to communicate with China Head Office and Chinese-speaking clients.
• Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage client treasury and IT teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a high sense of ownership.
• Positive, resourceful and independent, with the ability to multi-task under pressure.

description:
Programme Duration: 6 Months
Experience Level: Entry Level
Company Overview
Our client is an established organisation within the financial services industry, offering structured professional training, mentorship and practical business exposure.
The six-month programme helps participants develop sales, client engagement and relationship management skills while building financial knowledge and exploring career pathways within financial services.
Role Overview
We are looking for motivated and personable graduates and early-career candidates to join as a Sales & Financial Advisory Associate under our Graduate Development Programme .
Throughout the six-month programme, participants will receive structured training in sales techniques, financial advisory concepts, business development and professional conduct.
You will learn how to understand client needs, communicate financial concepts and build professional relationships. Practical client-facing activities will be undertaken under appropriate supervision and only after meeting the applicable examination, regulatory and authorisation requirements.
Participants will have access to mentorship, training resources and lead generation support.
Key Responsibilities
Sales and Client Engagement

• Support outreach to prospective clients through provided leads, referrals and business development activities.

• Build and maintain professional relationships with clients and prospects.

• Learn to identify clients’ financial goals, priorities and needs under guidance.

• Coordinate client appointments and participate in meetings under appropriate supervision.

• Present relevant financial solutions only when appropriately qualified and authorised, in accordance with applicable requirements.

• Follow up on client enquiries and maintain accurate engagement records.

• Handle client information confidentially and follow company procedures.

Business Development and Performance

• Develop and maintain a pipeline of prospective clients.

• Participate in lead generation, outreach and networking activities.

• Track client appointments, follow-ups and business development progress.

• Work towards agreed activity and sales targets within the scope of authorised duties.

• Collaborate with mentors and team members to improve communication and client engagement approaches.

Professional Training and Development

• Participate in structured sales, product knowledge and financial advisory training.

• Complete the required examinations and fulfil applicable regulatory and authorisation requirements before undertaking regulated advisory activities.

• Attend coaching sessions and apply feedback to improve professional skills.

• Develop presentation, negotiation and relationship management capabilities.

• Learn and apply ethical advisory practices and relevant compliance procedures.

Requirements

• Diploma or Degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, Economics or a related discipline preferred.

• Candidates without prior experience are welcome to apply.

• Interest in sales, financial services and client relationship management.

• Good interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable engaging with new people and building professional relationships.

• Self-motivated, goal-oriented and receptive to feedback.

• Willingness to complete the required professional examinations and training.

• Comfortable working towards agreed activity and performance targets.

• Ability to handle confidential information accurately and professionally.

• Willingness to complete the full six-month programme.

Remuneration and Development Pathways
Participants may explore two remuneration pathways, subject to eligibility and programme terms.
Option 1: Full Commission Pathway

• Commission-based remuneration tied to eligible sales performance.

• Opportunity to develop a client portfolio.

• Earnings depend on individual performance and the applicable commission structure.

Option 2: Conditional Allowance Scheme

• Monthly allowance of up to $3,000, subject to meeting specified performance requirements.

• Progressive monthly performance targets apply.

• Lead generation support and training resources are provided.

• The allowance is conditional and is not a guaranteed basic salary.

• Eligibility, performance assessment and any repayment obligations are governed by the programme agreement.

Full details of the engagement terms, remuneration arrangements, performance conditions and any repayment obligations will be explained before participants select a pathway.
Career Development Opportunities

• Develop practical sales, financial advisory and client relationship management skills.

• Build financial knowledge, commercial awareness and professional communication capabilities.

• Access structured mentorship, training resources and lead generation support.

• Explore longer-term opportunities in sales and financial advisory, subject to performance, suitability and applicable requirements.

• Where an initial functional placement forms part of the participant’s agreed programme, consideration for opportunities in that business function may be available after programme completion, subject to performance, role availability and business requirements.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

description:
2027 APAC Graduate Programme – Global Markets
Our two-year graduate programme is designed to provide you with first class training and immediate responsibility, it gives you the support and development you need to start a successful career in financial services.
What you can expect
Induction
You will be provided with a comprehensive induction, where you will be immersed in group training and discover more about the BNP Paribas Group.
Training
From day one, you will start your business specific technical and financial training, alongside personal skills development aimed at equipping you with the knowledge you need to get you the best possible start in your career. Working alongside our teams of industry leading specialists, you will gain on-the-job training throughout your two-year programme taking you along a development path to build your expertise and broaden your base of skills. You will also have the chance to experience other parts of the business through cross-entity projects, which will help you understand how we approach complex work and give you the chance to develop a strong internal network.
Position Purpose

This is a Graduate Analyst position within the FICC Corporate Sales team in Singapore. The candidate will work closely with coverage bankers to assist corporates in managing their FX and interest rate risks.

• Deliver a personal revenue budget for local corporate clients and MNCs

• Support senior sales in trade execution and booking, market commentaries, client onboarding and credit approval process

• Prepare client pitch-books, market analysis and risk disclosure factsheets

• Identify hedging opportunities across various asset classes

• Prepare excel-based analytical tools for market monitoring, scenario analysis and back testing of trade ideas

• Work with other functions of the Bank such as Middle Office, IT, Coverage, Credit, Legal, etc.

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
Interest in financial markets, strong work ethic, team work, understanding of macro economics.

Job Title
Management Trainee
Job Description & Requirements
Job Summary
As a Management Trainee, you will undergo structured training to develop skills in managing restaurant operations and progressively assume supervisory or management roles.
Responsibilities

• Assist with daily restaurant operations, including opening and closing procedures, to ensure smooth functioning

• Supervise front-of-house and back-of-house teams to maintain operational efficiency

• Maintain high standards of food quality, service, cleanliness, and hygiene to enhance customer satisfaction

• Assist in staff scheduling, training, and performance management to support team development

• Handle customer enquiries, feedback, and complaints professionally to resolve issues and improve service

• Monitor inventory, stock levels, wastage, and ordering to optimize resource management

• Assist with cash handling, sales reporting, and cost control to support financial accuracy and profitability

• Ensure compliance with food safety and workplace safety regulations to maintain a safe environment

• Support promotional activities and initiatives to drive sales growth

• Analyse restaurant performance data and suggest improvements to enhance operational outcomes

• Collaborate closely with the Restaurant Manager and other departments to align goals and operations

• Take on increasing leadership responsibilities throughout the training programme to prepare for management roles

Preferred competencies and qualifications

• Diploma or Degree in Hospitality, F&B, Business, or related field is preferred

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage effectively with customers and team members

• Customer-service orientation with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

• Willingness to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays to meet operational needs

• Demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, and organisational skills to manage tasks and teams

• Positive attitude and eagerness to learn and grow within the role

description:
At Conrad Hotels & Resorts, we believe that true luxury is being yourself. As a member of Hilton's luxury portfolio, Conrad delivers intuitive service, meaningful connections, and purposeful experiences that empower both our guests and our Team Members.
The Cluster Learning & Development Manager serves as a strategic business partner and culture champion responsible for driving learning excellence, leadership development, talent growth, service culture, and organizational effectiveness across Conrad Singapore Marina Bay and Conrad Singapore Orchard.
This role is instrumental in cultivating a high-performance learning culture that reflects Conrad's Luxury Service Standards, Hilton Values, and Employer of Choice aspirations. The incumbent acts as a catalyst for continuous learning, leadership capability building, and cultural transformation while ensuring that all Team Members are equipped to deliver exceptional guest experiences with passion, purpose, and excellence.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive team member training and development programs to enhance team skills and performance; assessing training needs, designing and updating training courses to ensure that the training content matches the team members' job responsibilities and career paths; managing training budgets to ensure maximum return on training investment. As a Cluster Learning & Development Manager , you’re not just managing training initiatives for hotel team members – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
Learning & Development Strategy
• Develop and execute the annual Cluster Learning & Development Strategy aligned with business goals, Conrad Brand Standards, and Hilton's global learning framework.
• Lead the design, implementation, and evaluation of all learning and capability-building initiatives across both hotels.
• Establish a culture of continuous learning that supports operational excellence, talent retention, and career growth.
• Identify learning needs through performance data, guest feedback, quality audits, and business priorities.
• Ensure training interventions deliver measurable improvements in guest satisfaction, team engagement, and operational performance.
Luxury Service Culture & Brand Excellence
• Champion the Conrad Luxury Service Culture and ensure all Team Members understand and embody Conrad's service philosophy.
• Facilitate and sustain brand immersion programmes that reinforce luxury hospitality standards and memorable guest experiences.
• Lead initiatives that strengthen service excellence, guest engagement, and personalized luxury experiences.
• Collaborate with department leaders to embed brand standards into everyday operations and team behaviors.
Leadership Development
• Develop leadership capability at all levels through structured learning programs, succession planning initiatives, and coaching interventions.
• Facilitate Hilton leadership development programs and support participation in regional and global learning initiatives.
• Coach Department Heads, Managers, and Supervisors in leadership effectiveness, performance management, communication, and people development.
• Support talent reviews and succession planning processes to strengthen leadership bench strength across both properties.
Team Member Development
• Drive onboarding, orientation, and assimilation programmes to ensure a strong Team Member experience from day one.
• Manage and facilitate all mandatory Hilton and hotel-specific training programs.
• Design learning pathways that support technical skills, service excellence, cross-functional exposure, and career growth.
• Support individual development plans and facilitate career conversations across all levels.
• Mentor high-potential Team Members and emerging leaders.
Talent Management & Organizational Development
• Partner with the Human Resources team and business leaders to support talent management, succession planning, and workforce capability development.

Learn the Business Before Leading It
Our Management Trainee Programme is designed for individuals who want to build practical experience before progressing into leadership.
You will begin with the foundation of our business: face-to-face sales and customer engagement. Through hands-on campaigns, structured training and personal mentorship, you will learn how to represent established brands, understand customer behaviour and achieve business objectives.
As you demonstrate consistency, adaptability and leadership readiness, you may progress into coaching, campaign management, recruitment and team development.
Your Development Journey
Phase 1: Sales and Customer Engagement

• Represent established brands at events and roadshows

• Engage customers and understand their needs

• Recommend suitable products or services

• Support customer acquisition and brand-awareness objectives

• Develop communication, presentation and negotiation skills

• Work with the team to achieve campaign targets

Phase 2: Coaching and Team Development
With consistent performance, you may take on opportunities to:

• Guide and support newer team members

• Conduct product and campaign sharing

• Develop coaching and people-management skills

• Support team performance and daily activities

• Lead through personal example

Phase 3: Campaign and Business Management
As you demonstrate leadership readiness, you may gain exposure to:

• Campaign planning and coordination

• Recruitment and onboarding

• Team performance management

• Client and campaign objectives

• Local and regional business expansion

What We Provide

• Structured onboarding and hands-on training

• Personal coaching and ongoing mentorship

• Practical sales, communication and leadership development

• Clear performance-based progression

• Exposure to recruitment and campaign operations

• Local and overseas learning opportunities

• Supportive and development-focused team environment

Requirements

• Fresh graduates and entry-level candidates are welcome

• No previous management experience required

• Strong willingness to learn and develop

• Comfortable working in a face-to-face customer environment

• Positive and receptive towards feedback

• Self-motivated, adaptable and goal-oriented

• Able to work independently and collaboratively

• Interested in sales, leadership and business development

This programme begins with frontline sales and customer engagement. Progression into leadership and management responsibilities is based on performance, consistency, adaptability and readiness.
We are not looking for ready-made managers. We are looking for individuals with the potential and determination to become effective ones.
If you are willing to learn the groundwork before leading others, we welcome your application.

Build your career through AKC’s two year Management Trainee Programme, designed to develop future Team Leads and business leaders.

• Conduct market and competitor research.

• Follow up on leads, registrations and customer engagement.

• Take on increasing responsibility throughout the programme.

• Build the capabilities needed to progress into a Team Lead position.

• Practical experience solving real business and operational challenges.

• Potential progression into a Team Lead or suitable specialist role

• Fresh graduates and entry-level candidates are welcome.

• Strong interest in business management and leadership.

• Good communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Proactive, adaptable and willing to take ownership.

• Able to work independently and collaborate across teams.

Flex Logistics is a fast-growing Healthcare Supply Chain On Demand startup in Singapore. For more details, please visit our website https://www.flexlogistics.sg/ . We are in the hunt for a highly driven, motivated and aggressive Management Trainee to join our highly talented team in a fast-growing startup at the early stages of growth.
What you can expect?

Direct exposure and training with Founder and inner workings of a start-up. Potential growth opportunities within the firm

We are looking for?
1. Talented individual who is not afraid of challenges and failure
2. People who is able to work in ambiguous environment
3. Strong entrepreneur spirit and able to think out of the box

How you’ll shape our journey

• Learning all aspects of company’s businesses and to acquire skills needed to assume a management position.

• Provide full spectrum of administrative and operational support in day-to-day business operations and project management.

• Develop and review project plans, track issues, facilitate and coordinate with various team players effectively.

• Learn the management viewpoints, company policies and best practices through assignments and rotations in various business units.

• Study existing work flow and assist with the revising and development of processes and procedures to enhance overall organisational efficiency.

• Provide leadership and direction for the day-to-day activities and planning.

• Manage and evaluate daily operations liaising with internal staffs, contractors and optimize operations.

• Developing, coaching and disciplining staffs.

• Monitor and evaluate departmental financial KPIs, ensuring that cost-control measures are in place, targets are met, and improvements are continuously implemented.

• Ensuring Health, Safety Security and SOP’s requirements and procedures are understood, implemented and compiled by all staffs and external contractors.

• Assist the Accounting and Operations team with fact-checking financial data, resolving discrepancies, and preparing reports.

• Contribute to team and organization’s special projects

• Brainstorm ideas for business development.

• Perform any other reasonable duties as assigned

We are looking for?
· Degree holder in any fields (preferabbly Degree in Accounting, Finance, or any related field)
· No experience required as on job training provided
· Possesses an open mind and willing-to-learn attitude
· Meticulous and have an eye for details
· Talented individual who is not afraid of challenges and failure
· People who is able to work in ambiguous environment
· Strong entrepreneur spirit and able to think out of the box
· Team player with a positive, pleasant & outgoing personality
· Proficient in MS Excel, with advance knowledge in Excel an advantage
· Fresh graduates are welcome to apply
· Self-motivated & results oriented
· Independent & resourceful
· Competent in problem solving & possess strong analytical skills
· Able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
· Good communication skills

This role reports directly to the Founders and CEO of the firm

ONLY APPLY THROUGH CAREERFUTURE OR EMAIL yiting.liew@flexlogistics.sg (WE DO NOT POST OUR JOB IN ANY OTHER PLATFORMS)

Company Overview
RE&S Enterprises Pte Ltd is a leading restaurant chain with over 60 outlets in Singapore. With 25 years of presence, we focus on delivering quality Japanese dining experiences through continual growth, innovation, and a commitment to Food for Life.
Job Summary
Lead and support service staff to deliver excellent restaurant operations by managing floor control, ensuring quality service, and maintaining safety and cleanliness standards to maximize customer satisfaction and business profitability.
Responsibilities

• Lead and allocate tasks to service staff within the assigned unit to ensure efficient team operations

• Prepare the restaurant for daily service by checking readiness and briefing staff on the service roster

• Manage customer flow and seating arrangements to optimize dining experience and operational efficiency

• Oversee service delivery to ensure adherence to quality, cleanliness, and value standards, addressing any service lapses promptly

• Manage cash floats and audit rolls, troubleshoot cash register errors, and document all cash discrepancies accurately

• Act as escalation point for service crew to resolve operational issues and support staff in completing assigned tasks

• Lead timely investigations and resolutions of complex customer complaints and feedback to enhance customer satisfaction

• Enforce compliance with restaurant quality, service, cleanliness, and safety standards through regular monitoring

• Implement corrective actions to address unsafe or non-compliant conditions related to personal and food safety

• Conduct induction training for new hires to equip them with necessary skills and role knowledge

• Provide ongoing training to encourage role rotation among service staff to enhance team flexibility and skills

• Train and monitor staff adherence to company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

• Ensure workplace safety practices are followed consistently to maintain a safe working environment

description:
Are you looking for a career that moves as fast as you do? We are a high-growth marketing and brand activation agency that specializes in running high-impact campaigns across diverse sectors.
We are looking for an ambitious Campaign Management Trainee to join our accelerated leadership track. This is a non-desk, highly immersive role where you will learn the business from the ground up—transitioning from campaign execution to strategic management. If you want to escape the monotony of a 9-to-6 desk job and build practical skills in business development, consumer psychology, and project management, this is your launchpad.
What You’ll Be Doing (The Trajectory):

• Campaign Execution: Act as the face of our client portfolios across multiple front-line channels, including high-traffic events, corporate roadshows, and direct-to-consumer field marketing.

• Strategy & Ideation: Participate in daily creative huddles to brainstorm, plan, and optimize localized marketing strategies that drive consumer engagement.

• Operational Coordination: Learn the logistics behind managing a campaign—from inventory control and compliance to team deployment and territory planning.

• Leadership Development: Shadow senior managers to learn team leadership, public presentation, client management, and business operations, preparing you to lead your own campaign division.

What’s In It For You (The Perks):

• True Meritocracy: Your progression is entirely performance-driven. We provide a transparent, fast-track pathway where your career milestones are determined by your results, not corporate politics or seniority.

• 1-on-1 Mentorship: No prior corporate experience? We’ve got you. You will be paired with an experienced industry mentor to guide you through fully funded onboarding modules.

• Regional Travel & Exposure: Gain broader market perspective with company-sponsored travel for regional campaigns, networking seminars, and overseas learning trips.

• Vibrant, Collaborative Culture: Work alongside a young, driven, and highly motivated team of peers who celebrate each other's wins and push you to grow daily.

Who We Are Looking For:

• An energetic, naturally outgoing communicator who thrives on human connection and public interaction.

• A goal-oriented individual with a "let's win together" mindset and high mental resilience.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Good problem-solving skills and sound judgement

• Passion for working with children and delivering high-quality programmes

• Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced environment, including weekend work

• Gymnastics, sports or coaching background is an advantage but not required; full training will be provided

• A clear development path from Management Trainee to Assistant Centre Manager

• Structured on-the-job training and mentoring from experienced centre leaders

Train to Lead, Starting From the Front Line.

• Review your progress with your coach daily

• Open to all educational backgrounds

• Aspiration to manage and develop people

• Strong communication and organisational skills

• Leads by example

• Daily one-to-one coaching

description:
Job Duties:

• Ensure consistent quality of food and beverages for all customers.

• Provide excellent customer service at the counter.

• Adhere to health, safety, and sanitation guidelines to maintain hygiene standards.

• Maintain cleanliness of preparation and counter areas.

• Handle cash transactions.

• Plan, recruit, and schedule monthly duty rosters for drink stall staff.

• Submit staff attendance and leave records to the office for payroll processing.

• Analyze the cost of goods sold and ensure staff meet monthly KPI sales targets.

• Review financial transactions such as budgets and payroll records.

• Manage service performance and employees during shifts in the absence of the Outlet Manager, including training, providing support during busy periods, addressing customer complaints, and maintaining positive relationships with the store to ensure maximum customer satisfaction.

• Act as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring consistent and fair handling of customer complaints and adherence to company policies.

• Follow closing procedures in accordance with company policies and procedures to minimize financial risk.

• Foster two-way communication and cultivate an environment of ownership, motivation, and teamwork.

• Manage day-to-day food and beverage operations within budgetary guidelines and to the highest standards.

• Design exceptional menus, purchase goods, and implement necessary improvements.

• Conduct monthly inventory in the designated store.

• Perform other ad hoc duties assigned by the Manager.

Requirements:

• Minimum 2 years of experience working in a coffee shop environment.

• Willingness to work long hours and weekends.

• Up-to-date with food and beverage trends and best practices.

description:
Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.
Summary
We are seeking ambitious, high-potential graduates and early-career professionals for Sanmina’s Accelerated Leadership Pathway (ALPS)—an intensive 2.5-year management trainee programme designed to cultivate our next generation of global manufacturing leaders. In this fast-track rotational program, you will complete structured assignments across five core functional pillars: Quality Assurance, Program Management, Material Control, Manufacturing & Test Engineering, and Production. Working side-by-side with senior operations executives and cross-functional teams, you will tackle high-impact Lean projects, master advanced PCBA and box-build operations, solve complex engineering and supply chain challenges, and develop the strategic vision and executive acumen required to lead world-class manufacturing organizations.
What You'll Do

• Rotate across five key operational departments—Quality Assurance, Program Management, Material Control, Manufacturing & Test Engineering, and Production—to master the end-to-end electronics manufacturing lifecycle.

• Champion Quality Management Systems (QMS) governance, ensuring rigorous adherence to international medical, industrial, and automotive standards.

• Partner with global OEM customers in Program Management, orchestrating product portfolios from initial demand forecasting through final fulfillment.

• Manage inventory flow and supply chain logistics in Material Control to mitigate component bottlenecks and ensure 100% production uptime.

• Drive New Product Introduction (NPI) roadmaps and process engineering optimizations for complex, high-reliability electronic assemblies.

• Develop, evaluate, and troubleshoot advanced test platforms and inspection equipment to safeguard hardware performance and product yield.

• Gain direct frontline leadership experience in Production by supervising high-speed assembly lines, balancing workflows, and driving team productivity.

• Take ownership of high-impact Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and Kaizen initiatives from day one to eliminate operational waste and shorten cycle times.

• Engage with executive mentors and senior leaders through dedicated 1-on-1 coaching to refine your leadership capabilities and strategic problem-solving skills.

• Leverage digital workflows and AI-assisted tools to automate operational reporting and extract actionable manufacturing insights.

• Transition upon successful program completion into a full-time leadership role aligned with your core operational strengths.

What You'll Bring

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline (fresh graduates or candidates with up to 3 years of electronics manufacturing experience are welcome to apply).

• Demonstrated track record of leadership, initiative, and teamwork in student organizations, athletics, volunteering, or co-curricular pursuits.

• Strong personal drive and genuine passion to build a long-term leadership career within the Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) sector.

• Foundational understanding of engineering principles, manufacturing processes, and quality methodologies gained through academic coursework, projects, or internships.

• Proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office applications, with an aptitude for utilizing modern AI productivity tools.

• Sharp analytical and logical problem-solving capabilities paired with clear, persuasive verbal and written communication skills.

• High learning agility, self-motivation, and the resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on engineering and shop-floor environment.

How to Stand Out
The ideal candidate combines strong technical or business fundamentals with natural leadership presence, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action. You distinguish yourself through a proven ability to bridge cross-functional gaps between technical engineering and commercial execution, an appetite to challenge the status quo using Lean principles and digital innovation, and the maturity to leverage executive mentorship into tangible shop-floor performance.
