description:
About Sanmina
Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a leading integrated manufacturing solutions provider serving the fastest-growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. Recognized as a technology leader, Sanmina Corporation provides end-to-end manufacturing solutions, delivering superior quality and support to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) primarily in the communications networks, defense and aerospace, industrial and semiconductor systems, medical, multimedia, computing and storage, automotive and clean technology sectors. Sanmina Corporation has facilities strategically located in key regions throughout the world.

Role Overview
Sanmina’s Accelerated Leadership Pathway (ALPS) is a 2.5-years management trainee programme aimed to develop high-potential engineering, operations, and business graduates into future leaders in complex, global manufacturing operations.
As an ALPS Management Trainee, you will be rotated through 5 different departments to gain a deep understanding of our manufacturing ecosystem. You will engage in strategic, engineering, and operational tasks to build a well-rounded foundation for a future leadership career at Sanmina.

• Quality Assurance: Oversee Quality Management Systems ensuring compliance with global medical and industrial standards.

• Program Management: Serve as the strategic bridge with global customers, orchestrating complex portfolios from forecast to fulfillment.

• Material Control: Manage inventory flow and supply chain activities to support efficient, uninterrupted production.

• Manufacturing and Test Engineering: Lead New Product Introductions (NPI) and optimize manufacturing processes for complex electronic products and develop test solutions and troubleshoot advanced hardware to ensure product performance and reliability.

• Production: Gain hands-on experience managing high-speed production lines and diverse teams while driving efficiency in a fast-paced environment.

Who Should Apply
We are seeking highly motivated individuals with a strong desire to learn and grow. The ideal candidate will possess excellent analytical capabilities and good communication skills.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field. Graduates or candidates with 3 years of electronics manufacturing experience are welcome to apply.

• Strong track record of leadership or initiative in student associations, sports, volunteering, or co-curricular activities.

• Strong interest to build a career in Contract Electronics Manufacturing.

• Proficiency in Google Workspace, and basic knowledge of AI tools.

• Basic understanding of engineering principles, manufacturing processes, and quality concepts gained through academic coursework, projects, internships, or practical training.

• Able to work collaboratively in a manufacturing and cross-functional team environment.

• Fast learner, take initiative, and develop technical and professional skills in a hands-on engineering environment.

About the Role
Are you looking to kick-start your career in the financial services industry with opportunities for continuous learning and career growth?

Whether you are a fresh graduate or have limited working experience, we welcome you to apply. You will receive structured professional training, mentorship from experienced leaders, and continuous on-the-job coaching to help you develop the knowledge and skills needed to build a successful career.
This position offers a mid-management career progression pathway above the Financial Planner level. Candidates without prior experience may begin at an entry-level position, with opportunities to develop their expertise and progress into a management role within approximately two to three years, subject to performance and development.
If you have a positive attitude, enjoy interacting with people, and are eager to learn and grow professionally, we would love to hear from you!
Key Responsibilities

• Understand clients' financial goals, needs, and objectives before recommending suitable financial and investment solutions.

• Review clients' financial plans regularly and provide recommendations based on changes in their financial circumstances and goals.

• Assist clients in managing and optimising their investment portfolios to support their long-term financial objectives.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients.

• Participate in company training programmes, workshops, and industry seminars to continuously enhance professional knowledge and skills.

What We Offer

• Basic allowance with additional performance-based incentives.

• Paid structured professional training programme.

• One-to-one coaching and mentorship from experienced leaders.

• Clear career progression and management development opportunities.

• Supportive and collaborative working environment.

• Flexible working hours and hybrid working arrangements.

• Opportunities for local and overseas business travel.

• Recognition and rewards for outstanding performance.

Working Arrangement
We offer a flexible, appointment-based working arrangement that allows you to plan your working hours according to your schedule.
Work locations are generally determined by client appointments, giving you the flexibility to choose suitable venues for client meetings.
However, attendance at designated company training sessions and meetings is mandatory and will require you to be physically present at the office.

Examination Sponsorship:

• First attempt: 100% sponsored.

• Second attempt: 50% sponsored if the first attempt is unsuccessful.

• Third attempt: 25% sponsored.

Certification Rewards:
Successful candidates will also receive monetary rewards upon passing each certification paper:

• First paper passed: SGD 100.

• Second paper passed: SGD 200.

• Third paper passed: SGD 300.

• Fourth paper passed: SGD 400.

Job Requirements

• Minimum qualification of Polytechnic Diploma, GCE A-Level, Bachelor's Degree, Professional Degree, or equivalent.

• Must be at least 21 years old, in accordance with MAS regulatory requirements.

• Fresh graduates and entry-level candidates are welcome to apply.

• Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

• Good communication with interpersonal skills, self-motivated, goal-oriented, and driven to achieve results.

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team.

• Experience in working in corporate environment is a plus.

Additional Benefits

• Employee discounts.

• Flexible working schedule.

• Professional development and continuous training.

• Hybrid working arrangement.

• Career advancement opportunities.

Start your professional journey with us and discover opportunities to learn, grow, and build a rewarding career!

Job Purpose:
Management Trainee will undergo 2 years’ training program to become an Outlet Manager with the Job Purpose and Main Duties as below:
This position is responsible for the daily operations of an outlet, including the selection, development and performance management of employees, overseeing the inventory and ordering of food and supplies, optimising profits and ensuring that customers are satisfied with their dining experience.
Main Duties:

• Oversee and manage all areas of an outlet assigned to the job holder and accountable to the Area Manager for the delivery of efficient, quality and profitable service. Keep Area Manager promptly and fully informed of all issues and take prompt corrective action where necessary or suggest alternative courses of action.

• Adhere to Han’s standards and service levels to increase sales and minimise costs, including food, beverage, supplies, utility and labour costs.

• Ensure that all daily sale collections are securely banked and personnel/payroll related administrative duties are completed accurately, on time and in accordance to Han’s policies and procedures.

• Enforce sanitary practices for food handling, general cleanliness, and maintenance of kitchen and dining areas. Ensure compliance with operational standards and Han’s policies.

• Ensure consistent high quality of food preparation and service.

• Supervise portion control and quantities of preparation to minimise waste.

• Estimate food needs and work with Central Procurement to place orders and schedule delivery.

• Ensure customer service in all areas. Respond to complaints, and take appropriate immediate corrective actions. Educate staff on prevention of future occurrence.

• Ensure that proper security procedures are in place to protect staff, customers and company assets.

• Ensure safe working and guest environment to reduce the risk of injury and accidents. Complete accident reports promptly in the event a customer or employee is injured.

• Management shifts which include: daily decision making, scheduling and planning.

• Interview job applicants. Direct recruitment, supervision, development and, when necessary, termination of employment of employees.

• Conduct orientation which includes safety briefing, and oversee the training of new employees.

• Develop employees by providing ongoing feedback, establishing performance expectations and by conducting performance appraisal.

Requirements:

• Diploma with 1-year experience working in the F&B or Hospitality Industry

• Need to perform shift work and work on Public Holiday and weekends

• 6 days work per week

• Physically fit as require to stand long hours

description:
Job Purpose:

Management Trainee will undergo 2 years’ training program to become an Outlet Manager with the Job Purpose and Main Duties as below:

This position is responsible for the daily operations of an outlet, including the selection, development and performance management of employees, overseeing the inventory and ordering of food and supplies, optimising profits and ensuring that customers are satisfied with their dining experience.

Main Duties:

• Oversee and manage all areas of an outlet assigned to the job holder and accountable to the Area Manager for the delivery of efficient, quality and profitable service. Keep Area Manager promptly and fully informed of all issues and take prompt corrective action where necessary or suggest alternative courses of action.

• Adhere to Han’s standards and service levels to increase sales and minimise costs, including food, beverage, supplies, utility and labour costs.

• Ensure that all daily sale collections are securely banked and personnel/payroll related administrative duties are completed accurately, on time and in accordance to Han’s policies and procedures.

• Enforce sanitary practices for food handling, general cleanliness, and maintenance of kitchen and dining areas. Ensure compliance with operational standards and Han’s policies.

• Ensure consistent high quality of food preparation and service.

• Supervise portion control and quantities of preparation to minimise waste.

• Estimate food needs and work with Central Procurement to place orders and schedule delivery.

• Ensure customer service in all areas. Respond to complaints, and take appropriate immediate corrective actions. Educate staff on prevention of future occurrence.

• Ensure that proper security procedures are in place to protect staff, customers and company assets.

• Ensure safe working and guest environment to reduce the risk of injury and accidents. Complete accident reports promptly in the event a customer or employee is injured.

• Management shifts which include: daily decision making, scheduling and planning.

• Interview job applicants. Direct recruitment, supervision, development and, when necessary, termination of employment of employees.

• Conduct orientation which includes safety briefing, and oversee the training of new employees.

• Develop employees by providing ongoing feedback, establishing performance expectations and by conducting performance appraisal.

Requirements:

• Diploma with 1-year experience working in the F&B or Hospitality Industry

• Need to perform shift work and work on Public Holiday and weekends

• 6 days work per week

• Physically fit as require to stand long hours

description:
Job Description:

1. Services (Front of House):

Responsible for setting-up and handling work station(s) assigned.

Be attentive to guests’ request efficiently and effectively.

Serve food & beverages in accordance to Restaurant and regulatory standards.

Ensure cleanliness and work order in compliance with standards at all times

Ensure all used plates and cutleries on the dining tables are being cleared once the guests left the restaurant.

Possess full knowledge on food, beverages and other products & services served/provided by the Restaurant.

Attend to guests’ queries, feedback and complaint timely & professional

2. Kitchen (Back of House):

Responsible for preparing, cooking and presenting quality cooked safe products to our guests.

Prepare food orders accordance to the standard recipes, portion controls and presentation specification as set by the Company.

Ensure all kitchen equipment are well maintained at all time.

Ensure all stocks and ingredients are restocks/sufficient.

Adhere to all sanitation requirements including product rotation, temperature maintenance, storage procedures, cooking requirements and handling techniques

3. People Management:

Build restaurant staffs commitment by demonstrating and reinforcing the leadership behaviours and work standards.

Develop and follow through on restaurant staffs’ development plan to increase their loyalty and commitment, and pride with the outlet’s experience.

Ensure all restaurant staff understand and adhere to all appropriate personnel policies, labour laws, security and safety procedures.

Recruit, select and retain an optimum number of restaurant staffs, who are enthusiastically dedicated to guest satisfaction.

Oversee and review performance appraisals based on defined goals and objectives for all restaurant staffs in a timely manner.

Administer in-restaurant employees’ welfare & benefits packages, as well as payroll procedures.

Maintain records for safety and appropriately documents contributions and performance in personal file.

4. Sales Building Management:

Responsible for achieving monthly sales target by deploying the store marketing strategies leveraging on correct and updated data.

Take necessary measures to ensure promotions are executed effectively to achieve/exceed the expected sales result.

5. Workplace Safety & Security:

Ensure all security procedures (cash deposits, staggered method of opening, closing, etc.) are executed accordingly.

Maintain all physical aspects of the restaurant, including landscaping, building, equipment, etc and ensure it is following the documented inspection and testing standards.

Ensure all workplace safety policies procedures are maintained and adhered to at all times.

Undertake regular practices of emergency & evacuation procedures and enforce compliance when need arises.

Undertake risk assessments on all restaurant specific issues, where the absence of such could put employees and guests at risk.

Undertake full investigations of workplace incidents in the restaurant promptly and act upon any rectifications or work improvements

6. Others:

Perform any other additional responsibilities as assigned by Restaurant Manager.

Requirements:

Candidate must possess at least Degree in Food & Beverage, Hospitality, Hotel Management or equivalent.

Require to work on rotating shift basis which include weekends and public holidays.

description:
Position Summary:

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Management Trainee to join our Container Depot operations team. The ideal candidate will gain comprehensive, hands-on experience in depot processes, container handling, yard planning, inventory control, and customer coordination. This role is designed to build future leaders in depot and logistics operations.

Key Responsibilities:

• Learn and support day-to-day container depot operations, including receiving and dispatching, repair and maintenance and surveying and inspection of containers.

• Assist in yard planning, ensuring optimal space utilisation and safe container movement.

• Monitor and update container inventory using depot/container management systems.

• Coordinate with operations, repair teams, transporters, surveyors, and shipping lines for smooth workflow.

• Verify and maintain accurate documentation, including inbound/outbound reports, gate passes, inspection reports, and work orders.

• Participate in safety compliance, ensuring operational adherence to depot and industry standards.

• Analyse operational data and prepare routine operational reports.

• Identify process gaps and support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity and reduce turnaround time.

• Provide support in customer service by addressing queries related to container availability, condition, and movement.

Qualifications, Skills & Abilities:

• Bachelor’s degree in any field (Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related fields is an added advantage).

• Strong interest in logistics, container management, and supply chain operations.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.

• Analytical mindset with problem-solving abilities.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and any depot management software is a plus.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced yard/operations environment and work under pressure.

• Good time management skills and attention to detail.

• Good team player with position work attitude.

• Must be able to climb up to containers for inspection.

Working Conditions:

• 5.5 Days work week

• This role will require working in an outdoor environment

• This role may be required to work late, on weekends and/or holiday based on operational needs.

• This role will require a 4-year contract (mandatory).

• This role may be subject to overseas posting upon successful completion of training.

Compensation:

• Competitive salary with benefits (Health and Medical Insurance, Transport, Meal, etc)

• Opportunity for growth and advancement within the company after successful completion of the trainee program

Apply today and start building your career with us!

Build Your Career. Grow With Us.
We are a fast-growing F&B company with 13 outlets across Singapore ,with exciting plans for further expansion. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a passionate, motivated and people-oriented F&B Operations Management Trainee to join our team and grow together with us.
This is an excellent opportunity for individuals who are passionate about the F&B industry and want to build a long-term career in restaurant operations, leadership and outlet management .
YOUR ROLE
1. Guest Experience & Service

• Welcome and serve guests warmly, professionally and efficiently.

• Present menu items and confidently explain ingredients and preparation methods.

• Attend to guests' needs and ensure a positive dining experience.

• Handle guest enquiries and feedback professionally while maintaining high service standards.

• Develop strong product knowledge and deliver consistent service excellence.

2. Restaurant Operations

• Learn and gain hands-on experience in all aspects of restaurant operations.

• Assist with daily opening and closing procedures and ensure all checklists are completed accurately.

• Support the smooth and efficient running of daily outlet operations.

• Maintain outlet standards in service,cleanliness, presentation and operational procedures.

• Identify opportunities and contribute ideas to improve service quality and operational efficiency.

3. Team & Leadership Development

• Assist the Restaurant Manager with daily operational tasks and team coordination.

• Support the implementation of company policies,procedures and operational standards.

• Participate in team briefings, training and staff development activities.

• Learn how to lead, motivate and work effectively with a diverse F&B team.

• Develop leadership, communication and problem-solving skills through structured on-the-job training.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
We are looking for individuals who are:

• Passionate about the F&B and hospitality industry .

• Positive, energetic and willing to learn.

• Customer-focused with a strong service mindset.

• Confident, proactive and comfortable working ina fast-paced environment.

• Good in verbal and written communication.

• Able to work well in a team and demonstrate leadership potential.

• Interested in developing a long-term career in F&B operations and management.

Qualifications & Experience

• Diploma / Degree holders are welcome to apply.

• Candidates with relevant F&B, hospitality, retail or service experience are also encouraged to apply.

• Fresh graduates with the right attitude and strong passion for F&B are welcome.

WHY JOIN US?
🚀Career Growth
We are expanding quickly, which means more opportunities for our people to grow with us. High-performing team members will have opportunities to progress into supervisory and management positions.
🎓Structured 1-Year Training Programme
Gain exposure to different areas of F&B operations through a structured rotational programme designed to build your operational knowledge and leadership capabilities.
🌱Develop Into a Future Manager
Receive comprehensive hands-on training and coaching to build the skills needed to be come one of our future outlet leaders and managers.
💰Attractive Compensation
Enjoy a competitive salary package with incentives and performance-based rewards as you grow with the Company.
🎁Staff Benefits
Enjoy staff discounts across our outlets, together with other employee benefits.
🤝Fun & Supportive Team
Join a young, dynamic and energetic team where collaboration, teamwork and a positive working environment are valued.
📈Grow With a Fast-Expanding Company
With 13 outlets islandwide and more expansion ahead, you will have the opportunity to be part of our growth journey and make a real impact.
READY TO START YOUR F&B CAREER?
Whether you are a fresh graduate looking for your first career opportunity or have experience in the F&B and service industry, we want to hear from individuals who are hungry to learn, ready to take on challenges and excited to grow with us.
Join us today and take the first step towards becoming our next F&B leader!

description:
Job Overview:
We are looking for an energetic and motivated Sales Management Trainee to join our fast-growing FMCG business. This role is designed for individuals who are keen to build a career in sales, retail operations, and business development.
As a Management Trainee, you will gain hands-on exposure across sales, retail execution, merchandising, account management, and trade marketing. You will work closely with our Sales, Key Account, Trade Marketing, and Merchandising teams to understand how FMCG businesses operate and develop practical commercial skills.
This is an excellent opportunity for fresh graduates or early-career professionals who are ambitious, proactive, and eager to take on increasing responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales & Retail Operations
• Support the Sales team in day-to-day sales and retail operations.
• Visit assigned retail outlets to understand sales performance, product availability, and merchandising standards.
• Monitor stock levels, product displays, pricing, and promotional execution.
• Support sales initiatives, product launches, and other commercial activities.
• Build and maintain positive relationships with store personnel and retail partners.
• Identify operational issues at retail outlets and work with the relevant teams to resolve them.
Sales Performance & Reporting
• Prepare regular sales performance reports and updates.
• Monitor sales targets, sell-out performance, stock levels, and promotional results.
• Gather market intelligence and competitor information from retail outlets.
• Highlight sales opportunities, operational issues, and areas for improvement.
• Assist in preparing presentations, reports, and other sales-related materials.
Trade Marketing & Promotions
• Support trade promotions, product launches, and in-store marketing campaigns.
• Assist with POSM placement, display setup, and maintenance.
• Work closely with the Trade Marketing and Merchandising teams to ensure strong retail execution.
• Conduct store checks and ensure promotional activities are implemented according to guidelines.
Customer & Account Support
• Support the management of assigned customers and retail accounts.
• Assist with sales orders, deliveries, stock allocation, and customer requests.
• Follow up with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth order fulfilment.
• Gain exposure to key account management and customer relationship management.
Management Trainee Development
• Participate in cross-functional projects and business initiatives.
• Gain practical knowledge across FMCG sales, retail, trade marketing, and supply chain operations.
• Work closely with experienced team members and managers to develop commercial and leadership skills.
• Take on increasing responsibilities based on performance, capabilities, and business needs.
• Support other projects and ad hoc assignments as required.

Working Schedule:
• 5-day work week
• Weekend work is compulsory as part of our retail operations.
• Working days and rest days will be scheduled according to business and retail operational requirements.
• The role requires regular visits to retail outlets and is suitable for candidates who are comfortable with field-based work.

Requirements:
• Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, Management, or a related discipline.
• Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
• Candidates with 1–2 years of experience in sales, retail, FMCG, customer service, or related fields are also encouraged to apply.
• Strong interest in sales, FMCG, retail, and business development.
• Good communication and interpersonal skills with confidence in engaging customers and retail partners.
• Energetic, proactive, and results-oriented with a strong willingness to learn.
• Well-organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks.
• Able to work independently as well as effectively within a team.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.
• Must be comfortable working weekends.

description:
Management Trainee (Rooms)
Mandarin Oriental, Singapore is looking for a Management Trainee to join our Rooms team.
Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.
Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.
Mandarin Oriental, Singapore is a sanctuary of luxury and sophistication overlooking the iconic Marina Bay.
About the job
Based at Mandarin Oriental, Singapore within the Rooms Department in Singapore, the Management Trainee is responsible in playing a vital role in providing exceptional services to guests, ensuring their comfort, safety, and satisfaction. Through this program, you will receive hands on operational skills training performed by our professional colleagues and gain plenty of experience in interacting with guests. The Management Trainee reports to the Front Office Manager.
As Management Trainee, you will be responsible for the following duties:
This programme provides opportunities for individuals to learn and understand all aspects of operating, supervising and managing Rooms with the ultimate goal of becoming a Director of Rooms in the future.
Included in the 18-month programme is:

• Extended onboarding within the home division

• In-depth departmental training within each of the following positions:

• Front Desk

• Concierge

• Club Lounge

• Guest Relations

• Housekeeping

• A minimum of three Rooms Projects designated by the Director of Rooms. Projects may include areas such as: Market Research, Standard Operating Procedures, Policies, FLHSS, New Business Strategies, etc.

• Spearhead and implement Rooms programmes for guests and colleagues in the hotel.

• Cross functional exposure to other departments during the 18 month programme scheduled with the Director of Rooms

• Accelerated leadership development

• Rising Fans will be given the opportunity to participate in: Move Ahead, Cornell and additional training program options.

As Management Trainee, we expect from you:

• Pursuing or possess a diploma or degree in hospitality management or related fields

• Passionate and eager to learn and grow in the hospitality industry

• Possess excellent communication skills with a friendly and helpful demeanor

• Willing to work shifts, weekends and public holidays

• Thrives in a fast paced and dynamic environment

• Aspiring to grow your career internationally within the group

• Previous work experience or internship in hospitality industry will be an advantage

Our commitment to you

• Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.

• MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.

• Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.

• Retirement Plans. When you show commitment to us, we reciprocate. We offer different retirement plans depending on the length of your service and your role.

We're Fans. Are you?

description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Shift Leadership & Floor Control

• Act as the second-in-command for service operations during assigned shifts

• Take charge of the floor in the absence of the Outlet Manager

• Coordinate service flow between host, floor, and bar to ensure smooth operations

• Monitor peak-hour service and step in proactively to resolve bottlenecks

• Ensure all systems are updated including point-of-sales, own and partner delivery platforms, Spotify

Service Standards & SOP Execution

• Ensure all service staff follow Company SOPs and service scripts

• Maintain service discipline, professionalism, and grooming standards

• Ensure proper table management, guest flow, and clearing procedures

• Prevent behaviours that affect guest experience (e.g. staff crowding, idle chatter)

• Ensure that food and beverages are served with outstanding quality and presentation adhering to the recipe guidelines and presentation standards at all times

Team Support & On-the-Job Coaching

• Guide and support service crew during shifts

• Coach junior staff on service sequence, etiquette, and guest engagement

• Assist in training new service staff under guidance of the Outlet Manager

• Set the tone for teamwork, accountability, and service mindset

Customer Engagement & Service Recovery

• Engage guests warmly and professionally when required

• Handle basic customer feedback or complaints on the floor

• Execute service recovery within approved guidelines

• Escalate serious or recurring issues to the Outlet Manager promptly

Manpower & Shift Readiness

• Ensure adequate manpower deployment during shifts

• Assign service roles and sections clearly at the start of each shift

• Monitor staff punctuality and readiness

• Inform Outlet Manager of manpower gaps or performance issues

Cleanliness & Outlet Readiness

• Ensure FOH areas are clean, organised, and presentable at all times

• Enforce cleaning SOPs, including no sweeping or mopping during service hours

• Oversee table reset, floor checks, and toilet cleanliness during service

• Ensure closing duties are completed properly before handover

Communication & Reporting

• Communicate operational updates and instructions clearly to the team

• Report shift issues, customer feedback, and incidents to the Outlet Manager

• Support daily briefings and end-of-shift handovers

description:
Job Purpose and Key Accountabilities:

As a Management Trainee, your main goal will be to learn and master various aspects of the company's operations, including but not limited to operations management, human resources management, team leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving. Through this training program, you will acquire the necessary skills and knowledge to prepare for future senior management positions.

Key Accountabilities:

• Continuously learn and understand the specific business operations and management strategies of the company.

• Participate in and lead team projects, enhancing teamwork and leadership.

• Effectively manage and execute projects in a multitasking and high-pressure environment, with a results-oriented approach.

• Solve problems encountered in work, formulate and implement solutions, emphasizing replicable processes.

• Embrace change, continuously improve your skills and knowledge, and break through your own capability boundaries.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:

• Participate in the company's daily operations and management activities, learning the company's business processes and strategies.

• Assume a leadership role in projects, effectively distribute tasks and manage progress, ensuring smooth completion of projects.

• Think independently when encountering problems, propose and implement solutions, and conduct a review after problem resolution.

• Accept feedback from superiors and colleagues, continuously improve your skills and knowledge, and maintain positive energy with an open mindset to change.

• Enhance your professional knowledge and skills by participating in the company's training and learning activities and continuously learning.
